example: The avuncular senior partner slipped the new hires his old exam notes.

hindi: आश्चर्य या प्रशंसा की भावना
definition: an overwhelming feeling of wonder or admiration
example: He stared over the edge with a feeling of awe.

hindi: विस्मयकारी — श्रद्धा और आश्चर्य से भर देने वाला
definition: filling you with reverent wonder and a humbling sense of your own smallness before something vast or magnificent
example: The awe-inspiring drone footage of the glacier made the whole meeting forget the agenda.

hindi: विस्मय-विभोर — श्रद्धामिश्रित आश्चर्य से अभिभूत

hindi: बकबक करना — उत्तेजना या घबराहट में बिना रुके बोलना

example: She babbled happily about the new flat to anyone who would listen at the party.

hindi: प्रसव के बाद की उदासी — नई माँ की अल्पकालिक रुलाई और चिंता

example: On the fourth day home she cried over a burnt toast, and the midwife reassured her that the baby blues were normal.

hindi: पीठ पीछे निंदा — किसी की अनुपस्थिति में बुराई करना
definition: spiteful talk about someone behind their back, usually driven by envy of their position

hindi: रीढ़ — दबाव में डटे रहने की दृढ़ता
definition: the firmness of character that lets someone stand their ground under pressure

hindi: प्रतिक्रिया-आक्रोश — किसी कदम के विरुद्ध भड़का जन-क्रोध

hindi: पीठ पीछे वार — भरोसे में लेकर नुकसान पहुँचाना

hindi: बुराई करना — पीठ पीछे किसी की निंदा करना
definition: to criticise someone unkindly behind their back, spreading a poor opinion of them out of dislike or resentment
example: She found out her ex had been bad-mouthing her to their mutual friends for months.

hindi: चिड़चिड़ा और गुस्सैल — आसानी से नाराज़ होने वाला
definition: easily angered and disagreeable, either by nature or because of a passing foul mood
example: The bad-tempered driver leaned on the horn the moment the light turned green.

hindi: पीछे पड़ना — बार-बार तंग करके परेशान करना
definition: to pester someone persistently with questions or demands until they feel harassed and worn down
example: Her flatmate badgered her about the electricity bill every single evening.

hindi: उलझन — किसी को पूरी तरह चकरा देना
definition: to confuse someone completely so that they feel frustrated at being unable to understand

hindi: चकराया हुआ — किसी बात की कोई समझ न बने

hindi: भौंचक्कापन — समझने की हर कोशिश के बेकार जाने की भावना

hindi: उकसाना — जानबूझकर किसी को क्रोधित करने का प्रयास

hindi: ठिठकना — संदेह या डर से अचानक रुक जाना

hindi: हँसी-मज़ाक — दोस्ताना, चंचल छेड़छाड़ भरी बातचीत

hindi: तीखा व्यंग्य — चुभने के लिए कहा गया कटाक्ष

hindi: झिड़कना — कड़े, तीखे और छोटे शब्दों में क्रोधित आदेश देना

hindi: भावनापूर्ण आनंद द्वारा चिह्नित

hindi: शर्मिंदा महसूस करना

hindi: भावनात्मक रूप से भावनात्मक

hindi: सर्वोच्च सुख की स्थिति

definition: treat cruelly

definition: hostile or warlike attitude or nature

hindi: भावनात्मक रूप से भ्रमित होने का कारण

definition: a desire for bloodshed

hindi: रक्तपिपासु — हिंसा और खून की लालसा
definition: eager for violence and cruelty, taking pleasure in seeing others hurt or killed
example: The comments section turned bloodthirsty the moment the referee's mistake was replayed.

hindi: हठी-विरोधी — दुराग्रह भरी जिद
definition: perversely stubborn and deliberately obstructive, refusing to cooperate just to be difficult, a British streak of contrariness
example: He was too bloody-minded to take the shortcut once his sister had suggested it.

hindi: डींगें मारने वाला — ज़ोर-ज़ोर से खोखली शेखी बघारने वाला
definition: a loud, pompous person who talks boastfully and at length with little substance behind the noise
example: The blowhard at the bar lectured strangers about the economy until the barman turned up the music.

hindi: बिसूरना — बच्चों की तरह ज़ोर से और बेबसी में रोना
definition: to cry noisily and without restraint, in a childish way that you may later feel embarrassed about
example: I blubbed all the way through the final episode and had to hide my face in a cushion.

hindi: फूट-फूटकर रोना — बेतरतीब, ज़ोर से बिलखना
definition: to weep noisily and messily, sobbing in a way that seems childish or lacking self-control
example: By the end of the film the whole row was blubbering into their popcorn.

hindi: उदास — हल्की मलिन उदासी में डूबा हुआ
definition: feeling quietly sorrowful and downhearted, without any single dramatic cause
example: She was feeling blue after the long weekend, missing her family already.

hindi: उदासी की लहर — हल्की, बेवजह उदास मनोदशा
definition: a spell of low spirits and mild sadness that arrives without a clear cause and usually passes
example: She gets the blues every Sunday evening when the weekend shrinks to nothing.

hindi: मुँहफट — बिना लाग-लपेट के कड़वी सच बात कह देने वाला
definition: saying exactly what you think in plain hard words without softening them, honest to the point of hurting
example: He was blunt about the design, telling the whole meeting it looked unfinished.

hindi: भावों की मंदता — भावनात्मक अभिव्यक्ति का घट जाना
definition: a reduced outward display of emotion where reactions seem muted and faces and voices show little feeling
example: The therapist noted a blunted affect when he described his promotion in the same tone as the weather.

hindi: बोल पड़ना — बिना सोचे, आवेश में अचानक कह देना
definition: to say something suddenly and without thinking, because feeling or nerves pushed the words out
example: He blurted out that he loved her in the middle of the supermarket queue.

hindi: लजाना — शर्म से चेहरा लाल होना
definition: to turn red in the face from embarrassment, shyness or modesty, the body giving the feeling away
example: He blushed when the barista remembered his usual order.

hindi: दहाड़-दपट करना — भीतर की असुरक्षा छिपाने के लिए ज़ोर से खोखली धमकी देना
definition: to talk loudly and aggressively with empty threats, usually to hide that you feel threatened or in the wrong
example: He blustered about calling his lawyer, but everyone could see the complaint had rattled him.

hindi: डींग मारने वाला — अपनी उपलब्धियों का बखान करने वाला
definition: given to talking with excessive pride about your own achievements, possessions or abilities in a way that seeks admiration
example: His boastful message about closing the deal single-handedly ignored the four people who had built the proposal.

hindi: आने के लिए बुराई की भावना
definition: a feeling of evil to come
example: A steadily escalating sense of foreboding.

hindi: चकरा जाना — विशालता से मन का हैरान होना
definition: to feel overwhelmed with amazement or confusion because something seems too enormous or strange to grasp
example: The mind boggles at how many emails the support inbox collected over one long weekend.

hindi: हुल्लड़ भरा — शोरगुल वाला उल्लास
definition: noisy, energetic and cheerfully rowdy, with a loudness that comes from good spirits rather than anger
example: The boisterous birthday crowd at the next table sang three rounds of the same song.

hindi: निर्भीकता — जोखिम उठाने का बेधड़क साहस
definition: willingness to take risks and act confidently where others hesitate or hold back
example: Her boldness in asking for double the salary paid off.

hindi: अड़ियल-विद्रोही — सहयोग से इनकार करता उग्र स्वभाव
definition: stubbornly uncooperative and argumentative, a British temperament that resists authority on principle and enjoys the fight
example: The intern turned bolshie when asked to redo the slides and refused to change a single word.

hindi: आत्मीय बंधन — दो लोगों के बीच स्नेह और भरोसे का मज़बूत जुड़ाव
definition: a strong emotional connection between people that holds firm through time, distance and disagreement
example: The bond between the two brothers survived years of living on opposite sides of the world.

hindi: हड्डियाँ जमा देने वाला — भीतर तक सिहरन और भय भर देने वाला
definition: so frightening or sinister that a cold shiver of dread seems to reach right into the bones
example: The bone-chilling silence on the emergency call recording stayed with him all afternoon.

hindi: हड्डियों तक थका — गहरी, पूरी थकावट
definition: exhausted so deeply that the tiredness seems to reach into your bones and every movement costs effort
example: After the double shift he was bone-tired and fell asleep on the bus home, still in his uniform.

hindi: (फ्रेंच) खुशी और अच्छा हास्य
definition: (French) happiness and good humor

hindi: हूट करना — अस्वीकृति या तिरस्कार में ज़ोर से आवाज़ करना
definition: to shout loudly in disapproval or scorn at a performer, speaker or unpopular decision, usually together with a crowd
example: The crowd booed when the referee waved play on.

hindi: ज़ोर-ज़ोर से रोना — दिखावटी या बचकाना रुदन
definition: to weep loudly and theatrically, said with a hint that the tears are exaggerated or childish
example: My little brother boohooed for an hour because his sandcastle got knocked down.

hindi: कुछ tedious द्वारा बोर होने की भावना
definition: the feeling of being bored by something tedious

hindi: हुक्म चलाने वाला — बिना अधिकार के आदेश देने का स्वभाव
definition: fond of giving orders and telling people what to do, controlling in an everyday irritating way
example: My bossy flatmate has colour-coded the fridge shelves and inspects them nightly.

hindi: परेशान करना — हल्की चिंता या खीज पैदा करना
definition: to cause someone mild worry or nagging irritation that keeps tugging at their attention
example: It bothered him all week that he had forgotten to thank the receptionist.

hindi: भीतर बंद की हुई — बाहर न आने दी गई दबाई हुई भावना
definition: describing emotions deliberately kept inside and never expressed, sealed away rather than shared
example: His bottled-up grief finally surfaced when a colleague asked how his father was doing.

hindi: उछलती ऊर्जा — जोश और खुशी से भरपूर, थमने वाला नहीं
definition: energetically cheerful and lively, with a spring in every movement that refuses to be flattened
example: The kids were still bouncy at nine at night, jumping between the sofa cushions.

hindi: प्रचुर उदार — भरपूर मात्रा में देने वाला
definition: giving generously and in great abundance, as if there were more than enough for everyone
example: The bountiful host kept refilling plates long after the guests had said they were full.

hindi: तैयार होना — आने वाले आघात के लिए मन को कड़ा करना
definition: to prepare yourself mentally for something unpleasant or shocking, tensing your resolve before the blow lands
example: He braced himself before opening the email titled 'Regarding your application'.

hindi: डींग हाँकना — शेखी बघारना
definition: to talk about your own successes or possessions with obvious pride in order to impress other people
example: She could not stop bragging about her new salary during the whole train journey home.

hindi: शेखीबाज़ — अपनी बड़ाई बढ़-चढ़कर करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a person who boasts loudly and constantly about their own achievements and successes, wearying listeners with endless self-praise
example: The braggart at the reunion worked his promotion into every single conversation.

hindi: उद्दंड आत्मविश्वासी — बेहिचक और शोरगुल भरा
definition: loudly and aggressively self-confident, with a rough energy that ignores tact and pushes ahead regardless
example: The brash new sales lead pitched to the client before anyone had introduced him.

hindi: तंग आकर खिन्न — लंबी ऊब से उपजी नाराज़गी
definition: bored and irritated to the point of resentment, a British word for the sour mood of someone stuck doing something dull
example: After a month of filing invoices he was properly brassed off with the job.

hindi: बहादुरी — भय के बावजूद खतरे का सामना करने का गुण
definition: the quality of facing danger or pain while still feeling the fear that comes with it
example: It took real bravery to walk back into the office the day after the company announced layoffs.

hindi: धृष्ट — निडर बेशर्मी
definition: bold and unembarrassed in doing something wrong, as if daring anyone to object
example: She made a brazen grab for the credit in front of the whole team.

hindi: साँस थमी — उत्तेजना या विस्मय से साँस रुक जाना
definition: so gripped by excited wonder or suspense that you seem to forget to breathe while it lasts
example: The fans were breathless as the final penalty was placed on the spot.

hindi: साँस रोक देने वाला — अत्यंत सुंदर या भव्य
definition: so beautiful or impressive that it leaves you gasping with sudden wonder and delight for a moment
example: The view from the new office rooftop was breathtaking on a clear evening.

hindi: बेफ़िक्र प्रसन्नता — सहज और चिंतामुक्त
definition: cheerful and relaxed in a casual, unbothered manner, as if nothing weighs heavily
example: He gave a breezy wave and said the missed deadline was no big deal.

hindi: चमकती आँखों वाला — उत्साह और ताज़गी से भरा
definition: alert and eagerly enthusiastic, with the fresh excitement of someone who cannot wait to begin
example: The bright-eyed new starters arrived twenty minutes early for their first stand-up.

hindi: खिल उठना — चेहरा और मन अचानक प्रसन्न हो जाना
definition: to become visibly happier and more cheerful all at once, the gloom lifting from a face as gladness returns
example: He brightened the moment his daughter's name lit up his phone screen.

hindi: उमंग-ऊर्जा — जोश और जीवंतता के साथ काम करना
definition: a lively, confident energy and enthusiasm brought to doing something, especially performing
example: He played the wedding set with such brio that the aunties left the buffet to dance.

hindi: भड़क उठना — अपमान पर तुरंत तनकर प्रतिक्रिया करना
definition: to react with sudden defensive anger, stiffening visibly at a remark that feels like a challenge
example: She bristled when the interviewer suggested her degree was not a real qualification.

hindi: बहुत चिड़चिड़ा
definition: very irritable
example: Bristly exchanges between the White House and the press.

hindi: भंगुर मन — ऊपर से सख़्त पर भीतर से टूटने को तैयार
definition: holding together with a hard, tense cheerfulness that could crack at any moment, hiding hurt behind a sharp edge
example: Her brittle laugh at the mention of his engagement told the whole office how she really felt.

hindi: दु:ख से भरा
definition: full of sorrow

hindi: चिंता में डूबना — किसी दुःख पर बार-बार सोचना
definition: to dwell gloomily on a hurt or worry, turning it over in the mind until it darkens the mood
example: She brooded over the offhand comment from the meeting for the entire train ride home.

hindi: चिंतामग्न उदासी — किसी दुःख पर लगातार सोचते रहना
definition: sunk in a heavy, silent mood of turning over some grievance or worry again and again
example: He sat brooding at the window long after the argument had ended.

hindi: संतान की लालसा से भरा — बच्चा पाने और पालने की गहरी चाह से भावुक
definition: feeling a strong longing to have a baby of your own, often stirred by being around other people's children
example: Holding her friend's newborn in the kitchen made her unexpectedly broody.

hindi: सहन करना — किसी बात को बर्दाश्त न करने की दृढ़ता
definition: to tolerate or put up with something, almost always used to say what someone will not stand for
example: The new director would brook no delay on the launch date.

hindi: भाईचारे भरा — भाई जैसी सुरक्षात्मक और निश्छल स्नेह-भावना
definition: showing the protective, easy affection of a brother, warm and teasing without any romance in it
example: He gave the younger colleague a brotherly pat on the back after the presentation went well.

hindi: डांट-डपट से दबा — कठोर दबाव से मानने पर मजबूर
definition: worn down into silent submission by someone's bullying words and stern intimidation over time
example: Browbeaten by weeks of criticism, he stopped defending his design choices altogether.

hindi: चमचागिरी करना — ऊपर वालों की खुशामद में लगे रहना
definition: to flatter and fawn over a person in authority so obviously that everyone else can see the motive
example: He brown-nosed the new director so hard at lunch that his colleagues stopped eating to watch.

hindi: ऊबा-चिढ़ा — बेकार के इंतज़ार से खिन्न
definition: tired and mildly annoyed, usually from boredom or endless waiting, a British irritation that turned dull and heavy
example: By the third delay announcement the passengers were thoroughly browned off.

hindi: आहत अहं — आत्म-सम्मान को लगी हल्की चोट की टीस
definition: the sore, sulky feeling that lingers after your sense of your own importance or ability has taken a knock
example: He nursed a bruised ego for the whole afternoon after the intern spotted the bug he had missed.

hindi: निर्मम — कठोर और क्रूर आघात करने वाला
definition: savagely cruel or harsh in manner, with no attempt made to soften the blow being delivered
example: The brutal feedback left the junior designer in tears in the stairwell.

hindi: चहकता हुआ — हँसमुख और उत्साही स्वभाव
definition: lively, cheerful and excitable in a warm way that makes conversation feel easy
example: The new receptionist was so bubbly that visitors lingered at the desk just to chat.

hindi: आशावादी और आक्रामक भरोसा — किसी चीज़ के बढ़ने और सफल होने का पक्का यकीन
definition: aggressively confident that a plan, market or person will grow and succeed, ready to bet on it
example: The founder was bullish about the new pricing tier and told the whole company so in the group chat.

hindi: दबंगई करना — कमज़ोर को धमकाकर और डराकर सताना
definition: to use strength or power to intimidate and hurt someone weaker, repeatedly and out of cruelty rather than any real quarrel
example: The senior analyst bullied the interns by mocking their questions in front of the whole floor.

hindi: अनाड़ीपन — हड़बड़ाहट में बार-बार गलती करना
definition: clumsy and confused in a flustered way that keeps causing small awkward mistakes in front of others
example: The bumbling new waiter apologised three times before he managed to take the order.

hindi: उदास-निराश — किसी छोटी बात से मन बुझा हुआ
definition: mildly disappointed and downcast about something that fell through, a casual American gloom rather than deep sorrow
example: She was bummed the gig got cancelled, but by dinner she had made other plans.

hindi: उद्धत — शोरगुल भरा आत्मविश्वास दिखाने वाला
definition: irritatingly self-assertive and loud in your confidence, pushing yourself forward in a way that annoys everyone around you
example: The bumptious new hire interrupted the senior engineer twice to explain how things were done at his last company.

hindi: उत्साह — किसी के मन को ऊपर उठाकर आशावान बनाना
definition: to keep someone's spirits up and hopeful, as if holding them afloat above discouragement
example: The early sales figures buoyed the whole startup through a difficult quarter.

hindi: cheerfulness कि सतह के लिए बुलबुले
definition: cheerfulness that bubbles to the surface

hindi: उत्फुल्ल — ऐसा हल्का और खुशमिज़ाज मन जो निराशा में डूबता नहीं
definition: cheerful and hopeful in a light, floating way that quickly rises back after setbacks
example: Even after the third rejection email he was buoyant enough to start drafting the next application over breakfast.

hindi: थकान से चुका हुआ — लंबे तनाव के बाद उत्साह और ऊर्जा खो चुका
definition: emotionally emptied by long, unrelieved stress, so that work once cared about now feels pointless and draining
example: After two years of night shifts she admitted she was burnt out and could not face another rota.

hindi: काम-काजी और औपचारिक — भावनाओं को अलग रखकर कार्यकुशल
definition: efficient and impersonal in manner, keeping feelings out of a situation to get the practical things done
example: The estate agent was brisk and businesslike as she showed them the flat where his mother had died.

hindi: दखलंदाज़ व्यक्ति — दूसरों के मामलों में अनचाही रुचि लेने वाला
definition: a person who takes far too much curious interest in other people's affairs and interferes in them
example: The office busybody had somehow learned about the resignation before the manager did.

hindi: बंद-सधा — भावनाओं को कसकर छिपाए रखने वाला औपचारिक स्वभाव
definition: emotionally reserved and formal, keeping feelings tightly fastened away behind a correct careful manner
example: Even at the leaving party the buttoned-up accountant never loosened his tie or his smile.

hindi: उत्साह की सिहरन — हल्की और सुखद उत्तेजना
definition: a pleasant feeling of lively excitement and energy, often shared among a crowd
example: There was a buzz in the office all morning before the product reveal.

hindi: उल्लास से गुंजित — शरीर में सिहरन जैसी उमंग
definition: thrilled and full of excited energy after a good result, a British word for happiness that cannot keep still
example: She was buzzing after the interview and rang three friends on the walk home.

hindi: मज़ा किरकिरा करने वाला — उत्साह ठंडा कर देने वाली बात
definition: something or someone that abruptly spoils a happy, excited mood and leaves the enjoyment deflated
example: Mentioning Monday's audit at the Friday drinks was a total buzzkill.

hindi: दर्शक-उदासीनता — भीड़ में सबका मदद न करना
definition: the strange unwillingness to help someone in trouble when other people are present, each person feeling it is not their place
example: Bystander apathy kept a dozen commuters staring at their phones while the woman searched for her lost child.

hindi: बंद रहने की बेचैनी — लंबे समय तक घर में कैद रहने की उकताहट
definition: restless irritable tension that builds from being shut indoors and severed from people for too long
example: By the third week of the storm the whole flat had cabin fever and argued over who left the mug in the sink.

hindi: अट्टहास करना — बेहद ऊँची, बेलगाम और बेढब हँसी हँसना
definition: to laugh loudly, harshly and without restraint, in a way that draws stares
example: Someone at the back of the cinema cachinnated through every serious scene.

hindi: कर्कश हँसी — तीखी, तेज़ और कुछ दुष्ट-सी हँसी
definition: to laugh in a loud, harsh, high-pitched way, often with a wicked or gleeful edge to it
example: She cackled with delight when her prank finally caught her brother out.

hindi: बेवजह की सुस्त उदासी — बिना कारण छाई नीरस मायूसी
definition: a bout of dull listless gloom and sunken spirits that descends for no reason and drains the will to do anything
example: A midweek cafard kept him staring at the same email draft for an hour without typing a word.

hindi: टालमटोल करने वाला — सीधा जवाब देने से बचने वाला
definition: deliberately vague and evasive about your plans or feelings, giving nothing away because you do not trust how it will be used
example: When asked whether he was interviewing elsewhere, he went cagey and changed the subject to lunch.

hindi: संवेदनहीन — दूसरों के दुख के प्रति कठोर और बेपरवाह
definition: showing a hardened indifference to the suffering or feelings of other people, without any softening of sympathy
example: It felt callous when the manager announced the cuts and then asked who wanted cake.

hindi: शांति — मन में हलचल या उत्तेजना का अभाव
definition: a quiet, settled state of mind in which no strong feeling or agitation is stirring
example: After the argument ended, a strange calm settled over the apartment and they both made tea.

hindi: कर दिखाने का हौसला — हर चुनौती को संभव मानने वाला आत्मविश्वासी रवैया
definition: confidently willing and eager to tackle any problem, sure that a way forward can be found
example: Her can-do attitude meant the leaking dishwasher became a weekend project instead of a complaint.

hindi: झगड़ालू चिड़चिड़ापन — बात-बात पर बहस करने वाला
definition: bad-tempered and argumentative by habit, quick to quarrel over small things and hard to please
example: The cantankerous old neighbour complained about the noise of children playing every single afternoon.

hindi: अचानक इच्छा
definition: a sudden desire
example: He bought it on an impulse.

hindi: आकर्षित करना
definition: attract; cause to be enamored
example: She captured all the men's hearts.

hindi: निश्चिंत — चिंता और ज़िम्मेदारी के बोझ से मुक्त प्रसन्नता
definition: light and happy because no worry or responsibility is weighing on the mind for the moment
example: The first carefree afternoon of the holidays was spent doing absolutely nothing by the pool.

hindi: जब आपके पास कुछ भी नहीं है, तो आपको खुशी होगी
definition: the cheerful feeling you have when nothing is troubling you

hindi: देखभालकर्ता का बोझ — किसी बीमार की लगातार देखभाल से उपजी थकान और तनाव
definition: the strain, exhaustion and guilt felt by someone who looks after a sick or dependent relative for a long time
example: The support group helped him name the caregiver burden he had been carrying since his mother's diagnosis.

hindi: स्नेह से सहलाना — कोमल स्पर्श से प्रेम प्रकट करना
definition: to touch or stroke someone gently and slowly as a way of showing tender affection
example: She caressed the sleeping toddler's hair while the rest of the house argued about dinner.

hindi: चिंता से थका — लंबी चिंताओं से घिसा हुआ
definition: showing the marks of long worry and sorrow, a tired sadness worn into the face over years
example: The careworn nurse smiled at the end of the double shift, but her eyes stayed tired.

hindi: प्यार करना
definition: a loving feeling

hindi: परेशान करना या असहज बनाना या चिंतित होना या चिंतित होना
definition: disturb in mind or make uneasy or cause to be worried or alarmed
example: She was rather perturbed by the news that her father was seriously ill.

hindi: शरीर की भूख और जुनून द्वारा चिह्नित
definition: marked by the appetites and passions of the body
example: Animal instincts.

hindi: मौज-मस्ती — शराब और शोर के साथ सामूहिक जश्न
definition: loud, cheerful group drinking and merrymaking that goes on late into the night
example: The carousing after the product launch meant a very quiet office the next morning.

hindi: नुक्ताचीनी करना — छोटी-छोटी गलतियाँ निकालकर शिकायत करना
definition: to find fault constantly over trivial things, complaining in a nagging petty way
example: She carped at every comma in the report until the writer gave up.

hindi: Unconcern द्वारा चिह्नित
definition: marked by blithe unconcern
example: An ability to interest casual students.

hindi: अनर्थ सोचना — हर छोटी परेशानी को भयंकर विपत्ति मान लेना
definition: to imagine the worst possible outcome of a situation and treat it as almost certain
example: She tends to catastrophize, so one missed deadline became losing the job and the flat.

hindi: ताना भरी सीटी — अस्वीकृति या अपमान में ऊँची तीखी आवाज़
definition: a loud whistle or shout of disapproval, mockery or harassment aimed at someone in public
example: The comedian silenced a catcall from the back row with a single raised eyebrow.

hindi: विरेचक — दबी भावनाओं को बाहर निकालकर हल्का करने वाला
definition: bringing relief by releasing pent-up sorrow or anger through tears, shouting or expression
example: Smashing the old printer in the car park turned out to be more cathartic than the team-building retreat.

hindi: भावनात्मक निवेश — किसी व्यक्ति, वस्तु या विचार पर मनोवेग का केंद्रित होना
definition: the concentration of emotional energy on a person, object or idea, psychology's term for investing feeling
example: His cathexis on the old family car was so strong that selling it felt like losing a relative.

hindi: चुभने वाला — दबे स्वर में द्वेषपूर्ण टिप्पणी करना
definition: making subtly spiteful remarks about someone, often about their looks or choices, out of rivalry
example: The group chat turned catty the moment the new colleague posted her holiday photos.

hindi: तीखा — जलाने वाली कटु टिप्पणी
definition: sharply sarcastic and bitter in a manner that scorches and humiliates the person it is aimed at
example: One caustic comment from the coach was enough to make the new player go quiet for the whole match.

hindi: सावधान — खतरे की आशंका से धीरे और संभलकर आगे बढ़ने वाला
definition: careful to avoid danger or mistakes, holding back with a wary, faintly anxious watchfulness before committing
example: She stayed cautious about the group holiday until she had seen the actual booking confirmation.

hindi: लापरवाह घमंड वाला — गंभीर बातों को हल्के में लेने वाला
definition: showing a proud, offhand lack of concern about something serious, as though it were beneath your attention
example: Her cavalier shrug when the backup failed made the rest of the team more worried, not less.

hindi: जश्न मनाने वाला — सफलता की खुशी में किया गया
definition: done in a mood of shared gladness to mark a success or special occasion
example: They ordered celebratory pizza the moment the last bug was closed.

hindi: कठोर आलोचक — हर बात में दोष निकालने वाला
definition: quick to condemn and find fault with other people's behaviour, judging them harshly from a position of moral superiority
example: Her censorious glance at his lunch made him feel he should apologise for the crisps.

hindi: स्थिरचित्त — भीतर से संतुलित और अविचलित
definition: calmly balanced within oneself so that outside pressures do not easily knock you off course
example: Ten minutes of breathing in the stairwell left him centered before the difficult meeting.

hindi: आत्मस्थ — भीतर से शांत और एकाग्र
definition: calm and inwardly balanced, with attention settled rather than scattered by outside pressure
example: Ten minutes of breathing in the car left him centred enough to walk into the interview.

hindi: पूर्ण निश्चय — किसी बात पर कोई संदेह न होना
definition: complete inner certainty that leaves no room for doubt or second thoughts
example: He answered with a certitude that made everyone else question their own memory.

hindi: कुढ़ना — बंधन या रोक से झुंझलाना
definition: to grow impatient and irritated under a restriction or constraint that rubs against one's wishes
example: The new hires chafed at having every email checked by a supervisor before sending.

hindi: हँसी-ठिठोली करना — हल्के मज़ाक में किसी को छेड़ना
definition: to tease someone lightly and good-humouredly, trading playful banter without any real sting
example: The regulars chaffed the barista about her new haircut while she made their coffees.

hindi: शर्मिंदगी की मजबूत भावनाओं
definition: strong feelings of embarrassment

hindi: परिवर्तनशील मिज़ाज — जिसका मूड बार-बार बदलता रहे
definition: having moods and opinions that shift often and unpredictably from hour to hour, without the sharpness of real anger
example: Her changeable moods meant the group chat never knew whether the weekend plan was still on.

hindi: दयालु उदारता — दूसरों को उदारता से आँकने का भाव
definition: generous and kind in judging other people, giving them the benefit of the doubt
example: Take the charitable view and assume he missed the meeting because something went wrong at home.

hindi: परोपकार-भाव — जरूरतमंदों के प्रति दया और उदारता
definition: a warm, generous kindness towards those in need or towards people who have done wrong
example: She spoke of her ex with a charity that surprised her friends.

hindi: आकर्षित करना — सुखद व्यवहार से मन जीत लेना
definition: to delight someone and win their affection through warmth, wit and a pleasant manner
example: The new intern charmed the entire floor within a week with her easy laugh.

hindi: मोहित — किसी की मधुरता से प्रसन्न और आकर्षित
definition: pleasantly delighted and won over by something lovely or endearing, warmed by its appeal rather than swept away
example: The interviewer was clearly charmed by the way he thanked the receptionist on his way out.

hindi: संकोची सावधानी — किसी काम या वादे में पड़ने से बचना
definition: cautiously unwilling to commit or take a risk, holding back through careful, slightly fearful reserve
example: After the last flat-share fell apart she was chary of promising anyone a room again.

hindi: सुधारात्मक पश्चाताप — गलती का बोध कराकर विनम्र बनाना
definition: to make someone feel subdued and regretful after a setback, so that they become humbler and more careful
example: A chastened intern rewrote the whole report after the client caught the error.

hindi: सबक से नरम पड़ा — दंड से सुधरा
definition: subdued and sobered after a rebuke or failure, with the sting of shame turned quietly into a lesson learned
example: Chastened by the feedback, she rewrote the whole proposal.

hindi: ठगा हुआ — अपने हक़ से वंचित होने की कड़वाहट
definition: bitter at being denied something you fairly deserved, whether through dishonesty or plain unfairness
example: She felt cheated when the promotion went to the colleague who had joined six months after her.

hindi: ढीठ-चुलबुला — मज़ेदार ढंग से अशिष्ट और शरारती
definition: playfully impudent and bold, mildly disrespectful in a way that makes people laugh rather than object
example: The cheeky reply from the delivery driver about our doorbell made the whole family laugh.

hindi: हौसला बढ़ाना — किसी उदास को प्रसन्न करना
definition: to make a downhearted person feel happier and more hopeful, or to shout out in gladness and support
example: A handwritten note in the lunchbox cheered him up after a rough morning.

hindi: प्रफुल्ल — स्वभाव से खुशमिज़ाज और हँसमुख
definition: noticeably happy and good-natured in an everyday, steady way that lifts the mood of others
example: The cheerful barista remembered everyone's order and hummed while steaming the milk.

hindi: उदासी और अपर्याप्तता के कारण
definition: causing sad feelings of gloom and inadequacy
example: The economic outlook is depressing.

hindi: डरावना या निराशावादी उदासी की भावना
definition: a feeling of dreary or pessimistic sadness

hindi: ऊबकर चिढ़ा हुआ — तंग आकर खिन्न
definition: weary and irritated after putting up with something tiresome for too long, a British annoyance more tired than fierce
example: She was cheesed off with the train being late for the fifth morning running.

hindi: सस्ती भावुकता — बनावटी और घटिया रूप से भावुक
definition: cheaply sentimental with an obvious insincerity that feels tacky, embarrassing and second-hand
example: The farewell video had cheesy slow-motion hugs set to piano music.

hindi: आपसी तालमेल का जादू — दो लोगों के बीच अनायास बनने वाला भावनात्मक खिंचाव
definition: the spark of mutual attraction and easy understanding between two people that neither can quite explain
example: Everyone on the team noticed the chemistry between the two presenters before they noticed it themselves.

hindi: संजोकर रखना — किसी को स्नेह से अनमोल मानकर सहेजना
definition: to hold someone or something dear and protect them tenderly because they feel precious and irreplaceable to you
example: He cherishes the chipped mug his daughter painted for him and will not let anyone else use it.

hindi: हल्की डांट — स्नेहपूर्ण किन्तु असंतुष्ट फटकार
definition: to scold someone mildly, expressing disappointment in a gentle way that carries more concern than anger
example: She chided her husband for skipping lunch again when the doctor had told him not to.

hindi: शांत-निश्चिंत — तनावमुक्त सहज मिज़ाज
definition: relaxed and easygoing, unbothered by pressure and slow to take offence, a calm that others find restful
example: Their new manager is pretty chill about start times as long as the work gets done.

hindi: रोंगटे खड़े करने वाला — ठंडे भय से भर देने वाला
definition: producing a cold, creeping sense of fear because of how calm or deliberate a threat seems
example: The chilling voicemail simply said he knew where she parked.

hindi: सिहरन — भावना से उपजी ठंडी कंपकंपी
definition: a sudden shiver through the body caused by a powerful emotional moment rather than cold
example: She got chills when the old recording of her mother's voice started playing.

hindi: रूखा और ठंडा — मैत्रीहीन शीतल व्यवहार
definition: unfriendly and cool in manner, with a noticeable lack of warmth that stops short of open hostility
example: Relations in the shared office had been chilly since the fridge incident.

hindi: चुस्त-प्रसन्न — खुश और फुर्तीला
definition: cheerful and lively in a brisk, energetic way, often surprisingly so given the hour or situation
example: She was oddly chipper for someone who had just come off a red-eye flight.

hindi: स्पर्शकातर-आक्रामक — हीनता से उपजी चिढ़
definition: touchy and quick to take offence, carrying a defensive resentment about being looked down on, a British irritability with a grudge
example: He got chippy about his accent as soon as the London office joined the call.

hindi: चहकता हुआ — हल्के-फुल्के ढंग से खुश और बातूनी
definition: cheerful and talkative in a light, bouncy way, like a small bird chattering in the morning
example: His chirpy good-morning messages in the group chat were either charming or annoying depending on your sleep.

hindi: हड़बड़ाना — किसी को जल्दी करने के लिए बार-बार टोकना
definition: to keep urging or nagging someone impatiently to hurry up or get something done
example: She had to chivvy the kids out of the door so they would not miss the bus again.

hindi: गला रुँधना — तीव्र भावना से आवाज़ अटक जाना
definition: to become unable to speak clearly because sudden strong emotion, usually grief or gratitude, tightens your throat
example: Dad choked up halfway through reading the card and had to hand it to Mum.

hindi: गहरी निराशा — गला रुँधाने वाला दुख
definition: bitterly disappointed and upset, so crushed that you barely manage to speak, a British word for a heartbreaking result
example: The striker was choked after missing the penalty that would have won the cup.

hindi: गला रुंधा हुआ — भावुकता से आवाज़ अटकी हुई
definition: unable to speak steadily because a sudden rush of tender emotion has tightened the throat
example: He got choked up reading the thank-you notes the students had slipped under his door.

hindi: एक चिड़चिड़ा महसूस
definition: an irritable petulant feeling

hindi: आसानी से क्रोधित हो गया; - H.G. वेल्स
definition: easily moved to anger; - H.G.Wells
example: Men of the choleric type take to kicking and smashing.

hindi: खिलखिलाना — खुशी से दबी हुई हँसी हँसना
definition: to give a breathy, gleeful laugh that mixes a chuckle with a snort of satisfaction
example: She chortled at the typo in the client email before quietly fixing it.

hindi: हल्के से हँसना — दबी और शांत हँसी
definition: to laugh quietly and softly to oneself, usually at something mildly amusing
example: He chuckled at the meme, then forwarded it to the whole family group.

hindi: बहुत खुश — गर्व से भरी प्रसन्नता
definition: very pleased and quietly proud about something, in a modest, satisfied way that shows more in a grin than in words
example: He was chuffed that his fix made it into the release notes.

hindi: घनिष्ठ मित्रता — खुली और आत्मीय दोस्ताना निकटता
definition: friendly and intimate in an easy, informal way, sometimes more than the situation calls for
example: The new client got chummy fast, sending memes to the group chat by lunchtime.

hindi: भुनभुनाना — दबे स्वर में असंतोष बड़बड़ाना
definition: to mutter and grumble under your breath in a steady stream of discontent, a British word for low-level moaning
example: Grandad chuntered about the price of parking the whole way from the car to the shop.

hindi: सोच-समझकर चलने वाला — जोखिम से बचने की सावधानी
definition: thinking carefully about the consequences before speaking or acting, unwilling to take risks with people you do not know well
example: She was circumspect about what she posted in the team channel once she learned the client could read it.

hindi: कोलाहल — किसी माँग या रोष में उठी बहुत लोगों की ऊँची आवाज़
definition: a loud, confused outcry from many people at once, expressing anger, demand or protest
example: There was a clamour in the group chat when the venue changed the night before the party.

hindi: गुटपरस्त — अपने गुट से बाहर के लोगों को दूर रखने वाला
definition: closely loyal to your own group and cool or suspicious toward anyone outside it
example: The founders were clannish, lunching together every day and never inviting the newer staff.

hindi: बंद जगह का भय — तंग या घिरी हुई जगहों से होने वाली घबराहट
definition: an intense fear of being shut in small or enclosed spaces, bringing on panic and a need to escape
example: His claustrophobia made the packed lift at the conference unbearable.

hindi: स्पष्ट-बुद्धि — घबराहट या भावना से धुंधलाए बिना सोचने वाला
definition: thinking calmly and lucidly, especially under pressure, with judgement unclouded by panic, anger or wishful hope
example: The most clearheaded person in the outage was the intern who simply asked what had changed at four o'clock.

hindi: चिपकू लगाव — स्नेह में किसी से इतना जुड़ना कि उसे घुटन होने लगे
definition: needing someone's attention and closeness so much that your affection becomes suffocating and dependent
example: He worried he was being clingy when he texted to ask why she had not replied within ten minutes.

hindi: भावशून्य और वस्तुनिष्ठ — बिना भावना के, तटस्थ ढंग से
definition: coolly detached and efficient, dealing with something emotional as if it were a technical problem
example: The way he broke up with her by bullet points was so clinical that she almost laughed.

hindi: कटी-छँटी बोली — दबे गुस्से में छोटे-छोटे तीखे शब्द
definition: spoken in short tight words with the warmth trimmed away, usually a sign that someone is holding back annoyance
example: Her clipped replies in the group chat told everyone she was still angry about the missed deadline.

hindi: गुटबाज़ — अपने छोटे घेरे को चिपके रहने और बाहरी को दूर रखने वाला
definition: clinging to a small, closed circle of friends and treating anyone outside it with cool exclusion
example: The design team was so cliquish that new hires ate lunch alone for their first month.

hindi: घड़ी देखना — अधीरता से समय बीतने का इंतज़ार
definition: the restless habit of repeatedly checking the time out of boredom or impatience for something to end
example: By the third hour of the training day the clock-watching in the back row was impossible to miss.

hindi: अंतरंग होने की भावना और एक साथ संबंध
definition: a feeling of being intimate and belonging together
example: Their closeness grew as the night wore on.

hindi: समापन-बोध — किसी दुखद अध्याय के पूरा होने की शांति
definition: the settled feeling that a painful chapter has properly ended and no longer needs to be carried
example: The final conversation with her old manager finally gave her closure on the job she had left.

hindi: अति से ऊब पैदा करना — अधिक मिठास या सुख से जी भर जाना
definition: to sicken or bore someone through an excess of something sweet or pleasant that was once welcome
example: The constant praise from the new manager began to cloy after the first week.

hindi: टक-टक करना — चिंता, सहानुभूति या हल्की नाराज़गी में जीभ चटकाना
definition: to make a short tongue-clicking sound to express concern, sympathy or mild disapproval
example: The receptionist clucked sympathetically when I explained about the missed train.

hindi: पुचकार कर मनाना — धीरज और कोमलता से राज़ी करना
definition: to persuade a reluctant or nervous person gradually with patience, gentle encouragement and kind words
example: She coaxed the shy new hire into presenting his idea to the group.

hindi: अतिआत्मविश्वासी — बिना आधार के अपने सही होने का पक्का यकीन
definition: confident in a cheeky, presumptuous way, certain of being right without good reason
example: The cocksure new analyst dismissed the warning and pushed his numbers straight to the client.

hindi: अकड़ू — बेपरवाह और छिछला आत्मविश्वास दिखाने वाला
definition: confident in a cheeky, careless way that assumes success is guaranteed, often just before things go wrong
example: He was cocky enough to skip the rehearsal and then forgot his opening line in front of the whole client team.

hindi: सुरक्षित घेरा — बाहरी दुनिया से लिपटी हुई निश्चिंतता
definition: wrapped up in a safe, comfortable space that keeps the world and its worries out, protected and at rest
example: Cocooned under the duvet with a podcast playing, she let the emails wait until Monday.

hindi: अति-लाड़ से पालना — स्नेहवश किसी को इतना बचाना कि वह कमज़ोर पड़े
definition: to treat someone with an overly soft and protective affection that may stop them from growing tougher
example: The coach refused to coddle the new player and made him run the same drills as everyone else.

hindi: सह-निर्भरता — किसी की ज़रूरतों में डूबकर अपनी पहचान खो देना
definition: an unhealthy emotional reliance on another person, in which your worth depends on being needed and rescuing them
example: She recognised the codependency when she cancelled her own job interview to fix her brother's overdraft again.

hindi: संज्ञानात्मक असंगति — विरोधी विश्वासों के टकराव से उपजी बेचैनी
definition: the mental discomfort felt when your beliefs and actions contradict each other
example: The cognitive dissonance of preaching sustainability while flying weekly began to bother her.

hindi: संज्ञानात्मक समानुभूति — दूसरे के भाव और दृष्टिकोण को समझना
definition: psychology's term for understanding what another person feels and why, without necessarily sharing the feeling yourself
example: The negotiator relied on cognitive empathy to guess how the anxious client would react to each offer.

hindi: एकजुटता — सदस्यों के बीच जुड़ाव और साथ रहने की भावना
definition: the feeling of being tightly bound to the other members of a group, so that people pull together and want to stay together
example: Three weeks of shared night shifts gave the new crew a cohesion the managers could feel in the room.

hindi: ठंडे दिल का — बिना भावना के क्रूरता
definition: deliberately cruel without any feeling or heat of passion, acting with calm indifference to suffering
example: The coldblooded way she fired him over a video call while eating lunch shocked the team.

hindi: सहानुभूति या भावना में कमी
definition: lacking in sympathy or feeling

hindi: दूसरों के कल्याण के लिए चिंता की अनुपस्थिति
definition: an absence of concern for the welfare of others

hindi: रूखापन — स्नेहहीन दूरी
definition: a lack of warmth or friendliness that keeps others at a distance and withholds any kindness
example: The coldness in her voice when she said goodnight told him the argument was not over.

hindi: संयत — घबराहट के बीच भी शांत और सधा हुआ
definition: calm and steady in a tense moment, with thoughts gathered and feelings under control when others are flustered
example: While the rest of the kitchen shouted over the burnt order, the head chef stayed collected and started again.

hindi: सामूहिक उल्लास — एक साथ जुटे लोगों में उमड़ता साझा आवेश
definition: the electric, uplifting shared excitement that surges through a crowd acting in unison, at a concert, a match or a rally
example: When the whole stadium sang the chorus together, the collective effervescence gave her goosebumps.

hindi: सामूहिक शोक — पूरे समुदाय द्वारा साझा किया गया दुख
definition: a shared mourning felt across a community or nation after a public loss, when strangers weep together
example: The collective grief after the stadium tragedy filled the town square with flowers from people who had never met the victims.

hindi: सामूहिक ग्लानि — अपने समूह के कर्मों के लिए साझा अपराध-बोध
definition: a shared sense of blame and shame felt by members of a group for wrongs done by that group, even by those who took no part
example: The department carried a quiet collective guilt about how the intern had been treated.

hindi: सामूहिक आघात — पूरे समुदाय पर पड़ा गहरा मानसिक घाव
definition: the lasting shared shock and sorrow carried by a whole community after a disaster or atrocity that struck all of them at once
example: Years after the flood, the town's collective trauma still surfaced whenever the river rose.

hindi: सहकर्मी-भाव — सहयोगियों के बीच आदरपूर्ण मित्रता
definition: the warm, respectful fellow feeling among colleagues who treat each other as equals and share responsibility willingly
example: What she missed most after leaving the department was the collegiality of the Friday reviews.

hindi: पेट में घबराहट — चिंता से पेट का मरोड़ना
definition: a nervous, queasy churning in the stomach brought on by worry before something you are dreading
example: He had the collywobbles all morning before the driving test and could not face his toast.

hindi: लड़ाकू — बहस या टकराव के लिए तत्पर
definition: ready and eager to argue or fight, treating every disagreement as a battle to be won
example: The councillor was combative from the first question and interrupted every reply.

hindi: अवनति की निराशा — ऊँचाई से नीचे आने का दुखद अहसास
definition: a disappointing fall from a better position or from a high mood, felt as a humbling drop
example: Going back to the open-plan desk after a week presenting abroad was quite a comedown.

hindi: करनी का फल — घमंडी के गिरने पर संतोष
definition: the deserved downfall of someone arrogant or unkind, and the grim satisfaction others feel in watching it
example: Everyone in the office felt the bully finally got his comeuppance when the audit landed on his desk.

hindi: सुकून — कष्ट के बाद मिलने वाली राहत और शांति
definition: the warm ease and relief that soothes distress and lets a person feel safe and settled again
example: There was real comfort in hearing his sister's voice on the phone after the long day in hospital.

hindi: मन बहलाने के लिए खाना — दुख में भोजन से सुकून खोजना
definition: eating to soothe sadness or loneliness rather than hunger, reaching for food when a feeling is too heavy to hold
example: The week after the breakup was mostly comfort eating and old sitcoms.

hindi: सहज — बिना संकोच या तनाव के आराम में
definition: feeling relaxed and unselfconscious in a situation because nothing about it threatens or unsettles your confidence
example: By the second week he felt comfortable enough to crack jokes in the team meeting.

hindi: सांत्वनाहीन — जिसे कोई तसल्ली न मिले
definition: feeling sorrow with nothing to ease it, a bleak state in which no kind word brings relief
example: The hospital corridor at three in the morning felt comfortless, and no cup of tea helped.

hindi: उत्तेजना या भड़काना
definition: arousing or provoking laughter
example: An amusing film with a steady stream of pranks and pratfalls.

hindi: सहानुभूति या करुणा को महसूस या व्यक्त करना
definition: to feel or express sympathy or compassion

hindi: दूसरों के दुर्भाग्य के लिए सहानुभूति और दुःख की भावना
definition: a feeling of sympathy and sorrow for the misfortunes of others
example: The blind are too often objects of pity.

hindi: बंधन-भय — स्थायी संबंध से घबराना
definition: a fear of promising yourself to one person for the long term, which makes you pull away whenever a relationship deepens
example: His commitment phobia showed up right on schedule, six months in and just after she mentioned meeting her parents.

hindi: उत्तेजित होना, उत्साहित होना या उत्तेजित होना
definition: cause to be agitated, excited, or roused
example: The speaker charged up the crowd with his inflammatory remarks.

hindi: आत्मिक जुड़ाव — गहरे साझा भाव का अनुभव
definition: a deep sense of shared feeling and closeness with another person, or with nature, that goes beyond words
example: Sitting in silence on the pier at dawn, the two old friends felt a communion they had not known in years.

hindi: सामुदायिक एकात्मता — साझा अनुभव में पद भूलकर एक हो जाने का भाव
definition: the intense sense of equality and togetherness that people feel when a shared experience dissolves their usual ranks and roles
example: Stuck overnight in the snowed-in station, strangers slipped into a communitas that vanished with the first train.

hindi: साथ में सहज — जिसकी संगति में शांत अपनापन महसूस हो
definition: friendly and easy to be with, creating a relaxed sense of togetherness that needs no conversation
example: The two colleagues ate lunch in companionable silence, each reading their own book.

hindi: साथीहीन — किसी साथी के बिना अकेला
definition: feeling alone because you have nobody at your side to share ordinary moments with, especially after losing a partner
example: Companionless at the wedding reception, he kept refilling his glass so he would have something to do with his hands.

hindi: साथ का सुख — किसी के साथ होने से मिलने वाली सहज गर्माहट और राहत
definition: the comfortable warmth of having someone alongside you, valued for their presence rather than any romance
example: After his wife died the old man kept the radio on all day for the companionship of the voices.

hindi: किसी अन्य के लिए गहरी जागरूकता और सहानुभूति
definition: a deep awareness of and sympathy for another's suffering

hindi: करुणा-थकान — लगातार दूसरों की पीड़ा से भावनात्मक थकावट
definition: psychology's term for the emotional exhaustion of caring for suffering people until empathy runs dry
example: The social worker recognised compassion fatigue when the next case file left her feeling nothing.

hindi: पीड़ा को साझा करना
definition: share the suffering of

hindi: सहानुभूतिपूर्ण समझ की भावना
definition: a feeling of sympathetic understanding

hindi: आकर्षक — ध्यान खींचने और बनाए रखने की शक्ति वाला
definition: attracting and holding your interest powerfully, hard to ignore or turn away from
example: His account of the missing shipment was compelling enough to keep the whole meeting silent.

hindi: पर-सुख-आनंद — साथी की खुशी में खुश होना
definition: the warm gladness you feel when a partner or loved one finds pleasure elsewhere, the direct opposite of jealousy
example: He surprised himself with compersion when his wife came home glowing from her weekend with old friends.

hindi: प्रतिस्पर्धी — हर चीज़ में जीतने की तीव्र इच्छा
definition: driven by a strong wish to win or to do better than others, even in situations that are not really a contest
example: Neha was so competitive that a casual board game in the kitchen ended with her demanding a rematch.

hindi: जब आप अपने आप से संतुष्ट हो जाते हैं तो आपके पास महसूस हो रहा है
definition: the feeling you have when you are satisfied with yourself
example: His complacency was absolutely disgusting.

hindi: जब आप अपने आप से संतुष्ट हो जाते हैं तो आपके पास महसूस हो रहा है
definition: the feeling you have when you are satisfied with yourself
example: His complacency was absolutely disgusting.

hindi: अपने आप या किसी के कार्यों के साथ गलती से संतुष्ट
definition: contented to a fault with oneself or one's actions
example: He had become complacent after years of success.

hindi: शिकायती — हर चीज़ में दोष ढूंढ़कर असंतोष जताने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a person whose habit is to voice dissatisfaction about almost everything rather than enjoy or accept it
example: He earned a reputation as a complainer after sending back three dishes at the team lunch.

hindi: जटिल शोक — जो शोक समय के साथ भी हल्का न हो
definition: grief that stays intense for far longer than usual and blocks a person from returning to ordinary life
example: Two years after her husband died the counsellor gently named it complicated grief.

hindi: तारीफ़ — किसी की खूबी पर कही गई मीठी प्रशंसा
definition: a small, personal remark of admiration meant to please the person it is about, warmth offered in a sentence
example: The compliment about her handwriting on the whiteboard made her blush more than the bonus did.

hindi: धैर्य — दबाव में भी मन का शांत और संयत बने रहना
definition: the settled calmness that keeps a person steady and unshaken when a situation pushes them toward panic or anger
example: She answered every hostile question at the town hall meeting without once losing her composure.

hindi: बाध्यता — कुछ करने की ऐसी अनिवार्य इच्छा जिसे रोकना कठिन हो
definition: an irresistible need to do something, felt as pressure that only eases once the action is done
example: She felt a compulsion to check whether he had read her message, even during the film.

hindi: गहरी खेद की भावना (आमतौर पर कुछ गड़बड़ी के लिए)
definition: a feeling of deep regret (usually for some misdeed)

hindi: सहचरता — साझा काम या संघर्ष से बना अपनापन
definition: the warm bond of loyalty and trust between people who have faced hard work or hardship side by side
example: The comradeship of the launch week, with everyone sleeping under desks, outlasted the product itself.

hindi: अत्यधिक गौरव की भावना
definition: feelings of excessive pride

hindi: झूठी गौरव की विशेषता; आत्म-आयात की अतिरंजित भावना होना
definition: characteristic of false pride; having an exaggerated sense of self-importance
example: A conceited fool.

hindi: चिंता भरी परवाह — किसी की भलाई के लिए स्नेहपूर्ण फ़िक्र
definition: a caring worry about someone's wellbeing that comes from affection rather than fear for yourself
example: Her concern showed when she quietly slipped a packed lunch into her brother's bag before his interview.

hindi: अधिक अनुकूल होने का कारण बनता है; अच्छी इच्छा प्राप्त करें
definition: cause to be more favorably inclined; gain the good will of
example: She managed to mollify the angry customer.

hindi: जोरदार भावुक
definition: vigorously passionate

hindi: कृपालु तिरस्कार — ऊपर से नीचे देखने वाली दयालुता
definition: an attitude of patronising superiority in which someone treats you kindly while making clear they think you are beneath them
example: He explained the spreadsheet formula to her with such condescension that she reminded him she had built it.

hindi: शोक-संवेदना — शोक में सहानुभूति प्रकट करना
definition: sympathy expressed to someone grieving a death, a shared acknowledgement of their sorrow
example: The whole team signed the condolence card for their colleague after her father's funeral.

hindi: विश्वास या आश्वासन द्वारा चिह्नित या चिह्नित करना
definition: having or marked by confidence or assurance
example: A confident speaker.

hindi: विश्वास से खुलकर बताने वाला — निजी बातें साझा करने का स्वभाव
definition: willing to share private thoughts and worries with someone because you feel safe that they will keep them
example: On the late train home she grew confiding and told him about the job offer she had not mentioned to anyone else.

hindi: अंतर्द्वंद्व में — परस्पर विरोधी भावनाओं का एक साथ होना
definition: having contradictory feelings about something so that no choice feels fully right
example: She was conflicted about attending the reunion she had once sworn to skip.

hindi: अनुरूपता — समूह के साथ घुल-मिल जाने का दबाव और चाह
definition: the urge to match what everyone around you thinks, feels and does, driven by the discomfort of standing apart
example: Out of pure conformity he laughed at the joke a beat after everyone else did.

hindi: को भ्रमित या perplexing; स्पष्ट रूप से सोचने में असमर्थ होने का कारण
definition: be confusing or perplexing to; cause to be unable to think clearly
example: These questions confuse even the experts.

hindi: स्तब्ध और भ्रमित — अपेक्षा उलट जाने से हैरान
definition: surprised and confused because something has gone against every expectation you held
example: The confounded coach watched his weakest player score three goals in the final.

hindi: टकरावपूर्ण — सीधे भिड़ने और चुनौती देने को उत्सुक
definition: tending to challenge people directly and provoke arguments rather than smooth things over
example: Her confrontational reply in the group chat turned a small mix-up into a full-blown row.

hindi: भ्रम — स्पष्ट सोच का खो जाना
definition: a muddled mental state in which you cannot tell what is true, what to do, or what is going on
example: The sudden change of meeting rooms threw the whole team into confusion.

hindi: अनुकूल स्वभाव — मन और रुचि से मेल खाने वाला, सुखद संगत
definition: pleasantly suited to your own temperament and tastes, so that being together feels natural and warm
example: The book club turned out to be congenial company, the sort of people she would have chosen as friends anyway.

hindi: अभिनंदनपूर्ण — किसी की सफलता पर हर्ष और शुभकामना भरा
definition: expressing shared gladness and warm good wishes at someone else's success or good fortune
example: The group chat filled with congratulatory messages the second she posted her exam results.

hindi: जुड़ाव — दूसरों से भावनात्मक रूप से बंधे होने का भाव
definition: the warm feeling of being emotionally linked to other people and part of something larger than yourself
example: The weekly call with old university friends gave him a connectedness that the office never had.

hindi: धोखे से लूटा गया — चालाकी से ठगा हुआ
definition: tricked out of money or trust by someone who won your confidence first, leaving you angry at them and at yourself
example: He felt thoroughly conned when the charming stranger's investment tip turned out to be an empty website.

hindi: खराब स्वभाव का प्रदर्शन
definition: a display of bad temper
example: He had a fit.

hindi: अंतरात्मा से पीड़ित — दोष की गहरी कचोट में
definition: suddenly and sharply troubled by a sense of wrongdoing, as if your conscience had struck a blow
example: Conscience-stricken, he went back to the shop to pay for the pen he had pocketed.

hindi: विचारशील परवाह करने वाला — दूसरों की सुविधा और भावनाओं का ध्यान रखने वाला
definition: thoughtfully attentive to the needs and feelings of others, taking care not to cause them trouble
example: It was considerate of him to turn the music down when he saw his flatmate had an early shift.

hindi: जब आप निराशा के समय सांत्वना करते हैं तो आपको आराम महसूस होता है
definition: the comfort you feel when consoled in times of disappointment
example: Second place was no consolation to him.

hindi: सांत्वना देना — दुख में किसी को ढाढ़स बँधाना
definition: to ease someone's sorrow or disappointment by offering gentle comfort and company
example: The whole group chat tried to console her with voice notes after the interview went badly.

hindi: खतरे के बारे में जागरूकता से डरना
definition: fear resulting from the awareness of danger

hindi: ग्रस लेना — किसी भावना का मन पर पूरी तरह छा जाना
definition: of an emotion such as jealousy or guilt, to fill someone so completely that it crowds out every other thought
example: Envy of his brother's success consumed him until he could barely enjoy his own wins.

hindi: Disdain के साथ देखो
definition: look down on with disdain
example: He despises the people he has to work for.

hindi: चिंतनशील — गहरी शांत सोच में डूबा हुआ
definition: in a quiet thoughtful mood, turning ideas or memories over slowly in the mind
example: He grew contemplative on the late train, watching the lit windows slide past.

hindi: सम्मान की कमी के साथ तीव्र नापसंद की भावना
definition: lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
example: He was held in contempt.

hindi: तुच्छ और तिरस्कार योग्य — जिसका आदर करना असंभव हो
definition: deserving scorn because the conduct is petty, cowardly or dishonest rather than merely wrong
example: Blaming the intern for a mistake he had made himself was contemptible, and the team lost respect for him.

hindi: चरम अवमान व्यक्त करना
definition: expressing extreme contempt

hindi: संतुष्ट — जो है उसमें शांत सुख पाना
definition: quietly satisfied with what you have and where you are, wanting nothing more in the moment, a calm pleasure without excitement
example: Sitting on the step with tea while the dog explored the garden, she felt completely content.

hindi: जीवन में किसी की स्थिति के साथ खुशी
definition: happiness with one's situation in life

hindi: हठीली विरोधवृत्ति — हर बात का उलटा करने की ज़िद
definition: a perverse urge to oppose or disagree with whatever others want, driven by irritation rather than by any real objection
example: Out of pure contrariness he voted against the restaurant everyone else had chosen.

hindi: पाप या अपराधों के लिए दर्द या दुःख महसूस करना या व्यक्त करना
definition: feeling or expressing pain or sorrow for sins or offenses

hindi: पाप के लिए दुर्बलता
definition: sorrow for sin arising from fear of damnation

hindi: पाप के लिए दुर्बलता
definition: sorrow for sin arising from fear of damnation

hindi: नियंत्रण-प्रवृत्त — हर चीज़ अपने काबू में रखने की बेचैनी वाला
definition: a person with an anxious need to control every detail of situations and other people's behaviour
example: The control freak on the project rewrote everyone's slides the night before the pitch.

hindi: नियंत्रणकारी — दूसरों के फ़ैसलों पर हावी रहने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: trying to manage what someone else does, sees or chooses out of a fear of losing them or of being left out
example: Her friends gently pointed out that asking to read his messages every night was controlling rather than caring.

hindi: दृढ़ विश्वास — जिस पर पूरी तरह भरोसा हो
definition: a firmly held belief that gives your words and actions a steady confidence
example: She argued for the change with such conviction that even the sceptics nodded.

hindi: उल्लासपूर्ण मेलजोल — साथ में खाने-पीने का आनंद
definition: the cheerful, friendly enjoyment of good company, shared food and lively conversation, typically around a table
example: The conviviality of the office party made even the quiet accountant sing.

hindi: गुटरगूँ करना — प्यार और लाड़ भरे कोमल मधुर स्वर में बोलना
definition: to speak in a soft, gentle, murmuring voice full of affection or admiration, as people do over a baby
example: The whole family cooed over the puppy as it fell asleep in the shoebox.

hindi: ठंडे दिमाग वाला — घबराहट के बजाय शांत सोच
definition: staying calm and clear in a crisis so that thinking is not clouded by fear or excitement
example: The cool-headed passenger talked the panicking driver through pulling over safely.

hindi: शांत और unruffled आत्म आश्वासन
definition: calm and unruffled self-assurance
example: He performed with all the coolness of a veteran.

hindi: कैद-सा बंद — जगह की कमी में बेचैन और उकताया
definition: feeling restless and confined from being shut indoors or in a small space for too long
example: After four days cooped up with a cold, she was desperate for a walk to the shops.

hindi: सामना करना — तनाव और कठिनाई से निपटने के मानसिक उपाय
definition: the everyday effort of managing stress and painful feelings, whether through problem-solving, comfort, humour or distraction, well or badly
example: Late-night baking became her coping after the divorce, and the whole office got the results.

hindi: नखरीली — चंचल इशारों से ध्यान और प्रशंसा खींचने वाली
definition: playfully flirtatious in a teasing way, inviting attention while keeping the other person guessing
example: She gave him a coquettish glance across the bar and then went back to her friends as if nothing had happened.

hindi: घिसा-पिटा भावुक — पुरानी और सस्ती भावुकता वाला
definition: sentimental in a tired obvious way that feels embarrassing or old-fashioned yet still touches people
example: The corny slideshow of baby photos at the leaving party still made people tear up.

hindi: अतिशय लाड़ करना — किसी को स्नेह से हर कठिनाई से बचाकर रखना
definition: to care for someone with such protective tenderness that you shield them from every discomfort, hardship and difficulty
example: His aunt cosseted him through the whole flu, refilling his soup before the bowl was even empty.

hindi: आरामदेह — गर्माहट और अपनेपन भरा सुकून
definition: giving a snug feeling of warmth, safety and contentment in a small familiar setting
example: With the rain outside and soup on the stove the tiny kitchen felt wonderfully cosy.

hindi: साहस — डर के बावजूद सही काम करने की हिम्मत
definition: the strength of heart to face fear, danger or pain and act anyway rather than shrink back
example: It took real courage to tell the whole team that the mistake in the report had been hers.

hindi: लालसा करना — दूसरे की चीज़ पाने की तीव्र और बेचैन इच्छा रखना
definition: to want something that belongs to someone else so badly that the wanting eats at you
example: She coveted her colleague's corner desk with the window and found herself resenting his early arrivals.

hindi: चरम कपिडिटी दिखाना; दर्दनाक रूप से किसी अन्य के फायदे की इच्छा
definition: showing extreme cupidity; painfully desirous of another's advantages
example: He was never covetous before he met her.

hindi: कुछ पाने के लिए उत्सुकता
definition: an envious eagerness to possess something

hindi: कायर — डर के कारण कठिन या ख़तरनाक काम से भागने वाला
definition: a person who lacks the courage to face danger, pain or difficulty and shrinks from it out of fear
example: He felt like a coward for letting his colleague take the blame in the meeting.

hindi: कायरता — डर के कारण सही काम करने से बचना
definition: the failure to face danger or do the right thing because fear wins out over duty
example: He later admitted it was cowardice that stopped him speaking up when the manager blamed the junior.

hindi: दबा हुआ — धमकी या भय से झुका और चुप कराया गया
definition: frightened into submission and silence by threats, bullying or the power of another person
example: The cowed staff stopped raising problems after the third public dressing-down.

hindi: दुबकना — डर से सिकुड़कर झुक जाना
definition: to crouch down and shrink away in fear, making yourself small before something threatening
example: The dog cowered under the table every time the fireworks started.

hindi: सकुचाहट भरा — दिखावटी शर्म से रुचि छिपाते हुए भी दिखाना
definition: pretending to be bashful or modest about attraction while actually inviting more attention
example: She gave a coy smile when asked about the flowers on her desk and changed the subject.

hindi: आरामदायक — गर्म, सुरक्षित और सुकून भरा अहसास
definition: feeling warmly snug and sheltered, with a quiet contentment that comes from small comforts close at hand
example: With the rain hammering the window and soup on the stove, the tiny kitchen felt wonderfully cozy.

hindi: केकड़ा-मानसिकता — आगे बढ़ने वाले को खींचकर गिराना
definition: the resentful impulse to pull down anyone in your group who starts to succeed rather than let them rise
example: Crab mentality in the old office meant anyone who took an evening course got mocked for having ambition.

hindi: परेशान और चिड़चिड़ा
definition: annoyed and irritable

hindi: मौज-मस्ती — हंसी-ठिठोली और बातचीत से भरा सामूहिक आनंद
definition: lively good-humoured merriment and enjoyable conversation shared among a group, the pleasure of good company
example: The pub quiz team lost badly, but the craic on the walk home made the whole evening worth it.

hindi: झुंझलाया हुआ — थकान या भूख से चिड़चिड़ा
definition: irritable and easily annoyed, usually because of tiredness, hunger or a lack of sleep
example: The toddler was cranky after the long train ride and cried at everything.

hindi: एक craving, भूख या महान इच्छा के लिए है
definition: have a craving, appetite, or great desire for

hindi: कुछ विशेष चीज़ों के लिए एक गहन इच्छा
definition: an intense desire for some particular thing

hindi: सनक की लहर — किसी चीज़ के लिए भीड़ का क्षणिक उन्माद
definition: a sudden shared enthusiasm for one thing that sweeps through a crowd or a whole country and burns out almost as fast as it caught
example: The office went through a two-week craze for standing desks and then quietly sat back down.

hindi: भोलापन — बिना जाँचे हर बात मान लेने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: a readiness to believe claims without asking for proof, the mental habit that makes a person easy to fool
example: The group chat's credulity was astonishing as the same fake giveaway link got forwarded for the fourth time.

hindi: सिहरन — किसी अप्रिय व्यक्ति या जगह से होने वाली रेंगती घबराहट
definition: an uneasy, shivery feeling that something or someone nearby is unpleasant or threatening
example: The way the stranger kept staring across the carriage gave everyone the creeps.

hindi: डरावना — अजीब और बेचैन कर देने वाला भय
definition: causing an uneasy, shivery fear because something feels strange or unpleasantly wrong
example: The creepy account kept liking her photos from three years ago.

hindi: हतोत्साहित — अचानक निराश होकर झुका हुआ
definition: suddenly deflated and dejected after a hope has been dashed, the disappointment visible in a dropped face
example: He looked crestfallen when the interviewer said they had gone with another candidate.

hindi: सिकुड़ना — डर या शर्म से पीछे हटकर सिमट जाना
definition: to shrink back and tense up in fear or embarrassment, pulling away from something unpleasant
example: He cringed when his boss raised a hand, then realised it was only a wave.

hindi: शर्मनाक-सा — देखकर झेंप हो जाए
definition: so embarrassing to watch or remember that it makes you wince and shrink inward, even when the mistake was not your own
example: The boss's attempt at a rap on the team call was genuinely cringeworthy.

hindi: आत्मविश्वास का संकट — अपनी क्षमता पर अचानक संदेह
definition: a sudden collapse of belief in one's own abilities, usually after a failure, that makes even routine tasks feel beyond reach
example: One harsh code review sent him into a crisis of confidence and he spent the afternoon second-guessing a simple bug fix.

hindi: खफ़ा — साधारण नाराज़गी और चिड़चिड़ाहट
definition: annoyed and somewhat angry in an ordinary, everyday way, the mild irritation of a parent or teacher
example: Mum was cross that we had tracked mud through the hallway again.

hindi: एक चिड़चिड़ा महसूस
definition: an irritable petulant feeling

hindi: चिड़चिड़ा और सनकी — छोटी बातों पर झुंझलाने वाला
definition: irritable and full of odd, fussy complaints, an old-fashioned kind of peevishness
example: The crotchety landlord grumbled that the tenants had used the wrong colour of bin bags.

hindi: जीत पर इतराना — दूसरों की हार पर खुशी से शेखी बघारना
definition: to express loud, triumphant delight over a victory, especially in a way that rubs the loss in for the people who were beaten
example: He crowed about beating the sales target for a full week until even his own team stopped replying.

hindi: क्रूर — दूसरों को कष्ट देने में निर्दय
definition: willfully causing pain or suffering to others, or feeling no concern about doing so
example: It felt cruel to make the puppy wait outside in the rain while they finished lunch.

hindi: उदास-बेहाल — मन में निम्न और बुझा हुआ भाव
definition: feeling miserable and downcast in a dull, grubby manner, an American word for a mood that is unpleasant without being dramatic
example: He felt crummy all afternoon after the argument and skipped the team drinks.

hindi: क्षणिक आकर्षण — किसी के प्रति अचानक जागा, अक्सर एकतरफ़ा प्रेम-भाव
definition: a brief, intense romantic attraction toward someone, often secret and one-sided, that feels bigger than it is
example: Her crush on the guy from accounting lasted exactly until he microwaved fish in the shared kitchen.

hindi: टूटा हुआ — निराशा से पूरी तरह दबा हुआ
definition: completely flattened by disappointment or grief, so let down that all spirit is gone
example: He was crushed when the visa was refused after two years of waiting.

hindi: रूखा-सख़्त — बाहर से कठोर और चिड़चिड़ा पर भीतर नरम
definition: gruff and short-tempered on the surface, especially in an older person whose hard shell often hides a softer heart
example: The crusty caretaker grumbled about the noise but still fixed our heating at midnight.

hindi: रोना — दुख, दर्द या भावना के आवेग में आँसू बहाना
definition: to shed tears and make sounds of sorrow, pain or overwhelming feeling, the plainest outward sign that distress has broken through
example: She cried in the car park after the vet called with the results.

hindi: रोंदू — छोटी बात पर आंसू बहाने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a person who weeps or complains tearfully over small hurts and disappointments that others would shrug off
example: He hated feeling like a crybaby, but the harsh code review left him blinking back tears at his desk.

hindi: आलिंगन में लेना — स्नेह और सुकून के लिए किसी को पास लगाना
definition: to hold someone close in a warm, gentle embrace that gives both people comfort and affection
example: They cuddled on the sofa under one blanket while the rain hammered the kitchen window.

hindi: सांस्कृतिक आघात — नई जगह के अपरिचित रीति-रिवाज़ों से घबराहट
definition: the disoriented, anxious feeling of arriving somewhere whose customs, food and manners are unfamiliar, before one learns to read them
example: The first week in Tokyo was pure culture shock, and she stood frozen at the ticket machine while commuters flowed around her.

hindi: जिज्ञासा — जानने और समझने की तीव्र इच्छा
definition: an eager desire to know or learn something, the itch to find out what lies behind a question
example: Curiosity got the better of him and he opened the unmarked package on the kitchen table.

hindi: खड़ूस — चिड़चिड़ा बूढ़ा व्यक्ति
definition: a bad-tempered, surly person who grumbles about everything and treats everyone with sour suspicion
example: The office curmudgeon muttered about the new coffee machine for the whole of Monday.

hindi: खड़ूस चिड़चिड़ापन — बुढ़ापे की कड़वी झुंझलाहट
definition: grumpy and mean-spirited in a crusty way, usually of an older person who dislikes most things
example: His curmudgeonly uncle refused to come to the party because there would be music.

hindi: आघात कम करना — दुखद खबर की चोट को नरम बनाना
definition: to soften the emotional blow of bad news or failure so the hurt lands more gently than it otherwise would
example: She praised his effort first, hoping to cushion the news that his proposal had been rejected.

hindi: सुरक्षित सुख — कठिनाई से बचाया हुआ आराम
definition: protected from hardship, shock or worry by comfort and support so that life feels soft and safe
example: Growing up cushioned by a steady family, she had never known what an unpaid bill felt like.

hindi: अड़ियल और खफ़ा — जानबूझकर उलटा चलने वाला
definition: stubbornly awkward and uncooperative out of ill temper, refusing to go along with things simply to be difficult
example: Too cussed to admit the shortcut was wrong, he drove them twenty minutes out of the way.

hindi: बहुत आहत — दुख से टूटा हुआ
definition: deeply upset and hurt after a loss or grim news, a British phrase for grief or distress that shows you are struggling
example: He was really cut up when his dog died and took the week off work.

hindi: मर्मभेदी — भावनाओं को चीर देने वाली कठोर टिप्पणी
definition: hurtful with a cold precision, a remark aimed to slice through someone's feelings rather than simply disagree
example: One cutting comment about her accent and she stopped speaking up in meetings for weeks.

hindi: सुरक्षित आलिंगन — गले लगाकर सुरक्षा और अपनापन देने वाली गर्माहट
definition: a warm sheltering cuddle that makes you feel safe and cared for, more comfort than embrace
example: After the exam results came in, all she wanted was a cwtch from her mum and a cup of tea.

hindi: चक्रीय मनोदशा विकार — हल्के उल्लास और उदासी के बीच झूलना
definition: in psychology, a lasting pattern of mood swinging between mild elation and mild depression, less severe than bipolar disorder
example: Her doctor suggested cyclothymia when the highs and lows kept cycling for years.

hindi: निंदक-सन्देही — हर अच्छाई के पीछे स्वार्थ देखने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a person who believes people act only from selfish motives and greets any show of goodness with distrustful scorn
example: The cynic in the meeting assumed the charity partnership was just a marketing stunt.

hindi: अविश्वास की एक सनकी भावना
definition: a cynical feeling of distrust

hindi: उत्साह घटाना — जोश या उमंग को कम और ठंडा कर देना
definition: to make enthusiasm or high spirits less lively and intense, taking the sparkle out of a cheerful mood without killing it
example: The forecast of rain dampened everyone's excitement about the office picnic.

hindi: दुस्साहसी — खतरे को न्योता देने वाला साहस
definition: adventurous and willing to take exciting risks that could easily go wrong
example: The daring pitch proposed replacing the whole product with something built in a weekend.

hindi: साहस खोना
definition: cause to lose courage
example: Dashed by the refusal.

hindi: डर या डरावना
definition: invulnerable to fear or intimidation
example: Audacious explorers.

hindi: दिवास्वप्न देखना — जागते हुए सुखद कल्पनाओं में खो जाना
definition: to drift into pleasant imaginings about hoped-for things while awake, losing track of the present
example: She began to daydream about the beach house halfway through the quarterly numbers.

hindi: जब आप गलती से कुछ बुरा होता है, तो संकट और असंतुष्टता की भावना
definition: the feeling of distress and disbelief that you have when something bad happens accidentally
example: His mother's death left him in a daze.

hindi: स्तब्ध — झटके से चेतना धुंधली
definition: unable to think clearly or react, as if lost in a haze, after a shock or sudden blow
example: He walked dazed out of the exam hall, unsure whether he had answered anything at all.

hindi: चकाचौंध करना — चमक या प्रतिभा से अभिभूत करना
definition: to impress and amaze someone with such brilliance or beauty that their judgement is briefly overwhelmed
