example: The new hire managed to dazzle the panel with a demo built the night before.

hindi: चकाचौंध — चमक या प्रतिभा से अभिभूत
definition: so impressed and overwhelmed by brilliance or splendour that you cannot judge it clearly or critically
example: The dazzled interns hung on every word of the founder's keynote.

hindi: तनाव उतारना — चिंता और दबाव घटाकर शांत होना
definition: to reduce or relieve the tension and worry you have built up so that you feel calm again
example: She runs along the river after work to de-stress before dinner.

hindi: भावशून्य आँखों वाला — नज़र में कोई जीवन या भाव न होना
definition: having eyes that show no feeling or interest, giving an impression of inner emptiness
example: The dead-eyed cashier scanned the items without once looking up or answering her greeting.

hindi: भावना कुंद करना — अनुभूति को मंद या निष्क्रिय कर देना
definition: to dull or weaken feeling until emotions that once responded sharply barely register anymore
example: Years of working the night shift had started to deaden his interest in almost everything.

hindi: जानबूझकर असंभव तरीके से
definition: deliberately impassive in manner
example: Deadpan humor.

hindi: अधोगति — अपने मूल्य के घटने की ग्लानि
definition: the shame of feeling your worth lowered, as if something fine in you had been cheapened by what you did or allowed
example: Laughing along with the cruel jokes about a colleague left her with a lingering sense of debasement.

hindi: छला गया — जानबूझकर झूठ से गुमराह किया गया
definition: hurt at discovering someone deliberately made you believe a falsehood, and now unsure what else was untrue
example: He felt deceived when he learned the apartment he had been shown was not the one on the lease.

hindi: निर्णय थकान — बहुत सारे फैसलों के बाद मन का चुकना
definition: the worn-down state after making too many choices in a row, when even picking dinner feels like a burden and judgement slips
example: By evening decision fatigue had set in and she just ordered the same pizza rather than face the takeaway app again.

hindi: मानसिक संतुलन का टूटना — सहने की क्षमता का ढह जाना
definition: the clinical collapse of someone's ability to cope, when the defences that kept distress in check give way under strain
example: The ward doctor worried about decompensation when the exams, the breakup and the eviction landed in the same fortnight.

hindi: दबाव उतारना — तनाव के बाद मन को हल्का करना
definition: to release the pressure of a stressful stretch by taking quiet time until the mind returns to calm
example: After the product launch, the whole team took Friday off just to decompress.

hindi: पराजित — हार मानकर हताश और थका हुआ
definition: feeling beaten and hopeless after trying repeatedly and failing, with no fight left to try again
example: After the third rejected application he closed the laptop with a defeated shrug.

hindi: हार की अपरिहार्यता की स्वीकृति
definition: acceptance of the inevitability of defeat

hindi: असुरक्षित निरीहता — बचाव का कोई साधन न होना
definition: without any means of protecting yourself, exposed to harm and unable to fight back
example: The sudden public criticism left her feeling defenceless in front of the whole online community.

hindi: रक्षात्मक — आलोचना पर तुरंत बचाव
definition: quick to protect yourself against criticism, often with anger, excuses or counterattack
example: He got defensive the moment anyone mentioned the missed deadline.

hindi: आदर — बड़ों की राय के आगे झुकने की भावना
definition: a respectful willingness to yield to someone's judgement because of their age, rank or knowledge
example: Out of deference to the senior nurse, the intern waited before offering his own diagnosis.

hindi: विद्रोही — खुलकर अवज्ञा करने वाला
definition: boldly refusing to obey or back down, often with open challenge
example: The defiant tenant taped the eviction notice to the door with a note saying he was staying.

hindi: निराशा — उत्साह या गर्व को अचानक ठंडा कर देना
definition: to make someone suddenly lose their excitement or confidence, as if the pride had been let out of them
example: His big announcement was deflated by the flat silence around the dinner table.

hindi: निराश और ढीला — उत्साह अचानक निकल जाने से खाली महसूस करना
definition: suddenly drained of confidence and excitement, as though the energy has been let out of you
example: The team felt deflated when the launch was pushed back yet another month.

hindi: तनाव घटाना — भड़कने से पहले क्रोध या टकराव को ठंडा करना
definition: to lower the heat of a tense or angry situation before it explodes, draining the hostility out of a confrontation
example: A well-timed joke from the manager defused the argument brewing between the two designers.

hindi: अवमानना-बोध — अपनी गरिमा छिनने की पीड़ा
definition: the painful feeling of being stripped of dignity and treated as something lower than a person deserves
example: Being made to apologise in front of the whole open-plan office left him with a sense of degradation that lasted for weeks.

hindi: अपमानित करना — किसी की गरिमा छीनकर नीचा दिखाना
definition: to treat someone in a way that strips away their dignity and self-respect, leaving them humiliated and small
example: Being made to read his mistakes aloud in the meeting degraded him in front of the whole team.

hindi: व्यक्तित्व-विलोप — भीड़ में खुद को खोकर संकोच त्याग देना
definition: the loss of your sense of being an individual within a crowd, which loosens restraint and lets people act as they never would alone
example: Behind an anonymous username, deindividuation turned a polite accountant into the forum's cruellest commenter.

hindi: किसी की आत्माओं को कम करना; दिल को कम करना
definition: lower someone's spirits; make downhearted
example: These news depressed her.

hindi: कम आत्माओं की भावना
definition: a feeling of low spirits
example: He felt responsible for her lowness of spirits.

hindi: विलंबित तृप्ति — बड़े सुख के लिए छोटा सुख टालना
definition: the deeper satisfaction of waiting for a bigger reward instead of grabbing the pleasure available now, self-control that pays off later
example: Saving the last episode for Friday night was her small act of delayed gratification.

hindi: अत्यधिक खुशी या संतुष्टि की भावना
definition: a feeling of extreme pleasure or satisfaction
example: His delight to see her was obvious to all.

hindi: अत्यधिक खुशी या संतुष्टि की भावना
definition: a feeling of extreme pleasure or satisfaction
example: His delight to see her was obvious to all.

hindi: उन्मत्त हर्ष — खुशी से बेसुध और बेकाबू
definition: wildly and almost incoherently excited, with happiness so overwhelming that you lose your usual composure and sense
example: The interns were delirious when the client renewed the contract on the spot.

hindi: उद्धार — संकट से छूटने की गहरी राहत
definition: the profound relief of being rescued from danger, misery or a long exhausting ordeal
example: The email confirming the visa felt like deliverance after a year of uncertainty.

hindi: अपमानित करना — किसी की गरिमा घटाकर तुच्छ बनाना
definition: to lower someone's dignity by treating them with contempt, making them feel small and unworthy of respect
example: The coach demeaned the goalkeeper in front of the whole squad, and two players walked out of training.

hindi: अपमानित — गरिमा घटाई गई
definition: stripped of dignity and made to feel lowered in worth by how you have been treated
example: She felt demeaned being asked to fetch coffee during her own presentation.

hindi: राक्षस ठहराना — किसी को पूरी तरह बुरा बताकर घृणा फैलाना
definition: to portray a person or group as thoroughly evil so that others come to fear and hate them without question
example: The neighbourhood forum quickly demonized the new landlord before anyone had even met him.

hindi: हतोत्साहित करना — आत्मविश्वास और उत्साह तोड़ देना
definition: to destroy someone's confidence and spirit, leaving them discouraged and unwilling to keep trying
example: The constant last-minute changes demoralized the whole design team.

hindi: हतोत्साहित — आत्मविश्वास और हौसला खो चुका
definition: having lost confidence and hope after setbacks or criticism, with little will to continue
example: The team was demoralized after the client rejected the design for the fourth time.

hindi: हतोत्साहित — जिसकी काम करने की इच्छा छीन ली गई हो
definition: having lost the drive and enthusiasm you once had for something, usually because setbacks or poor treatment drained it away
example: The team was demotivated after their proposal was ignored for the third time in a row.

hindi: इनकार — कष्टदायक सच्चाई को मानने से मन का मुकर जाना

definition: so surprised or overwhelmed by something that you feel knocked flat and unable to respond
example: I was floored when the quiet guy from accounts turned out to be a former national chess champion.

hindi: तल्लीनता — काम में इतना डूब जाना कि समय का पता न चले
definition: the absorbing, pleasurable state of being so fully involved in an activity that time and self-consciousness disappear
example: He hit a state of flow debugging the parser and looked up to find the office empty.

hindi: प्रवाह अवस्था — काम में इतना डूब जाना कि समय का पता न चले
definition: the absorbed, energised state of being so lost in a challenging task that time and self-consciousness vanish
example: He hit a flow state fixing the bug and looked up to find the office dark and his tea stone cold.

hindi: एक रहस्य या bewildering
definition: be a mystery or bewildering to
example: This beats me!

hindi: हक्का-बक्का — उलझन से बेबस
definition: thoroughly confused and stuck, unable to work out what to answer or which move comes next
example: The flummoxed teacher stared at the projector remote with twenty buttons and no labels.

hindi: हड़बड़ाया — जल्दबाजी में घबराया और अस्त-व्यस्त
definition: agitated and confused by hurry, rushing about in a nervous, disordered state
example: Flurried by the surprise inspection, the manager knocked a tray of cups off the counter.

hindi: तमतमाना — भावना के उभार से चेहरा गरम और लाल होना
definition: to go suddenly hot and crimson in the face from a rush of embarrassment, anger or excitement
example: He flushed to the ears when the teacher read his private note aloud to the class.

hindi: घबरा देना — हड़बड़ी और बेचैनी में डालना
definition: to make someone nervously agitated and confused so they lose their composure
example: The unexpected question flustered him and he forgot his own phone number.

hindi: हड़बड़ाया हुआ — अचानक घबराहट में सोच-समझ खो बैठा
definition: suddenly confused and nervous under pressure, losing track of what you were doing or saying
example: She got flustered when the boss joined the video call and forgot which document she was sharing.

hindi: फड़फड़ाहट — उत्साह या घबराहट की हल्की थरथराहट
definition: a brief trembling stir of excitement or nervousness felt in the chest or stomach
example: She felt a flutter when his name appeared in her inbox.

hindi: नाकाम — किसी की योजना का दूसरों द्वारा विफल कर दिया जाना
definition: frustrated because a plan or scheme you were counting on was defeated, often just before it could succeed
example: Foiled by the office printer running out of toner, she handed in her report a day late.

hindi: गर्मी या स्नेह को प्रदर्शित या प्रदर्शित करना
definition: having or displaying warmth or affection
example: Affectionate children.

hindi: कुछ की तरह एक predisposition
definition: a predisposition to like something
example: He had a fondness for whiskey.

hindi: मूर्खता का बोध — अपनी नासमझी पर शर्म आना
definition: feeling silly and embarrassed after realising you acted without sense or fell for something obvious
example: She felt foolish for waiting an hour at the wrong cafe before checking the message again.

hindi: बंधनमुक्त — बिना जिम्मेदारी की आज़ादी
definition: free from ties, duties or responsibilities and able to travel wherever you please, carefree and unattached
example: Footloose after graduating, she spent the summer hopping between friends' sofas.

hindi: सहनशील — उकसावे पर भी धैर्यवान
definition: patient and restrained in the face of provocation, choosing not to react even when one has every right to
example: She remained forbearing through her brother's third rant about the same parking ticket.

hindi: भयावह गंभीरता — जिसका रूखा रूप पास आने से रोके
definition: having a stern, unfriendly appearance that warns people off and discourages any approach
example: The bouncer's forbidding stare made the group check their tickets twice before walking up.

hindi: इसके बारे में भविष्यवाणी करें; अग्रिम में बताएं
definition: make a prediction about; tell in advance
example: Call the outcome of an election.

hindi: आने के लिए बुराई की भावना
definition: a feeling of evil to come
example: A steadily escalating sense of foreboding.

hindi: दयालु भावना जो क्षमा करने की इच्छा का समर्थन करती है
definition: compassionate feelings that support a willingness to forgive

hindi: बेसहारा उदास — अकेला, त्यागा हुआ और आशाहीन
definition: sorrowful and lonely in a way that feels abandoned and hopeless, with nobody coming to help
example: He sat forlorn on the station bench after the last friend from the reunion had caught a train home.

hindi: उदासी जिसके परिणामस्वरूप फोर्केन या छोड़ दिया गया
definition: sadness resulting from being forsaken or abandoned

hindi: किसी को छोड़ दें जो आपको चाहिए या गिनें; लूर्च में छोड़ दें
definition: leave someone who needs or counts on you; leave in the lurch
example: The mother deserted her children.

hindi: त्यागा हुआ — हर किसी द्वारा छोड़ दिया गया
definition: utterly deserted and left without help, with a sense of being given up on by everyone who mattered
example: Waiting alone at the closed station after the last bus left, he felt forsaken by the whole city.

hindi: मज़बूत करना — हिम्मत और सहनशक्ति देना
definition: to strengthen someone's courage and resolve so they can face a hard moment without crumbling
example: She fortified herself with a strong coffee and a pep talk before opening the exam results.

hindi: दुर्गंधपूर्ण और घृणित — गंध या व्यवहार में गंदा
definition: disgustingly dirty or smelly, and by extension offensive in language or conduct, the word carrying a sense of rot
example: The bins had not been emptied for a week and the stairwell smelled foul enough that tenants held their breath.

hindi: उलझन में पड़ा — हैरान-परेशान
definition: baffled and puzzled by something you cannot work out, a British word for confusion that leaves you stumped
example: He was completely foxed by the new expenses system and asked for help twice.

hindi: झगड़ालू चिड़चिड़ापन — बेचैन और उपद्रवी
definition: irritable and quarrelsome, restless and hard to control, like tired children or a divided crowd
example: The fractious passengers began arguing with the crew after the third delay announcement.

hindi: भावुक नाज़ुकता — ज़रा-सी ठेस से टूट जाने वाली स्थिति
definition: emotionally delicate and easily shattered after a loss, so that a small remark can bring tears or panic
example: He was fragile for weeks after the breakup, and the team quietly stopped teasing him.

hindi: बदहवास — डर या चिंता में बेकाबू और हड़बड़ाया हुआ
definition: wildly agitated by fear or worry, rushing about in a desperate and uncontrolled way
example: He made frantic calls to every hospital in the city when his brother did not come home.

hindi: भ्रातृवत — भाइयों जैसा स्नेह और एकता
definition: marked by the warm loyalty and affection of brothers, a feeling of kinship among equals
example: The two rival shopkeepers greeted each other with fraternal hugs at the street festival.

hindi: भाईचारा — साझा पहचान से उपजी बंधुत्व की भावना
definition: the brotherly warmth and loyalty felt among people who share a trade, a cause or a common experience, as if they were family
example: Among the volunteer firefighters there was a fraternity that outlasted every argument about the rota.

hindi: तनावपूर्ण — चिंता और दबाव से भरा हुआ
definition: filled with worry and strain, so that every part of a situation or person feels tense and close to breaking
example: The fraught phone call with her sister ended with both of them apologising and neither of them calm.

hindi: घिसा-टूटा — तनाव से धीरज की डोर कमज़ोर पड़ी
definition: having patience or nerves worn thin by ongoing strain, so that small irritations threaten to snap them
example: Tempers were frayed by the third hour of the delayed train.

hindi: थककर बदहवास — तनाव और भागदौड़ से मानसिक रूप से चूर
definition: worn out and scattered by too much stress and worry, unable to hold a thought together
example: By the end of the school run she was frazzled, with one child's lunch still sitting on the counter.

hindi: घबराकर बेकाबू होना — भय या उत्तेजना से विचलित होना
definition: to lose your composure in sudden panic, fear or wild excitement, reacting much more strongly than the moment needs
example: She started to freak out when the lift stopped between floors.

hindi: निराधार चिंता — बिना किसी निश्चित कारण के बनी रहने वाली बेचैनी
definition: a general, persistent feeling of worry that attaches to no particular cause and drifts from one concern to the next
example: She woke with a free-floating anxiety that latched onto the dishes, then the emails, then nothing at all.

hindi: बेरोकटोक — नियमों की चिंता बिना खुला और सहज
definition: relaxed and unconstrained by rules or plans, happily going where the moment takes you
example: The freewheeling road trip had no itinerary, only a car full of snacks.

hindi: उन्मत्त बेचैनी — तेज़ और अव्यवस्थित उत्तेजना
definition: frantic and feverishly busy, with excited activity that feels chaotic and hard to control
example: The newsroom was frenetic in the hour before the election results dropped.

hindi: उन्मत्त — बेकाबू उत्तेजना और हड़बड़ी में
definition: driven by wild, uncontrolled excitement or panic that makes actions hurried and chaotic
example: The frenzied last hour before the store closed left the staff breathless.

hindi: उन्माद — भय या उत्तेजना से भड़की हुई बेकाबू हलचल
definition: a burst of wild, uncontrolled activity driven by fear or intense excitement
example: The fire alarm set off a frenzy of people grabbing laptops and running for the stairs.

hindi: कुढ़ना — छोटी-छोटी चिंताओं में मन को घुलाते रहना
definition: to worry restlessly over small things, picking at them again and again without finding relief
example: He sat in the kitchen and fretted over whether the invoice had gone to the wrong client.

hindi: तंत्रिका और आराम करने में असमर्थ
definition: nervous and unable to relax
example: A constant fretful stamping of hooves.

hindi: एक चिड़चिड़ा महसूस
definition: an irritable petulant feeling

hindi: मानसिक रूप से जला हुआ — दिमाग थककर काम करना बंद कर दे
definition: informally mentally exhausted from too much concentration or stress, so drained that your brain refuses to work
example: After six hours of back-to-back video calls his brain was fried and he could not remember his own password.

hindi: मित्रहीन — जिसका कोई दोस्त न हो, उसकी उदासी
definition: sorrowful and unsupported because you have no friends at all to turn to, a more total condition than being lonely
example: After moving cities twice in a year she felt friendless, with nobody to call when the boiler broke.

hindi: किसी अन्य व्यक्ति के लिए झूठ बोलने की भावना; उनकी कंपनी में आनंद
definition: a feeling of liking for another person; enjoyment in their company

hindi: मैत्रीपूर्ण — सहज स्नेह और अपनापन
definition: kind, pleasant and welcoming towards others as if they were already your friends
example: The friendly barista remembered her order and asked how the job interview went.

hindi: कुछ विशिष्ट दर्द या खतरे की प्रत्याशा में अनुभव होने वाली भावना (आमतौर पर फी या लड़ाई की इच्छा के साथ)
definition: an emotion experienced in anticipation of some specific pain or danger (usually accompanied by a desire to flee or fight)

hindi: भयभीत
definition: cause fear in
example: The stranger who hangs around the building frightens me.

hindi: भयभीत
definition: cause fear in
example: The stranger who hangs around the building frightens me.

hindi: भयावह — डराने वाला और बहुत बुरा
definition: causing fear or shock because it seems dreadful, alarming and deeply unpleasant to face
example: The frightful banging from the boiler room had everyone edging toward the exit.

hindi: भावशून्य-शीत — प्रेम या इच्छा के प्रति ठंडा और अनुत्तरदायी
definition: cold and unresponsive to affection or sexual desire, showing none of the warmth others expect
example: The frigid reply to his flirtatious message told him the relationship was going nowhere.

hindi: चंचल उल्लास — खेलने को उत्सुक और ऊर्जावान
definition: playful and full of restless, bouncing energy, eager to race about or tease, like a young animal released into a field
example: The puppy was frisky after the rain stopped and dragged everyone toward the park.

hindi: डर की लगभग सुखद सनसनी
definition: an almost pleasurable sensation of fright
example: A frisson of surprise shot through him.

hindi: जानबूझी शीतलता — नापसंदगी जताने के लिए ओढ़ी गई रूखी दूरी
definition: a deliberate coolness and reserve of manner toward someone, disapproval shown by withheld warmth
example: After the argument about the shared fridge, a froideur settled over the flat that lasted a full week.

hindi: किलोल करना — खुशी से उछलना-कूदना
definition: to play about in a lively, carefree and happy way, moving with light, skipping energy and no purpose beyond enjoyment
example: The kids frolicked in the sprinkler while the barbecue smoked away.

hindi: रूखा-ठंडा — नाराज़गी से भरी बर्फीली दूरी
definition: coldly unfriendly in manner because of unspoken resentment or disapproval toward the other person
example: The reception from her in-laws was frosty after she had missed the anniversary lunch.

hindi: भौंहें सिकोड़ना — नाराज़गी, चिंता या उलझन का भाव
definition: to draw the eyebrows together in a look of displeasure, worry or puzzled concentration
example: He frowned at the bank statement and began adding the numbers up again.

hindi: अवरोधन या रोकथाम (प्रयास, योजना, या इच्छाओं)
definition: hinder or prevent (the efforts, plans, or desires) of
example: What ultimately frustrated every challenger was Ruth's amazing September surge.

hindi: वह भावना जो आपके लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने में विफल होने के अनुभव के साथ
definition: the feeling that accompanies an experience of being thwarted in attaining your goals

hindi: कुंठा-सहनशीलता — बाधा या असफलता पर बिना भड़के टिके रहना
definition: the psychological capacity to stay calm and keep working when things go wrong, instead of erupting in anger or giving up at the first obstacle
example: Debugging the same crash for three days tested his frustration tolerance, but he never raised his voice at anyone.

hindi: पुराने ख़यालात का बुज़ुर्ग-मिज़ाज — नयेपन से चिढ़ने वाला रूढ़िवादी व्यक्ति
definition: an old-fashioned, fussy person who disapproves of modern habits and cheerfully dismisses anything trendy
example: Grandpa admitted he was a fuddy-duddy about phones at the dinner table, but he still insisted on the rule.

hindi: अपनी इच्छाओं को प्राप्त करने के लिए संतुष्टि की भावना
definition: a feeling of satisfaction at having achieved your desires

hindi: अपनी इच्छाओं को प्राप्त करने के लिए संतुष्टि की भावना
definition: a feeling of satisfaction at having achieved your desires

hindi: भुनभुनाना — भीतर ही भीतर गुस्से से खौलना
definition: to be silently furious, showing the anger only through a tense face and muttered complaints
example: He fumed at his desk after reading the reply-all email.

hindi: मज़ा — हल्का, खिलखिलाता आनंद
definition: light, carefree amusement and enjoyment that lifts the mood, playful pleasure taken in an activity for its own sake
example: The team-building afternoon turned out to be actual fun once the karaoke machine appeared.

hindi: मौज-मस्ती पसंद — हंसी-खेल में रमने वाला स्वभाव
definition: having a playful, lighthearted temperament that seeks out amusement and enjoyment and brightens whenever a good time is on offer
example: Their fun-loving flatmate had turned Tuesday nights into a standing board-game tournament.

hindi: सुस्त उदासी — निराश और निष्क्रिय मनोदशा
definition: a slump of gloomy, low-energy dejection in which a person cannot be bothered to do anything
example: He was in a funk for weeks after the project was cancelled and barely left the sofa.

hindi: अत्यंत क्रुद्ध — तीव्र और अनियंत्रित क्रोध से भरा
definition: filled with fierce, intense anger that wants to break out into action or shouting
example: He was furious that the landlord had let himself into the flat without warning.

hindi: हंगामा — किसी बात पर भड़का सामूहिक आक्रोश या उत्तेजना
definition: an outburst of excited or angry public feeling and uproar over something, quick to flare and quick to fade
example: The furore over the new logo filled the company chat for two days and was forgotten by Friday.

hindi: तीव्र क्रोध की भावना
definition: a feeling of intense anger
example: Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned.

hindi: बेवजह परेशान होना — छोटी बातों पर घबराकर हड़बड़ाना
definition: to show anxious agitation over small matters, unable to settle until everything is right
example: She fussed over the table settings for an hour before the guests arrived.

hindi: एक चिड़चिड़ा महसूस
definition: an irritable petulant feeling

hindi: नुक़्ताचीनी करने वाला — छोटी-छोटी बातों पर बेचैन और चिंतित व्यक्ति
definition: a British informal name for a person who gets anxious and agitated over small details and unimportant matters
example: Her dad was a fusspot about the picnic blanket lying perfectly straight on the grass.

hindi: परेशान और चिड़चिड़ा
definition: annoyed and irritable

hindi: व्यर्थता — प्रयास बेकार लगने की निराशा
definition: the dispiriting sense that effort is pointless and nothing done will make any difference
example: A feeling of futility crept in as he rewrote the proposal for the fourth time.

hindi: दीवाना — किसी के लिए हद से ज़्यादा उत्साहित और मोहित
definition: foolishly enthusiastic and infatuated with someone, so keen that others find it a little silly
example: The whole marketing team went gaga over the new intern's dog when it visited the office.

hindi: समलैंगिक भावना
definition: a gay feeling

hindi: कचोटना — कड़वी खीझ पैदा करना
definition: to irritate someone deeply and bitterly, especially by something that feels unjust and cannot be changed
example: It galled him that the colleague who did the least work had been promoted first.

hindi: खीझ भरा — जो कड़वी झुंझलाहट पैदा करे
definition: causing bitter annoyance and humiliation, especially when the unfairness of a situation stings
example: It was galling to watch the intern present the slides she had built over the weekend.

hindi: काला हास्य — भयावह स्थिति में डर छिपाने वाला मज़ाक
definition: grim joking in the face of death or disaster, a way of managing fear and dread by laughing at what cannot be escaped
example: The night shift traded gallows humour over the coffee machine as the third ambulance of the hour pulled in.

hindi: उछलना-कूदना — हर्ष में मेमने की तरह कुलाँचें भरना
definition: to run and jump about playfully like a lamb, skipping with light, joyful energy
example: The toddler gambolled across the lawn the moment she was let out of the pushchair.

hindi: मुँह खोले ताकना — आश्चर्य में स्तब्ध होकर देखना
definition: to stare with the mouth hanging open in amazement, shock or wonder at something unexpected
example: The tourists gaped at the size of the bill for two coffees and a croissant.

hindi: किसी को अपनी ही याद और समझ पर शक कराना — मानसिक छल
definition: to make someone doubt their own memory or sanity by repeatedly denying things that really happened
example: He tried to gaslight her about the missed dinner, insisting she had never mentioned it despite the message on her phone.

hindi: साँस खींचकर चौंकना — आश्चर्य या भय में हाँफना
definition: to draw in a sudden sharp breath through the open mouth from shock, surprise or fright
example: The whole carriage gasped when the toddler nearly toppled off the seat.

hindi: अति-उत्साहित — खुशी से फूला हुआ
definition: extremely excited and pleased, often after victory or praise, a British slang word for feeling thrilled almost to bursting
example: He was gassed when his sketch got picked for the school show.

hindi: मुँह खोले घूरना — अचरज या जिज्ञासा से ताकते रहना
definition: to stare openly and clumsily at something out of curiosity or wonder, mouth half open and without any tact
example: Tourists stopped to gawk at the film crew blocking the pavement outside the cafe.

hindi: उदारता — खुले दिल से देने की भावना
definition: the readiness to give more than is expected, whether money, time or praise, without keeping account
example: Her generosity with credit meant the whole team was named in the launch announcement.

hindi: उदार — दिल खोलकर देने वाला
definition: willing to give more of your time, money or praise than is expected or required
example: He was generous with his notes and shared them with anyone who had missed the lecture.

hindi: गर्मजोशी और मित्रता
definition: diffusing warmth and friendliness
example: An affable smile.

hindi: अधिक अनुकूल होने का कारण बनता है; अच्छी इच्छा प्राप्त करें
definition: cause to be more favorably inclined; gain the good will of
example: She managed to mollify the angry customer.

hindi: कर्मठता — बिना टाले उठकर काम शुरू करने की ऊर्जा
definition: cheerful practical energy and initiative that gets you started on things without waiting to be pushed or persuaded

hindi: घर लौटने के लिए लंबे समय तक

hindi: घर लौटने के लिए एक लंबे समय तक

hindi: की विशेषता या सक्षम करने के लिए या करने के लिए प्रवृत्ति की हत्या की ओर एक अन्य इंसान

hindi: मधुर-चापलूसी — मीठी बातों से लुभाने वाली

hindi: सम्मान-बोध — अपने अच्छे नाम की रक्षा करने की भावना

example: She refused the shortcut on the report because her honour mattered more to her than an easy deadline.

hindi: सम्मानित अनुभव — आदर मिलने का गर्वयुक्त सुख

example: He felt genuinely honoured when the retiring engineer asked him to take over the codebase.

hindi: लत लगी — किसी चीज़ में इतनी रुचि कि छोड़ना मुश्किल

hindi: हो-हल्ला — किसी अवसर पर मचाया गया शोरगुल भरा उत्साह

hindi: ठहाका या हूट करना — ज़ोरदार हँसी या उपहास में ऊँची आवाज़ निकालना

example: The audience hooted with laughter when the projector showed his holiday photos instead of the slides.

hindi: आशाजनक महसूस करने का एक विशिष्ट उदाहरण
definition: a specific instance of feeling hopeful

hindi: आशान्वित — किसी अच्छी बात के होने की उम्मीद से भरा हुआ

hindi: आशा के बिना क्योंकि आराम या सफलता की कोई संभावना नहीं है

hindi: प्रेम-स्वप्नी — प्रेम को लेकर अत्यधिक भावुक और आदर्शवादी

hindi: जब आप आराम या सफलता की उम्मीद छोड़ चुके हैं तो आपको निराशा महसूस होती है
definition: the despair you feel when you have abandoned hope of comfort or success

hindi: भय या भय या आतंक के कारण

hindi: तनाव या अलार्म से भरा; अप्रिय रूप से आश्चर्यचकित होने का कारण

hindi: तीव्र और गहन भय

hindi: भयाक्रांत — किसी वीभत्स दृश्य से सन्न रह गया

example: She stood horror-struck in the doorway when she saw the flooded kitchen.

hindi: ठठाकर हँसी — ऊँची, कर्कश, उपहासपूर्ण हँसी
definition: a loud, coarse, braying laugh, often expressing scorn or crude amusement

hindi: धक्का-मुक्की वाली मस्ती — शोरगुल भरी, उग्र हँसी-ठिठोली

hindi: अतिथिपरायण — मेहमानों का हार्दिक स्वागत करने वाला
definition: warmly welcoming towards guests and strangers, eager to feed and look after them
example: Our hospitable hosts insisted we stay for dinner even though we had only come to drop off a parcel.

hindi: शत्रुता — खुली दुश्मनी और विरोध की भावना

hindi: उष्ण-रक्त — भावुक, आवेगी और जल्दी उत्तेजित होने वाला

hindi: गरम-मिज़ाज — पल भर में भड़क उठने वाला क्रोधी स्वभाव

hindi: जल्दी क्रोधित
definition: quickly aroused to anger

hindi: पीछा करके सताना — किसी को लगातार परेशान करना

hindi: विलाप में चीखना — असहनीय दुख, पीड़ा या हँसी में लंबी ऊँची चीख

example: He howled with laughter when the cat knocked the birthday cake off the table.

hindi: दर्पपूर्ण — विनाश को न्योता देने वाला अहंकार

hindi: रूठना — नाराज़ होकर मुँह फुलाना

hindi: क्रोध और नाराजगी की स्थिति
definition: a passing state of anger and resentment

hindi: sullen या मूडी
definition: sullen or moody

hindi: sulky resentment की भावना

hindi: जल्दी बंद करने के लिए
definition: quick to take offense

hindi: मानवीय — दया और करुणा से भरा व्यवहार

hindi: शर्म महसूस करने का कारण बनता है; का गौरव को चोट पहुँचाता है
definition: cause to feel shame; hurt the pride of

hindi: एक विशेषता (हाबिटुअल या अपेक्षाकृत अस्थायी) महसूस करने की स्थिति

hindi: अटका हुआ — किसी पूर्व प्रेम से मन न हटना

hindi: सन्नाटा — आदरपूर्ण चुप्पी का क्षण

hindi: जद्दोजहद — तेजी और लगन से लगातार मेहनत करने की ऊर्जा

hindi: भावावेश — वक्ता या भीड़ को बहा ले जाने वाला जोश और उत्साह

hindi: प्रचार से उत्साहित — बढ़ी हुई उत्तेजित उम्मीद

hindi: अति-उत्तेजित — बेकाबू उछलती ऊर्जा

hindi: अतिसक्रिय — असामान्य रूप से बेचैन और अत्यधिक चंचल

hindi: अति-उत्तेजन — लगातार सतर्क और तनी हुई अवस्था

example: Months after the accident his hyperarousal meant every car horn made him jump.

hindi: अति-आलोचनात्मक — छोटी खामियों को भी बड़ा बनाने वाला

example: The hypercritical reviewer complained that the cafe's napkins were folded unevenly.

hindi: अति-एकाग्रता — किसी एक चीज़ पर इतना ध्यान कि बाकी सब छूट जाए

example: Hyperfocus on the model kit meant he looked up and found it was three in the morning.

hindi: अति-संवेदनशील — मामूली बात पर आहत

hindi: अतिसतर्कता — खतरे की तलाश में लगातार चौकन्ना रहना

example: After the burglary his hypervigilance meant every creak of the stairs woke him.

hindi: अति-सतर्क — हर आहट पर ख़तरा भाँपने को तैयार

example: After the burglary she was hypervigilant, checking the locks every time the flat creaked.

hindi: सम्मोहक — मन को बाँध लेने वाला, नींद जैसी तल्लीनता देने वाला

example: The hypnotic rhythm of the windscreen wipers had him staring blankly at the motorway.

example: His hypochondria turned every headache into an evening of searching symptoms online.

hindi: हल्का उन्माद — बढ़ी हुई ऊर्जा और उल्लास की अवस्था

example: During her hypomania she started three side projects in a single weekend.

hindi: उन्माद — भय से भड़का हुआ बेकाबू भावनात्मक उफान

example: A rumour of a gas leak sent the whole floor into hysteria before anyone had checked.

hindi: उन्मादग्रस्त — बेकाबू भावनात्मक विस्फोट
definition: overcome with wild uncontrolled emotion such as panic, weeping or laughter

hindi: भावनात्मक दौरा — बेकाबू रोना या हँसना
definition: a sudden burst of uncontrollable laughing, crying or panic that overwhelms composure completely
example: The kitchen staff were in hysterics after the souffle collapsed for the third time.

hindi: चिपचिपा और घिनौना — हल्की, बचकानी घृणा जगाने वाला

hindi: बर्फ़ीली शीतलता — क्रोध छिपाए हुए ठंडा व्यवहार

example: She gave him an icy thank you when he finally returned the borrowed car with an empty tank.

hindi: आदर्श मानना — किसी को उसकी खामियों के बिना पूर्ण समझना

example: She idealized her old boss until she read the messages he sent the interns.

hindi: तादात्म्य — किसी दूसरे के साथ स्वयं को एक महसूस करना

example: His identification with the underdog team was so total that he sulked all evening after their defeat.

hindi: पहचान संकट — यह न जानने की उलझन कि मैं कौन हूँ

hindi: सहज जिज्ञासा — बिना किसी उद्देश्य की हल्की-फुल्की जानने की इच्छा

hindi: प्रेम या लालसा में खोया-खोया रहना — किसी की याद में सपने देखते फिरना
definition: to wander about dreamily and idly, lost in tender longing for someone or something you cannot have
example: He spent the whole lecture mooning over the girl who sat two rows ahead.

hindi: प्रेम-विह्वल — प्रेम में इतना खोया हुआ कि सुध-बुध न रहे
definition: dazed and dreamy with romantic love, behaving as though the feeling has knocked sense out of you
example: The moonstruck intern kept forgetting his badge because he was busy replaying their lunch conversation.

hindi: प्रेम में खोया हुआ — प्रेम के कारण स्वप्निल और अनमना रहना
definition: dreamily absent-minded because of romantic longing, gazing into space with a soft, faraway look
example: He has been moony all week, staring at the office window and sighing whenever her name comes up in a meeting.

hindi: उदासी में डूबे रहना — सुस्त होकर दुःख मनाना
definition: to drift about in a listless, sulky sadness, feeling sorry for oneself rather than doing anything
example: Instead of calling anyone he moped around the flat all weekend in the same hoodie.

hindi: नैतिक घृणा — अनैतिक आचरण से उपजी जुगुप्सा
definition: the revulsion people feel toward cheating, cruelty or betrayal, a psychology term for disgust triggered by wrong conduct rather than by dirt
example: The moral disgust in the room was obvious when the manager admitted he had read the staff's private messages.

hindi: नैतिक उत्थान — किसी की भलाई देखकर उठा गर्म, प्रेरक भाव
definition: psychology's term for the warm, uplifting feeling of witnessing a deed of kindness or goodness that makes you want to be better yourself
example: Watching a stranger pay for the old man's groceries gave her a flush of moral elevation that lasted all afternoon.

hindi: नैतिक आघात — अंतरात्मा पर गहरा घाव
definition: the lasting guilt and shame from doing or witnessing something that violates your deepest sense of right, beyond ordinary regret
example: The nurse described her moral injury from the wards during the shortage.

hindi: नैतिक आक्रोश — अन्याय देखकर उठा तीव्र क्रोध
definition: the hot anger that flares when one sees a rule of fairness or decency being broken, often on behalf of someone else
example: The group chat erupted in moral outrage when the landlord doubled the rent on the elderly tenant downstairs.

hindi: नैतिक आतंक — समाज में किसी खतरे को लेकर फैला अतिरंजित भय
definition: a wave of exaggerated public fear that some group or new habit threatens society's values, spread by headlines faster than by evidence
example: The moral panic over the new game had parents at the school gate swapping rumours none of them had checked.

hindi: मनोबल — किसी समूह का साझा उत्साह और आत्मविश्वास

hindi: रुग्ण उदासी — मृत्यु और दुःख में अस्वस्थ रुचि

hindi: विकृत जिज्ञासा — मृत्यु, दुर्घटना या भयावह चीज़ों को जानने की खिंचाव
definition: a fascination and desire to know about death, disaster or unpleasant things that one also finds disturbing
example: Morbid curiosity kept the whole office refreshing the news page about the train crash.

hindi: विकृत ईर्ष्या — बिना सबूत बेवफ़ाई का जुनूनी शक
definition: an obsessive and unfounded conviction that a partner is being unfaithful, strong enough to take over daily life
example: The counsellor recognised morbid jealousy when he described checking the mileage on his wife's car every evening.

hindi: तीक्ष्ण — काटने वाली कड़वी बुद्धि
definition: having a biting, bitterly sharp humour that cuts its target while amusing everyone else
example: Her mordant summary of the team meeting had the group chat crying with laughter.

definition: showing a brooding ill humor; ; ; ; ; ; - Bruce Bliven

hindi: उदासीन अनुभव

hindi: शर्मिंदगी की मजबूत भावनाओं
definition: strong feelings of embarrassment

hindi: अत्यंत लज्जित — शर्म से गड़ जाना

hindi: अत्यंत लज्जित करना — इतनी शर्मिंदगी कि जमीन में गड़ जाने का मन करे

hindi: ममतामयी — माँ जैसी कोमल, संरक्षक और पोषण देने वाली भावना
definition: showing the warm, protective tenderness of a mother, caring for someone's comfort as if they were your own child

hindi: प्रेरणा — किसी काम को करने की भीतरी इच्छा और कारण

hindi: उदासी महसूस

hindi: दु:ख व्यक्त करना

hindi: दबी-सी संकोची — शांत और अलक्षित रहने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: timid, quiet and easily overlooked in temperament, seeming to shrink away from any notice or attention
example: The mousy receptionist surprised everyone by winning the pub quiz single-handedly.

hindi: मुंहज़ोर — बड़बोला और बेअदब

hindi: भावविभोर — किसी बात से मन गहराई से प्रभावित
definition: feeling a warm, tender swell of emotion in response to something kind, brave or beautiful, often with a lump in the throat
example: He was genuinely moved when the whole group chat chipped in for his vet bill without being asked.

hindi: भावुक कर देने वाला — जो मन को गहराई से हिला दे
definition: stirring deep tender emotion in the person who sees or hears it, so that they feel gently shaken and closer to tears than they expected
example: The retirement video the interns made was so moving that the whole office went quiet for a minute.

hindi: दमखम — साहस, जोश और चुनौती का सामना करने की हिम्मत

hindi: उलझा हुआ — विचार गड्डमड्ड

hindi: मुदिता — दूसरे की खुशी में निःस्वार्थ आनंद

hindi: अस्पष्ट बुदबुदाना — घबराहट या शर्म में शब्द गड्डमड्ड करके बोलना

example: A mild note on his code review set off narcissistic rage that spilled into three angry emails.

example: She burned off her nervous energy by reorganising the pantry before the results call.

hindi: एक रहस्य या bewildering
definition: be a mystery or bewildering to
example: This beats me!

hindi: किंकर्तव्यविमूढ़ — इतना हैरान कि प्रतिक्रिया न सूझे
definition: surprised and confused to the point where you have no idea how to react or what to answer
example: The nonplussed receptionist watched a man in a full dinosaur costume ask for the finance department.

hindi: कुछ देर तक
definition: longing for something past

hindi: परिचित चीजों या व्यक्तियों के लिए दूर रहने और लंबे समय तक दुखी
definition: unhappy about being away and longing for familiar things or persons

hindi: निम्न जीवन की चाह — सुख-सुविधा में पले व्यक्ति में घटिया और कच्चे अनुभवों की ललक
definition: a yearning for coarse, lowly or squalid experiences felt by someone used to comfort and refinement
example: Bored of tasting menus, the executive's nostalgie de la boue took him to a greasy late-night kebab van every Friday.

hindi: दखलंदाज़ — दूसरों के निजी मामलों को जानने की अनुचित उत्सुकता
definition: showing rude eager curiosity about other people's private affairs, asking questions that are none of your business
example: The nosy neighbour asked why the ambulance had stopped outside our flat last night.

hindi: सुन्न — दुःख से भावनाशून्य हो जाना
definition: unable to feel anything after a shock or loss, an emotional blankness that comes before the sorrow arrives
example: For the first few days after the funeral she felt numb and answered every text with one word.

hindi: पोषण देने वाला — किसी को स्नेह से बढ़ने और फलने में मदद करने वाला
definition: caring for someone with patient tenderness that helps them grow, gain confidence and feel safe
example: Her nurturing manner meant the shy trainees always ended up at her desk when something went wrong.

hindi: कठोर-हृदय हठी — पछतावे या समझाने से भी न पिघलने वाला
definition: stubbornly refusing to change your mind or soften your heart, unmoved by pleading, argument or regret
example: Despite three apologies she stayed obdurate and would not let him back into the group chat.

hindi: आपत्तिजनक — जो नापसंदगी और विरोध जगाए
definition: arousing dislike and disapproval because it offends taste or decency, unpleasant enough that people feel they should complain
example: The most objectionable thing about the new open-plan office was the colleague who ate tuna at his desk.

hindi: आभारी — कृतज्ञता के साथ बंधन का भाव
definition: feeling grateful and slightly bound to return a kindness that someone has done for you
example: Much obliged, she typed into the group chat after three neighbours offered to feed the cat.

hindi: सहायक तत्परता — खुशी से मदद करने को तैयार
definition: eager and willing to help or do favours for other people, saying yes before they finish asking
example: The obliging IT guy fixed her laptop during his own lunch break.

hindi: अत्यंत अप्रिय — व्यवहार से घृणा और चिढ़ जगाने वाला
definition: extremely unpleasant in a loud, rude or self-satisfied way that makes others feel both irritated and disgusted
example: The passenger in the quiet carriage played videos at full volume and became obnoxious when asked to stop.

hindi: जुनून में डूबना — किसी एक बात के बारे में लगातार बेचैनी से सोचना
definition: to think about one worry or desire so constantly that it crowds out everything else in the mind
example: She obsessed over the typo in the sent email long after the client had replied without noticing.

hindi: जुनून — किसी व्यक्ति या विचार का मन पर लगातार हावी रहना
definition: a preoccupation with a person or idea that dominates your thoughts and crowds everything else out
example: His obsession with the woman from the running club meant every conversation somehow circled back to her.

hindi: हठी — तर्क और मनुहार के बावजूद अपनी बात पर अड़ा हुआ
definition: stubbornly clinging to your own opinion or course despite reason and persuasion, with a defiant streak that hardens under pressure
example: He stayed obstinate about the road trip route even after the map app showed a two-hour delay.

hindi: सागरीय अनुभूति — विश्व के साथ असीम एकत्व का बोध
definition: a sense of being boundless and merged with everything around you, named by psychology as the root of religious feeling
example: Lying on the roof watching the meteor shower, she had an oceanic feeling of belonging to the whole sky.

definition: unequivocally detestable; ; ; ; - Edmund Burke
example: Abominable treatment of prisoners.

hindi: विकर्षक — जो हल्की अरुचि से दूर कर दे
definition: unpleasant enough to make you lose interest or keep your distance, milder than disgusting but still a turn away
example: His habit of chewing loudly during video calls was off-putting, and colleagues started muting him.

hindi: आहत भावना — बुरा मान जाना
definition: the hurt and resentful feeling of having been insulted or disrespected, whether or not any harm was meant
example: He took offence at a joke that nobody else even noticed.

definition: cause to feel resentment or indignation
example: Her tactless remark offended me.

hindi: आपत्तिजनक — क्रोध, घृणा या आहत भाव जगाने वाला
definition: causing someone to feel upset, insulted or disgusted, used of remarks and images that cross a line of decency
example: The joke on the office whiteboard was offensive enough that human resources sent an email about it.

hindi: लापरवाह — बिना सोचे या परवाह किए बेरुखी से
definition: casual and careless in manner, showing little interest or thought about something that deserved more
example: His offhand reply to her long message left her wondering whether he had even read it.

hindi: अतिसक्रिय-दखलंदाज़ — बिना माँगे अधिकार जताने वाला
definition: asserting authority in an annoying self-important way, interfering where your help was never wanted
example: An officious volunteer kept moving our chairs back into a straight line.

hindi: घूरना — कामुक रुचि से किसी को खुलेआम ताकना
definition: to stare at someone with obvious sexual interest, in a way that is rude and uncomfortable to receive
example: She moved seats on the train after noticing the man opposite continued to ogle her.

hindi: अशुभ — किसी बुरे होने वाले की चेतावनी देता हुआ
definition: giving the worrying, threatening impression that something dreadful is about to happen
example: The ominous silence in the group chat after her message made her check it every minute.

hindi: एक कदम आगे दिखने की होड़ — हर बात में बढ़त जताना
definition: the habit of trying to appear a little better than whoever you are with, topping their story or purchase with your own
example: The dinner turned into one-upmanship, each guest mentioning a slightly more exotic holiday than the last.

hindi: एकत्व — दूसरों या संसार से एक होने की गहरी अनुभूति
definition: a deep sense of being united and at one with other people or with everything around you, all separateness gone
example: Singing the last chorus with ten thousand strangers, she felt a oneness she never found anywhere else.

hindi: खुले हाथ वाला — बिना हिसाब के देने वाला
definition: giving freely and without keeping count, generous to the point of carelessness
example: She was openhanded with tips, leaving extra for every server who looked tired.

hindi: खुले दिल का — बिना छुपाव के गर्मजोशी और स्नेह दिखाना
definition: warm, candid and unguarded in showing kindness and affection, holding nothing back and hiding nothing about your feelings
example: Her openhearted welcome at the door made the new neighbours feel they had known her for years.

hindi: भव्य भावुकता — भावना का बड़ा, ऊँचे स्वर वाला प्रदर्शन
definition: expressing feeling on a grand sweeping scale with loud passionate gestures and voice
example: The argument over the parking space reached operatic levels of wailing and arm waving.

hindi: oppressed होने की भावना
definition: a feeling of being oppressed

hindi: आशावादी लग रहा है कि सभी अच्छी तरह से बाहर बारी जा रहा है
definition: the optimistic feeling that all is going to turn out well

hindi: सभी संभावित दुनिया में सबसे अच्छा उम्मीद
definition: expecting the best in this best of all possible worlds
example: In an optimistic mood.

hindi: अड़ियल चिड़चिड़ापन — जिद्दी और झगड़ालू स्वभाव
definition: stubbornly bad-tempered and difficult to deal with, refusing to cooperate out of sheer contrariness
example: My grandfather gets ornery whenever anyone suggests he should stop driving at night.

hindi: अनाथ — सहारे और संरक्षण से वंचित महसूस करना
definition: feeling left without the protection and guidance you depended on, as a child without parents does
example: With the mentor who hired them gone, the whole team felt orphaned inside the new company structure.

hindi: सामाजिक बहिष्कार — समूह द्वारा जानबूझकर अनदेखा करना
definition: deliberate shunning of a person by their group, cutting them out of conversation and company as a punishment
example: The ostracism after she refused to cover for her colleague was silent but complete.

hindi: क्रोध का विस्फोट — अचानक फूट पड़ने वाला गुस्सा
definition: a sudden violent expression of anger or strong emotion that bursts out after being held in
example: His outburst at the meeting surprised colleagues who had only ever seen him calm.

hindi: बहिष्कृत — समाज या समूह से निकाला गया व्यक्ति
definition: a person rejected and pushed out by their group or community, left to feel unwanted and outside
example: After reporting the safety breach he was treated like an outcast, eating alone while the crew fell silent around him.

hindi: जनाक्रोश — किसी अन्याय पर जनता का ज़ोरदार विरोध
definition: a strong public expression of anger or indignation about something seen as unjust or wrong
example: The decision to close the library caused an outcry across the whole town.

hindi: बहिर्मुखी — खुलकर मिलने-जुलने वाला स्वभाव
definition: confident and friendly in temperament, quick to approach and talk to new people
example: Her outgoing younger brother had befriended the whole hostel by the second morning.

hindi: भावनात्मक बाढ़ — भावना का अचानक भारी प्रवाह
definition: a sudden powerful flood of feeling expressed openly and all at once by many people
example: The closing of the cafe brought an outpouring of grief and gratitude from regulars.

hindi: धर्मी क्रोध की भावना
definition: a feeling of righteous anger

hindi: Disgust या revulsion के साथ हड़ताल
definition: strike with disgust or revulsion
example: The scandalous behavior of this married woman shocked her friends.

hindi: बाहरी व्यक्ति — जो समूह का हिस्सा महसूस न करे
definition: a person who does not belong to a group and feels the separateness of watching from the outside
example: Even after two years she still felt like an outsider in the team's private jokes and shared history.

hindi: अति-चिंतित — जरूरत से ज्यादा घबराया और बेचैन
definition: worrying far more than a situation deserves, anxious to the point of fretting over every small thing
example: She was overanxious about the parcel and refreshed the tracking page every two minutes.

hindi: आतंकित करना — प्रभाव या भय से किसी को दबा देना
definition: to impress or frighten someone so much that they feel small and unable to speak up
example: The glass boardroom and the row of directors overawed the young founder into silence.

hindi: अभिभूत — भय मिश्रित श्रद्धा से दबा हुआ
definition: so impressed by someone or something grand that you feel small, timid and unable to behave normally
example: The overawed junior barely spoke during lunch with the company's legendary designer.

hindi: दबंग — दूसरों को दबाकर अपनी चलाने वाला अहंकारी
definition: domineering and arrogant, pushing your own wishes onto others with a heavy insistence that ignores theirs
example: Her overbearing co-founder rewrote everyone's slides the night before the pitch.

hindi: अतिरंजित भावना — आवश्यकता से अधिक बढ़ी हुई
definition: inflated beyond what the situation deserves, making a feeling seem excessive
example: Her overblown outrage at the typo made the intern quietly panic.

hindi: बोझ से दबा — अपनी ताक़त से ज़्यादा ज़िम्मेदारियाँ ढोता
definition: weighed down by more duties or worries than a person can fairly carry, leaving a tired heaviness
example: The nurse looked overburdened, juggling twelve patients on a ward built for eight.

hindi: भावाभिभूत — भावना के आगे बेबस और निःशब्द
definition: so flooded by a feeling such as grief, gratitude or relief that you cannot speak or act for a moment
example: Overcome by the surprise farewell, she just stood in the kitchen doorway holding the card.

hindi: अति आत्मविश्वास — अपनी क्षमता या सफलता का ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा भरोसा
definition: excessive trust in one's own ability or in a plan's success, which blinds a person to real risks
example: Overconfidence made him skip the backup, and the laptop died the night before the presentation.

hindi: अतिआत्मविश्वासी — अपनी क्षमता को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर आँकने वाला
definition: having more confidence in your own abilities or judgement than the facts justify, so that you underestimate risks
example: He was overconfident about the migration and skipped the backup, which the whole team regretted by lunch.

hindi: अति-उत्सुक — इतनी उत्सुकता कि जल्दबाजी हो जाए
definition: so eager and keen to please or to start that you rush ahead and overdo it
example: The overeager intern answered every question in the meeting before the client had finished asking.

hindi: अतिभावुक — ज़रूरत से अधिक भावना दिखाना
definition: showing far more feeling than a situation calls for, in a way others find excessive
example: The overemotional farewell to the office plant lasted longer than the meeting.

hindi: अति उत्तेजित — जोश में संयम खोया हुआ
definition: excited beyond what a person can comfortably control, so that behaviour becomes loud, scattered or exhausting
example: The puppy got overexcited when guests arrived and knocked over the coffee table.

hindi: हद से ज़्यादा फैला — इतने वादे कि सब निभाना मुश्किल
definition: stretched thin by having taken on more commitments than time or energy can cover
example: Volunteering for two committees left her overextended and quietly resentful.

hindi: अत्यंत हर्षित — खुशी से भरा हुआ, जितना सोचा था उससे कहीं ज़्यादा
definition: filled with far more happiness than expected, so that the gladness spills over into visible, almost uncontrollable excitement
example: My parents were overjoyed when I told them over dinner that the surgery had gone well.

hindi: अत्यधिक भार से दबा — क्षमता से ज़्यादा काम या जानकारी झेलता
definition: carrying more tasks, information or responsibility than the mind can process at once, so thinking slows and errors creep in
example: After three back-to-back meetings he felt overloaded and forgot what the first one had even decided.

hindi: अनदेखा — ध्यान न दिए जाने की चुभन
definition: quietly stung at being passed over or unnoticed while others receive the attention or credit you had also earned
example: Watching the whole project praised without her name mentioned once left her feeling thoroughly overlooked.

hindi: अभिभूत करने वाला — जिसके सामने संभलना कठिन हो
definition: so strong an emotion or impression that it defeats every attempt to stay composed or think clearly
example: An overpowering wave of homesickness hit him when the café played a song from his school days.

hindi: अतिसुरक्षात्मक — ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा बचाने की चिंता
definition: guarding someone from harm so anxiously and constantly that the guarding itself begins to smother their freedom
example: The overprotective older brother insisted on driving his sister to the party and waiting outside in the car.

hindi: अतिप्रतिक्रिया — छोटी बात पर ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा भावुक प्रतिक्रिया
definition: to respond to something with far more emotion or alarm than the situation deserves
example: She overreacted to the typo as if the whole report were ruined.

hindi: unduly संवेदनशील या पतली त्वचा
definition: unduly sensitive or thin-skinned

hindi: छाया में दबा — किसी की चमक के कारण नज़रअंदाज़
definition: feeling unseen and less valued because someone nearby draws all the attention and praise
example: Growing up overshadowed by a famous older sister, she learned to expect no one to ask about her work.

hindi: अति-उद्दीपित — बहुत अधिक उत्तेजना से थका और बेचैन
definition: restless and frayed because too much noise, activity or excitement has flooded the senses
example: The toddler was overstimulated after the birthday party and melted down in the car.

hindi: एक सामयिक स्थिति में होना
definition: being in a tense state

hindi: ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा सोचना — किसी बात पर इतना विचार करना कि बेचैनी बढ़ जाए
definition: to turn a decision or a remark over and over in the mind until worry replaces any clear judgement
example: She overthought the two-word reply for an hour before deciding the full stop meant nothing.

hindi: अति-थकान से चिड़चिड़ा — इतना थका कि आराम भी न आए
definition: so exhausted that you become restless, irritable and unable to settle or sleep, tiredness tipped past the point of rest
example: The overtired toddler screamed at the wrong-coloured cup, and honestly his overtired father understood.

hindi: अतिघमंडी — अपनी क्षमता का अत्यधिक अनुमान
definition: showing excessive confidence or pride that goes far beyond what a person's actual ability or position could justify
example: His overweening belief that the startup would be worth billions by summer made the investors quietly close their notebooks.

hindi: अभिभूत — भावना से इतना भर देना कि संभालना कठिन हो
definition: to flood someone with an emotion so powerful and sudden that they feel unable to cope with or contain it
example: The kindness of the neighbours after the fire completely overwhelmed her.

hindi: अभिभूत — भावना की बाढ़ में डूबा हुआ
definition: flooded by a feeling so strong that you cannot cope with or contain it, whether gladness or distress
example: He was overwhelmed when the whole team turned up at the hospital with balloons.

hindi: अत्यधिक काम से थका — आराम बिना लगातार श्रम से चूर
definition: tired and strained from being made to work far too hard for too long without proper rest
example: The overworked developer answered messages at midnight and dreaded the morning standup.

hindi: अति-उत्तेजित — तनाव से बेकाबू भावनाएँ
definition: strained to the point of losing control, nerves and feelings pushed too far by stress or sorrow
example: By the end of the funeral week she was overwrought and burst into tears over a slice of burnt toast.

hindi: अति-उत्साही — उत्साह में सीमा से आगे बढ़ जाना
definition: so enthusiastic and eager about a cause or task that you push too hard and go too far
example: An overzealous moderator deleted half the group chat over a mild joke.

hindi: अधिक अनुकूल होने का कारण बनता है; अच्छी इच्छा प्राप्त करें
definition: cause to be more favorably inclined; gain the good will of
example: She managed to mollify the angry customer.

hindi: शारीरिक या मनोवैज्ञानिक दर्द के कारण
definition: causing physical or psychological pain
example: Worked with painful slowness.

hindi: भावनात्मक संकट; एक मूलभूत भावना जो लोग बचने की कोशिश करते हैं
definition: emotional distress; a fundamental feeling that people try to avoid
example: The pain of loneliness.

hindi: अचानक numbing dread
definition: a sudden numbing dread

hindi: पीड़ा हल्की करना — कारण हटाए बिना कष्ट को कम करना
definition: to make distress or misery easier to bear without removing its cause, easing the suffering rather than curing it
example: Weekly calls with her old roommate palliated the loneliness of the new city but never quite ended it.

hindi: लाड़-प्यार से सुख देना — स्नेहवश किसी को आराम और सुविधाएँ देना
definition: to treat someone with loving care and comfort, giving them more attention and luxury than they strictly need
example: After her exams her parents pampered her with breakfast in bed and a whole weekend of doing nothing.

hindi: अचानक तेज भावना
definition: a sudden sharp feeling
example: Pangs of regret.

hindi: भय और चिंता की भारी भावना
definition: an overwhelming feeling of fear and anxiety

hindi: आतंक का दौरा — अचानक तीव्र भय जिसमें सांस और धड़कन बेकाबू हो जाए
definition: a sudden surge of overwhelming fear with a pounding heart and breathlessness, usually passing within minutes
example: She had a panic attack on the crowded platform and had to sit on the floor until it passed.

hindi: आतंक-खरीदारी — कमी के भय से भीड़ का हड़बड़ी में सामान भरना
definition: the anxious rush to buy up supplies when a crowd fears a shortage, which spreads the fear and creates the shortage
example: Two days of panic buying left the supermarket with no pasta and no toilet paper.

hindi: आतंकित — अचानक भय से बदहवास हो गया
definition: overwhelmed by sudden wild fear that makes clear thinking impossible
example: The panic-stricken parents ran through the mall calling their daughter's name.

hindi: अचानक भय से दूर होना
definition: be overcome by a sudden fear
example: The students panicked when told that final exams were less than a week away.

hindi: तीव्र भय या निराशा की स्थिति में फेंकना
definition: thrown into a state of intense fear or desperation
example: Became panicky as the snow deepened.

hindi: व्यामोह — बिना कारण यह डर कि लोग आपके खिलाफ हैं
definition: a persistent, unfounded fear that other people are secretly plotting against you or watching you
example: His paranoia grew until he was sure every quiet group chat was about him.

hindi: एकतरफ़ा लगाव — जिस प्रसिद्ध व्यक्ति को जानते नहीं, उससे अपनापन महसूस करना
definition: feeling a personal bond and affection for a public figure who does not know you exist
example: He admitted his attachment to the podcast host was parasocial when he caught himself worrying about her cold.

hindi: क्रोध का दौरा — अचानक और तीव्र उन्माद

hindi: मर्मस्पर्शी — दुख और स्नेह मिली गहरी टीस देने वाला

hindi: स्थिरता — गरिमा के साथ शांत और संतुलित बने रहना

example: He walked into the interview with a quiet poise that made the panel relax before he said a word.

hindi: भावहीन चेहरा — जानबूझकर कोई भावना न दिखाना

hindi: सुखद (अवास्तविक रूप से) आशावादी

hindi: आडंबरी — दिखावटी गंभीरता और घमंड वाला

hindi: हँसी में उड़ा देना — तिरस्कार से किसी बात को नकारना

hindi: थककर चूर — पूरी तरह हांफता हुआ

hindi: सकारात्मक भाव — प्रसन्नता और उत्साह जैसी सुखद भावनाओं का समूह

hindi: सकारात्मकता — हर बात का उजला पक्ष देखने की आदतन मनोवृत्ति

hindi: अधिकार-भावना से ग्रस्त — प्रेम में किसी को पूरी तरह अपना मानने की ज़िद

example: His possessiveness showed when he sulked because she went to the pub with colleagues.

hindi: छुट्टी के बाद की उदासी — लौटकर रोज़मर्रा में ढलने का दुख

hindi: आघातोत्तर विकास — गहरे दुख के बाद आया सकारात्मक बदलाव

hindi: प्रशंसा — किसी के गुण या काम की स्वीकृति भरी सराहना

hindi: टीसना — पुरानी बात का कड़वापन बना रहना

hindi: क्रोध भरा भाषण — लंबा और उत्तेजित शिकायती प्रवाह

hindi: आकर्षक लगना

hindi: भावना से दूर जाने की स्थिति; - चार्ल्स डिकेंस

hindi: आकर्षक लगना
definition: feeling great rapture or delight

hindi: अविवेकी — बिना परिणाम सोचे जल्दबाजी में कदम उठाना
definition: acting quickly on impulse without stopping to consider the likely consequences of the choice

hindi: घबराहट — किसी को विचलित और बेचैन कर देना

hindi: विचलित — अचानक घबराकर संयम खो बैठा

hindi: झल्लाया हुआ — मामूली बातों पर चिड़चिड़ा

example: Sorry I was ratty this morning, I had not slept and the bus was late again.

hindi: उन्मत्त होकर बड़बड़ाना — क्रोध या पागलपन में असंगत तेज़ बातें करना
definition: to talk wildly and incoherently in a burst of fury or excitement, as though reason has been swept away
example: He was raving about the referee's decision long after the match had finished.

hindi: आनंद की भावना आश्चर्य और उत्साह से भरी हुई है

hindi: कच्चा और नंगा — अभी-अभी लगी चोट सा खुला और तीखा

hindi: आप एक बार प्यार करने वाले व्यक्ति के बारे में भावुक महसूस करते हैं लेकिन अब नहीं करते

hindi: मज़ाक उड़ाना — दोस्ताना ढंग से खिल्ली उड़ाना

hindi: आश्वासन — भय शांत करने वाला भरोसा
definition: the calming relief that comes from being told or shown that a worry is unfounded or handled

hindi: आश्वस्त करना — किसी की चिंता या डर को दूर कर भरोसा दिलाना

hindi: आश्वस्त — चिंता मिटने के बाद का सुकून
definition: feeling calm again because someone has removed your doubts or fears about them or the situation

hindi: अस्वीकृति — रूखे ढंग से ठुकराकर ठेस पहुँचाना
definition: to reject someone's offer or approach bluntly so that they feel stung and turned away

hindi: अवज्ञाकारी — अनुशासन या नियंत्रण का हठपूर्वक विरोध करने वाला

hindi: ऊर्जा भरना — विश्राम से मन की शक्ति वापस पाना

example: He books one quiet Saturday a month with no plans purely to recharge.

hindi: लापरवाह — परिणामों की परवाह किए बिना साहसी
definition: acting boldly without any concern for the danger or consequences involved, treating obvious risks as if they were nothing
example: It was reckless to push the update to every customer on a Friday evening.

hindi: एकांतवासी — लोगों से कटकर रहने वाला
definition: habitually avoiding other people and preferring to stay shut away from society by temperament
example: The reclusive developer worked from a cabin and only surfaced online when a bug report mentioned his name.

hindi: पीछे हटना — भय या घृणा से झटके से दूर होना

hindi: समझौता-भाव — अनचाही स्थिति को संघर्ष छोड़कर शांति से स्वीकार कर लेना

hindi: शर्म से लाल — चेहरे पर झेंप

example: Red-faced, she realised she had been muted for the entire presentation.

hindi: लाल पड़ जाना — शर्म या क्रोध से चेहरे का रंग बदलना
definition: to grow visibly red in the face because embarrassment or anger has slowly crept over your features
example: He reddened and looked at his shoes when the teacher read his poem aloud.

hindi: गहराई से या गंभीरता से सोचा
definition: deeply or seriously thoughtful

hindi: तरोताज़ा — आराम के बाद पुनः ऊर्जावान
definition: feeling renewed in energy and mood after rest, sleep or a welcome change of scene
example: One proper night's sleep and she came into the studio refreshed and ready.

hindi: आश्रय — संकट से बचकर सुरक्षा का सुकून
definition: the feeling of shelter and safety you find when you escape from trouble, danger or stress
example: On hard days the library was her refuge, quiet and warm and asking nothing of her.

hindi: आदर — किसी के प्रति सम्मानपूर्ण और स्नेहिल दृष्टि

example: He always asked after her father's health, a small sign of the regard he had for the family.

hindi: कुछ गलत किए गए या कुछ निराशा से जुड़े उदासी
definition: sadness associated with some wrong done or some disappointment

hindi: अस्वीकृति की चोट — ठुकराए जाने की पीड़ा

example: The sting of rejection from the dream job lasted well past the weekend.

hindi: अस्वीकार-संवेदनशीलता — ठुकराए जाने की आशंका से तीव्र पीड़ा

hindi: खुशी या खुशी महसूस करना

hindi: खुशी की भावना

hindi: पुनर्जीवित — नई जान और उत्साह से भरा

hindi: सापेक्ष वंचना — दूसरों की तुलना में कम मिलने का दुख

hindi: तनावमुक्त — शरीर और मन के तनाव से छूटा हुआ

hindi: नरम पड़ना — कठोरता या क्रोध छोड़ देना

hindi: अविराम — बिना रुके या ढीले पड़े लगातार चलने वाला

hindi: निर्भरता — किसी पर टिके रहने का भरोसा

hindi: जब कुछ बोझ को हटा दिया जाता है या कम हो जाता है तो वह महसूस होता है

hindi: दर्द से शारीरिक राहत प्रदान करते हैं

hindi: जोरदार और उत्साही आनंद

hindi: बदला लेने या बदला लेने के लिए इरादा करने के लिए disposed; - शेक्सपियर; - M.R. कोहेन

hindi: किसी व्यक्ति या किसी चीज़ के लिए गहन सम्मान की भावना
definition: a feeling of profound respect for someone or something

hindi: श्रद्धालु — गहरे आदर से भरा हुआ

hindi: महसूस करना या प्रकट करना

hindi: पुनः ऊर्जित — नई ऊर्जा और उत्साह से भरा

hindi: पुनर्जीवित करना — थके या निराश मन में फिर से जोश भरना

hindi: घृणा — किसी में तीव्र जुगुप्सा और विरोध जगाना

hindi: अत्यंत घिनौना — जिसे देखकर पेट उलट जाए

hindi: तीव्र संस्करण
definition: intense aversion

hindi: संतोषदायक — मेहनत के बदले मिलने वाला गहरा सुख
definition: bringing a deep, earned satisfaction that makes the effort feel worthwhile, pleasure that comes from what you gave rather than what you got
example: Teaching the evening class was exhausting but the most rewarding thing on her calendar.

hindi: आकर्षक लगना
definition: feeling great rapture or delight

hindi: उल्लासपूर्ण प्रशंसा — भावना में बहकर बोलना
definition: an outpouring of enthusiastic, extravagant feeling, often spoken or written in praise of something
example: Her review of the tiny noodle place turned into a rhapsody that ran three paragraphs long.

hindi: उपहास — किसी को हास्यास्पद बनाकर तिरस्कार दिखाना
definition: mocking laughter or remarks that make a person or idea seem absurd and unworthy of respect

hindi: दरार — रिश्ते में पड़ी गहरी फूट

hindi: धर्मसंगत क्रोध — सही होने के भरोसे के साथ उठा गुस्सा

hindi: आत्म-मुग्धता — अपनी ही योग्यता या रूप पर मोहित होना
definition: an open delight in your own looks, talent or cleverness, dwelling on them with the fondness usually reserved for someone else
example: He read his own email aloud twice with undisguised self-admiration before finally hitting send.

hindi: आत्म-समर्थन — अपने मूल्यों और योग्यता को याद दिलाकर मन को मजबूत करना
definition: deliberately reminding yourself of your values and strengths to steady your confidence when it feels under threat
example: Before the interview he sat in the car doing a minute of self-affirmation about what he actually knew.

hindi: आत्मश्लाघा — खुद को बड़ा दिखाने की चेष्टा
definition: the act of making yourself seem more powerful, important or impressive than you are, usually through boasting or exaggerated claims
example: His presentation was pure self-aggrandizement, with every team win reframed as something he had personally delivered.

hindi: आत्मविश्वास — शांत और स्थिर आत्म-भरोसा
definition: a calm, settled confidence in oneself that does not need to be loud or proved to anyone
example: She gave the presentation with a quiet self-assurance that made the numbers seem obvious.

hindi: आत्मविश्वासी — अपनी योग्यता पर शांत और स्थिर भरोसा रखने वाला
definition: calm and settled belief in your own ability that shows in an easy manner rather than in loud claims
example: She was self-assured enough to pause for a full minute while the projector rebooted mid-presentation.

hindi: आत्म-जागरूकता — अपनी भावनाओं और प्रभाव का सजग बोध
definition: the conscious knowledge of your own emotions, habits and the effect you have on other people as it happens
example: He had enough self-awareness to notice he was getting snappy and stepped out for some air.

hindi: स्वयं पर अटूट आस्था — असफलताओं के बाद भी सफल होने का पक्का यकीन
definition: deep faith that you can succeed which survives failures that would shake other people
example: Her self-belief carried her through three failed auditions to the one that landed.

hindi: आत्म-दोष — हर बात का दोष खुद पर लेना
definition: the habit of holding yourself responsible for a bad outcome, quietly taking the fault onto your own shoulders even when events were mostly beyond your control
example: The coach warned her that self-blame after a lost match would not fix the team's passing.

hindi: आत्म-ताड़ना — स्वयं को कड़ी फटकार
definition: severe scolding of yourself in your own head for a mistake, sharper and more verbal than quiet regret
example: His self-castigation over the typo went on longer than the email itself.

hindi: आत्मकेंद्रित — हर बात को अपने फायदे और सुविधा से देखना
definition: habitually treating your own needs and convenience as the point of every situation, weighing others only by how they affect you
example: It was self-centered of him to move the team dinner to suit his gym schedule without asking anyone.

hindi: आत्म-करुणा — अपनी गलतियों पर खुद के प्रति नरमी
definition: the gentle kindness a person turns toward their own mistakes and pain instead of harsh judgement
example: After missing the deadline she practised some self-compassion and went for a walk rather than spiralling.

hindi: आत्म-निंदा — स्वयं को कठोर सज़ा सुनाना
definition: a harsh judgement passed on yourself that treats a mistake as proof you are a bad person, not just someone who erred
example: One forgotten birthday tipped him into total self-condemnation.

hindi: आत्मविश्वास — अपनी योग्यता पर भरोसा
definition: trust in your own abilities and worth that lets you act and speak without excessive fear of failure or judgement
example: His self-confidence grew with every demo that went smoothly in front of the client.

hindi: आत्मप्रशंसा — अपनी सफलता पर खुद को सराहना
definition: the smug pleasure of praising yourself for something you have done, often before anyone else has had a chance to judge it
example: The group chat was full of self-congratulation before anyone had actually checked whether the fix worked.

hindi: आत्म-सजग — दूसरों की नज़रों का बोझ
definition: uncomfortably aware of how you look or sound to others, so that ordinary actions feel awkward
example: He became self-conscious about his laugh after the video went round the office.

hindi: आत्म-पर्याप्त — भावनाओं को अपने भीतर संभाले रखने वाला
definition: emotionally complete in yourself, calm and private, neither seeking company for comfort nor showing much need of anyone
example: He was so self-contained that no one at work knew he had been through a breakup until months later.

hindi: आत्मतिरस्कार — स्वयं को तुच्छ समझना
definition: a scornful low opinion of oneself in which you judge your own weakness as harshly as you would a stranger's
example: His self-contempt showed in the way he called himself useless every time the code failed to compile.

hindi: आत्मसंयम — अपने आवेगों और भावों पर नियंत्रण
definition: the calm ability to hold back an impulse or strong feeling and act with steadiness instead
example: It took real self-control not to reply to the rude email the moment it landed.

hindi: आत्म-आलोचना — अपनी कमियों की कठोर समीक्षा
definition: the habit of judging your own work and behaviour harshly, noticing faults faster than merits
example: Her self-criticism was so sharp that she deleted a perfectly good draft three times.

hindi: आत्म-भ्रम — अपने बारे में सुखद झूठ पर विश्वास
definition: a comforting false belief about yourself or your situation that you cling to because the truth would hurt
example: Insisting the startup was fine while payroll bounced was self-delusion, and his cofounder said so.

hindi: आत्म-उपहास — खुद को हल्का करके पेश करना
definition: making light of yourself and your abilities, often with humour, to seem modest or to disarm criticism
example: His self-deprecating remark about his cooking got a laugh before anyone could complain.

hindi: आत्म-विनाशक — अपने ही हित को चोट पहुँचाने वाला व्यवहार
definition: acting in ways that damage your own well-being, relationships or prospects, often while knowing it
example: Picking a fight with his only ally on the team was self-destructive, and he knew it as he did it.

hindi: आत्म-अनुशासन — मन न होते हुए भी नियमित प्रयास जारी रखना
definition: the steady ability to make yourself do what needs doing despite boredom, tiredness or temptation to stop
example: Her self-discipline showed in the way she opened the textbook every night even after a long shift.

hindi: आत्मग्लानि — अपने आचरण से उपजी घृणा
definition: a sick feeling of revulsion at your own behaviour or body, the disgust reflex turned inward
example: She deleted the drunken messages the next morning with a hot flush of self-disgust.

hindi: आत्म-संदेह — अपनी योग्यता और निर्णयों पर भरोसा न होना
definition: an uneasy questioning of your own abilities and choices that undermines confidence before you have even tried
example: Self-doubt crept in halfway through the essay and he deleted three paragraphs that were perfectly fine.

hindi: आत्मगोपन — खुद को पीछे रखने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the habit of keeping yourself in the background and drawing attention away from your own contributions
example: His self-effacement was so complete that the client left believing the intern had designed the whole system.

hindi: आत्म-क्षमता का बोध — काम पूरा कर पाने का भरोसा
definition: the psychological belief that you can carry out the actions needed to reach a goal
example: Every small fix she shipped raised her self-efficacy a little more.

hindi: आत्मसम्मान — अपने मूल्य की स्थिर भावना
definition: the settled feeling of confidence and respect you hold toward your own worth and abilities, which can be healthy or damaged
example: Her self-esteem took a hit when the feedback form came back covered in red ink.

hindi: आत्म-प्रताड़ना — खुद को कोड़े मारने जैसा दंड
definition: excessive, almost ritual punishing of yourself for a fault, dwelling on it far past the point of usefulness
example: Rereading the failed pitch for the tenth time was pure self-flagellation.

hindi: आत्म-चाटुकारिता — अपने बारे में मीठी झूठी धारणाएँ पालना
definition: telling yourself pleasing things about your own abilities or motives that are kinder than the truth
example: It was pure self-flattery to think the meeting had gone well because everyone laughed at his jokes.

hindi: आत्म-क्षमा — स्वयं को माफ़ करना
definition: the deliberate letting go of guilt and blame toward yourself after accepting a mistake
example: Self-forgiveness came slowly after the accident that was not really her fault.

hindi: स्व-द्वेष — खुद से बैर
definition: an intense, persistent dislike of who you are, felt as a personal enemy living inside your own head
example: Her therapist gently pointed out how much self-hatred was hidden in her jokes.

hindi: आत्म-छवि — अपने बारे में मन में बनी तस्वीर
definition: the picture you carry of your own appearance, abilities and character, which may be kinder or harsher than the truth
example: Being called the reliable one clashed with his self-image as a bit of a rebel.

hindi: आत्ममहत्व की भावना — खुद को बहुत ज़रूरी मानना
definition: an exaggerated sense of your own significance and value, which makes you expect that others should treat your time and opinions as special
example: His self-importance showed when he demanded the meeting be moved so it would not clash with his lunch.

hindi: आत्म-भोग — अपनी ही इच्छाओं में डूबे रहना
definition: the habit of treating your own comfort and pleasure as what matters most, gratifying every whim rather than holding back for anyone
example: Spending the whole weekend in bed with takeaway and a box set felt like glorious self-indulgence.

hindi: आत्म-औचित्य — अपनी गलती को सही ठहराने की बेचैनी
definition: the defensive urge to explain away your own questionable behaviour so you can keep feeling you were right
example: His long message about why he missed the deadline was more self-justification than apology.

hindi: आत्मघृणा — स्वयं से गहरी नफ़रत
definition: intense hatred and disgust directed at oneself, often after failing to live up to your own standards
example: After snapping at his daughter he lay awake in a fog of self-loathing, replaying every word.

hindi: आत्मप्रेम — अपने प्रति स्नेह, जो कभी घमंड में बदल जाता है
definition: regard for your own wellbeing and happiness, which is healthy in moderation but can shade into vanity when excessive
example: She called the spa weekend an act of self-love, though her sister said it was just an excuse to skip the family dinner.

hindi: आत्म-संयम — अपनी भावनाओं और इच्छाओं पर पूर्ण नियंत्रण
definition: a hard-won command over your own impulses, moods and appetites, so that you act from choice rather than urge
example: Not replying to the rude message for a full day was a small victory of self-mastery.

hindi: आत्म-मुग्ध — अपने रूप, छवि और जीवन के प्रति जुनूनी
definition: compulsively focused on your own appearance, image and story, checking and polishing them so constantly that little else holds your attention
example: He was so self-obsessed that he retook the group photo six times until his own angle looked right.

hindi: आत्म-दया — अपनी ही हालत पर तरस
