definition: excessive sorrow for one's own troubles, an unhappiness that turns inward and feeds on itself
example: After the breakup he spent a week in self-pity, replaying every unfair thing that had happened to him.

hindi: आत्मसंयमी — भावनाओं पर पूरा नियंत्रण रखने वाला
definition: calm, confident and fully in control of your feelings and reactions when others might flinch
example: The self-possessed intern answered the hostile question without a flicker of panic.

hindi: आत्म-दंड — अपनी गलती के लिए स्वयं को सज़ा देना
definition: deliberately denying yourself pleasure or inflicting hardship on yourself to pay for something you feel guilty about
example: Skipping the party as self-punishment for failing the test did not make her feel any better.

hindi: आत्म-दोषारोपण — बार-बार खुद को कोसना
definition: bitter, accusing blame directed at yourself for a wrong you cannot undo, harsher and more relentless than simple regret
example: After the launch failed he sank into self-recrimination for weeks.

hindi: आत्मादर — अपने बारे में ऊँची राय
definition: the level of respect and consideration you have for yourself, especially when it is high enough to seem like vanity
example: His self-regard was such that he assumed the whole meeting had been called to hear his opinion.

hindi: आत्मनिर्भरता — दूसरों पर निर्भर न होने का भरोसा
definition: confident reliance on your own resources and judgement rather than on help from others
example: Living alone abroad taught him a self-reliance he never needed at home.

hindi: आत्म-भर्त्सना — स्वयं को दोष देना
definition: the quiet, repeated blaming of yourself for a mistake, turned inward instead of spoken aloud
example: She spent the train ride home in self-reproach over the missed deadline.

hindi: स्वाभिमान — अपनी गरिमा बनाए रखने की भावना
definition: a quiet pride in your own dignity and standards that makes you refuse to be treated badly or to act beneath yourself
example: She kept her self-respect by declining the job offer once they mentioned unpaid weekend shifts.

hindi: आत्म-निग्रह — तीव्र इच्छा के बावजूद स्वयं को रोक लेना
definition: holding back an urge to speak, react or indulge, choosing composure even when the feeling pushing you is strong
example: It took real self-restraint not to correct his boss's wrong figures in front of the client.

hindi: आत्मधर्मी — अपने को नैतिक रूप से श्रेष्ठ मानने वाला
definition: smugly convinced that your own moral views are correct and that people who disagree are not merely mistaken but wicked
example: His self-righteous lecture about recycling went on so long that the rest of the kitchen quietly finished lunch and left.

hindi: आत्म-विध्वंस — सफलता के डर से अपने ही रास्ते में रोड़े अटकाना
definition: undermining your own goals through procrastination or reckless choices, often out of hidden fear of succeeding
example: Leaving the application until an hour before the deadline was classic self-sabotage.

hindi: आत्म-बलिदान — दूसरों की भलाई के लिए अपना सुख छोड़ देना
definition: willingly giving up your own comfort, time or advantage for someone else's good, with a quiet steadiness rather than any wish for thanks
example: Covering the weekend shifts so a colleague could attend the wedding was a small self-sacrifice he never mentioned.

hindi: आत्मतुष्ट — अपनी उपलब्धि से अति प्रसन्न और निश्चिंत
definition: showing a comfortable, complacent pleasure in your own achievements or qualities, with no sense that anything could be improved
example: He leaned back with a self-satisfied grin after the client approved the design without a single change.

hindi: स्व-सांत्वना — खुद को शांत करने की क्षमता
definition: the ability to calm your own distress through familiar comforting actions rather than depending on others
example: Humming while she tidies the desk is her go-to self-soothing before a big call.

hindi: आत्म-पुष्टि — अपनी भावनाओं और मूल्य को स्वयं मान्यता देना
definition: affirming that your own feelings and worth are legitimate without waiting for someone else to approve of them
example: Instead of refreshing for likes, she practised self-validation by deciding the essay was good on her own terms.

hindi: आत्ममूल्य — अपने मूल्यवान होने का बोध
definition: the inner sense that you deserve respect and happiness regardless of what you achieve or what others think
example: Losing the contract dented his self-worth so badly that he stopped applying for anything for months.

hindi: स्वार्थी — केवल अपने लाभ की परवाह करने वाला
definition: caring chiefly about your own gain, pleasure or comfort and willing to let other people lose out so that you come first
example: Taking the last two slices when three people had not eaten yet was plainly selfish.

hindi: परमार्थी — अपने हित की चिंता किए बिना दूसरों के लिए
definition: acting entirely for the good of other people with no thought of reward, credit or personal gain, often at real cost to yourself
example: The selfless nurse kept coming back on her days off to sit with patients who had no visitors.

hindi: रोमांच की तलाश — नए और तीव्र अनुभवों की चाह
definition: psychology's term for the personality trait of craving intense, novel and risky experiences
example: Her sensation seeking explained the skydiving trips and the spontaneous move abroad.

hindi: भावनात्मक भावनाओं के प्रति संवेदनशीलता (स्वयं और दूसरों की संवेदनशीलता)
definition: sensitivity to emotional feelings (of self and others)

hindi: इंद्रिय-अतिभार — शोर, रोशनी और भीड़ से घबराहट
definition: distress and confusion caused by more sights, sounds and sensations than the mind can process
example: The crowded mall at Christmas gave her sensory overload and she fled to the car.

hindi: शरीर की भूख और जुनून द्वारा चिह्नित
definition: marked by the appetites and passions of the body
example: Animal instincts.

hindi: कामुक सुख की इच्छा
definition: desire for sensual pleasures

hindi: कामुक सुख की इच्छा
definition: desire for sensual pleasures

hindi: कामुक सुख की इच्छा
definition: desire for sensual pleasures

hindi: सुंदरता में प्रसन्न होना
definition: taking delight in beauty
example: The sensuous joy from all things fair.

hindi: एक संवेदनशील भावना
definition: a sensuous feeling

hindi: निविदा, रोमांटिक, या उदासीन भावना या भावना
definition: tender, romantic, or nostalgic feeling or emotion

hindi: भावना या भावना द्वारा दिए गए या चिह्नित
definition: given to or marked by sentiment or sentimentality

hindi: भावुकता — अतीत या कोमल चीज़ों पर ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा भावुक होना
definition: an excess of tender, nostalgic feeling that is a little softer and sweeter than the occasion deserves
example: He kept every train ticket from their trips out of pure sentimentality.

hindi: भावुक बनाना — किसी चीज़ को वास्तविकता से अधिक भावपूर्ण रूप देना
definition: to treat something as more tender and touching than it really deserves, softening the hard facts
example: The documentary sentimentalized the factory years and left out the strikes.

hindi: वियोग चिंता — किसी प्रिय से दूर होने पर होने वाली घबराहट
definition: the distress and worry felt when parted from a person or place that gives a sense of safety
example: The puppy's separation anxiety meant it howled every time she left for the office.

hindi: नहीं; आत्म-स्थिति खोए बिना
definition: not agitated; without losing self-possession
example: Spoke in a calm voice.

hindi: प्रशांति — अविचलित शांति की अवस्था
definition: a calm, untroubled peacefulness of mind that nothing outside seems able to disturb
example: She reached a rare serenity on the early train, before the emails started.

hindi: सबसे अमीर और ईमानदार भावना
definition: an earnest and sincere feeling

hindi: दासभाव — आत्मसम्मान त्यागकर की गई अति विनम्रता
definition: an excessive, cringing eagerness to please and obey, deference that has given up all self-respect
example: The waiter's servility toward the loud table made the other diners uncomfortable.

hindi: शांत होना — उथल-पुथल के बाद मन का स्थिर होना
definition: to become calmer and steadier after agitation, nerves or upset have gradually faded
example: His stomach began to settle once the first slide of the presentation was behind him.

hindi: स्थिर — बेचैनी के बाद मन का टिक जाना
definition: calmly established and secure after a period of unrest, with the restlessness gone and life feeling in place
example: Six months into the new city, she finally felt settled enough to hang pictures on the wall.

hindi: परम हर्ष — सर्वोच्च सुख की अवस्था
definition: a state of the highest possible happiness, as if lifted to the topmost level of heaven
example: When the band replied to her message she was in seventh heaven for the rest of the week.

hindi: कड़ाई — बिना कोमलता की कठोर गंभीरता
definition: harsh and unbending in tone, treating people with a strictness that offers no warmth or leniency
example: Her severe response to the missed deadline left the junior designer close to tears.

hindi: हिला हुआ — भावनात्मक रूप से झकझोरा
definition: emotionally disturbed and unsteady after a shocking or frightening experience, still trembling inside
example: She was still shaken hours after the cyclist swerved into her path on the way to work.

hindi: कांपता हुआ — घबराहट के कारण अस्थिर और कमज़ोर महसूस करना
definition: trembling and unsteady from nerves or shock, with a voice or hands that will not hold still
example: She felt shaky after the phone call and had to sit on the stairs before telling anyone the news.

hindi: एक दर्दनाक भावना जिसके परिणामस्वरूप अपर्याप्तता या अपराध के बारे में जागरूकता होती है
definition: a painful emotion resulting from an awareness of inadequacy or guilt

hindi: शर्म आती है या बेईमान हो जाती है
definition: bring shame or dishonor upon
example: He dishonored his family by committing a serious crime.

hindi: अत्यंत मामूली या शर्मीला; - H.O. टेलर
definition: extremely modest or shy; - H.O.Taylor
example: Cheerfully bearing reproaches but shamefaced at praise.

hindi: अपने बारे में शर्मिंदा महसूस करना
definition: feeling embarrassed about yourself

hindi: शर्मनाक — जिससे लज्जा उपजे
definition: deserving of shame because the behaviour is so wrong that it brings disgrace on the person who did it, judged by others as much as felt
example: The way they ignored the new hire at lunch was shameful.

hindi: बेशर्म — लज्जा से रहित
definition: showing no shame at all about behaviour others would find disgraceful, and often openly proud of it
example: His shameless bragging about cheating the timesheet got him reported.

hindi: तेज़ ज़बान वाला — कटु और चुभने वाले बोल बोलने वाला
definition: given to harsh, cutting speech that wounds people, often out of impatience or contempt rather than deliberate cruelty
example: The sharp-tongued editor could reduce a nervous intern to silence with a single question.

hindi: टूटा हुआ — सदमे से मन के टुकड़े हुए
definition: emotionally broken into pieces by a loss or betrayal, unable to feel whole or steady afterwards
example: He sounded shattered on the phone after his best friend admitted taking the credit for his work.

hindi: झेंपा हुआ — हल्की शर्म से मुस्कराता
definition: showing mild, slightly comic embarrassment about a small fault, often with a guilty half-smile
example: He gave a sheepish grin when the group chat noticed he had replied to himself.

hindi: अपने बारे में शर्मिंदा महसूस करना
definition: feeling embarrassed about yourself

hindi: युद्ध आघात — भीषण अनुभव के बाद की सुन्न और काँपती दशा
definition: the older name for the shaking, numb and haunted state of soldiers after prolonged bombardment, now used loosely for anyone stunned by a shocking experience
example: The survivors walked out of the collapsed office with a look of shell shock, answering the paramedics in single words.

hindi: आघात से सुन्न — बड़े झटके के बाद स्तब्ध
definition: left dazed and emotionally numb after an overwhelming series of shocks or a traumatic event
example: The shell-shocked staff wandered the office after learning the company would close in a week.

hindi: सुरक्षित — कठिनाई और खतरे से बचा हुआ
definition: protected from harm, hardship and the rough side of life, safe and looked after
example: She had a sheltered childhood in a small town where every neighbour knew her name.

hindi: तुनकमिज़ाज — जल्दी चिढ़कर बदतमीज़ हो जाना
definition: bad-tempered and rudely annoyed, especially in a huffy way when one feels wronged
example: He got shirty with the delivery driver over a five-minute delay.

hindi: सिहरना — भय या रोमांच से बदन में झुरझुरी होना
definition: to shake briefly with a quick, cold rippling movement brought on by fear, dread or a sudden thrill
example: He shivered when the footsteps upstairs stopped right above his bedroom.

hindi: जब आप गलती से कुछ बुरा होता है, तो संकट और असंतुष्टता की भावना
definition: the feeling of distress and disbelief that you have when something bad happens accidentally
example: His mother's death left him in a daze.

hindi: क्रोधी स्वभाव — जल्दी गुस्सा हो जाने वाला
definition: quick to lose one's temper, with very little patience before anger flares
example: He gets short-tempered when he is hungry, so we always eat before the long meetings.

hindi: ठगा हुआ — उचित हिस्सा न मिलने का क्षोभ
definition: aggrieved at having been given less than your fair share, cheated of what you had a right to expect
example: The freelancers felt shortchanged when the bonus went entirely to the in-house staff.

hindi: दिखावेबाज़ — अपनी योग्यता या चीज़ें जताकर प्रभावित करने वाला
definition: a person who deliberately displays their skills or possessions to impress others and win admiration
example: The show-off at the gym grunted loudly so everyone would notice how much weight he was lifting.

hindi: छटपटाहट — बैठे न रह पाने वाली घबराई हुई बेचैनी
definition: a jittery restless impatience that makes it impossible to sit still, nervous energy with nowhere to go
example: With the interview at two, she had such shpilkes by noon that she walked around the block three times.

hindi: कर्कशा — झगड़ालू और कटु स्वभाव की स्त्री
definition: an irritable, aggressively nagging woman who scolds constantly, an old-fashioned and unkind label
example: The sitcom's writers leaned on the tired cliché of the shrew who berates her husband at breakfast.

hindi: कर्कश-झगड़ालू — लगातार डांटने वाली तीखी चिड़चिड़ाहट
definition: bad-tempered and constantly scolding in a nagging, complaining way that wears people down
example: The shrewish tone of the neighbourhood group chat made him mute it for good.

hindi: चीखना — भय या रोमांच में कर्कश तीखी चीख
definition: to utter a sudden piercing scream from terror, sharp pain or wild excitement
example: She shrieked when a spider dropped from the kitchen cupboard onto her arm.

hindi: कर्कश तीखी — गुस्से या घबराहट में ऊंची होती आवाज़
definition: high-pitched and piercing in a way that betrays anger, panic or rising agitation
example: Her voice turned shrill as the customer service line put her on hold yet again.

hindi: डर की लगभग सुखद सनसनी
definition: an almost pleasurable sensation of fright
example: A frisson of surprise shot through him.

hindi: भयभीत आतंकवाद
definition: provoking fear terror
example: A scary movie.

hindi: उपेक्षित — लोगों द्वारा जानबूझकर दूर रखा गया
definition: deliberately avoided and ignored by people who once accepted you, left to feel rejected and unwanted
example: He felt shunned when former colleagues crossed the street rather than speak to him after the scandal.

hindi: शर्मिंदगी के डर की भावना
definition: a feeling of fear of embarrassment

hindi: भाई-बहन की प्रतिद्वंद्विता — माता-पिता के ध्यान के लिए होड़
definition: the competition and resentment between brothers and sisters for parents' attention, praise and approval
example: The sibling rivalry never quite faded, and at forty the two brothers still compared bonuses at every family dinner.

hindi: में परिवर्तन का कारण बनता है; नैतिक भावना को रोकना
definition: cause aversion in; offend the moral sense of
example: The pornographic pictures sickened us.

hindi: में परिवर्तन का कारण बनता है; नैतिक भावना को रोकना
definition: cause aversion in; offend the moral sense of
example: The pornographic pictures sickened us.

hindi: पेट पकड़कर हँसाने वाला — अत्यधिक हास्यपूर्ण
definition: extremely funny, causing laughter so hard that your sides seem to ache from it
example: His retelling of the airport mix-up was side-splitting even the third time we heard it.

hindi: आह भरना — उदासी, थकान या चाह में गहरी साँस छोड़ना
definition: to release a long, audible breath that shows weariness, sadness, longing or relief
example: She sighed at the pile of dishes and started the tap running.

hindi: मौन दंड — नाराज़गी में बात करना बंद कर देना
definition: punishing someone by refusing to speak to them, using cold silence to express anger and hurt
example: Three days of the silent treatment over one forgotten text made the flat feel like a waiting room.

hindi: सुलगना — दबा हुआ गुस्सा धीरे-धीरे उबलना
definition: to be filled with suppressed anger that stays just below the point of breaking out
example: She simmered all through dinner and finally brought up the forgotten anniversary at dessert.

hindi: सहज मेल-जोल — स्वभाव के मेल से तुरंत भाने वाला और प्रिय
definition: instantly likeable and easy to get along with, sharing a natural sympathy of temperament with someone
example: The new hire and her manager were so simpatico that they finished each other's sentences by the second meeting.

hindi: बनावटी मुस्कान देना — चापलूसी भरी, नकली मुस्कुराहट
definition: to smile in a silly, affected or self-conscious way that seems put on to please or flatter someone
example: The intern simpered at every joke the director made during the meeting.

hindi: सबसे अमीर और ईमानदार भावना
definition: an earnest and sincere feeling

hindi: एकनिष्ठ — एक ही लक्ष्य पर पूरा ध्यान टिकाने वाला
definition: giving all one's attention and effort to one goal with fixed determination, ignoring every distraction
example: She was single-minded about finishing the marathon and skipped every party that spring.

hindi: बहनापा — महिलाओं के बीच साझा एकजुटता और सहारा
definition: the feeling of solidarity, loyalty and mutual support among women who recognise each other's struggles as their own
example: The sisterhood in that book club got two of its members through divorces in the same year.

hindi: अडिग जीवट — साधारण हिम्मत चुक जाने पर भी डटे रहने का शांत हठ
definition: stubborn quiet determination and inner grit that keeps you going long after ordinary courage is exhausted
example: It was pure sisu that got her through the last ten kilometres of the marathon in the rain.

hindi: संशयी — किसी दावे को बिना सबूत न मानने वाला
definition: unwilling to accept a claim until you have seen convincing proof, doubting the story rather than the person
example: She was skeptical of the app's promise to double her savings and asked to see the fine print first.

hindi: संशयवादी रवैया — दावों को बिना प्रमाण न मानने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: a questioning attitude that holds back belief until there is good reason to accept a claim
example: The team greeted the promise of a bug-free release with polite skepticism.

hindi: भड़कने वाला — छोटी सी बात पर चौंककर घबरा जाने वाला
definition: nervous and easily startled, likely to bolt at the slightest unexpected sound or movement
example: The investors were skittish after the news and pulled out at the first sign of trouble.

hindi: मुँह खुला हुआ — आश्चर्य से जबड़ा लटका
definition: gaping with the mouth hanging open in dumb astonishment or stupefied wonder
example: The slack-jawed commuters watched a man carry a full-size fridge onto the train.

hindi: पूरी तरह से गैर जिम्मेदार
definition: cheerfully irresponsible
example: Carefree with his money.

hindi: भ्रष्ट और गंदा — नैतिक रूप से घृणित और सस्ता
definition: morally low and disreputable in a way that feels dirty, especially where money or sex is involved
example: The sleazy landlord offered to lower the rent if she came round to discuss it alone one evening.

hindi: उपेक्षा करना — किसी को तुच्छ समझकर आहत करना
definition: to insult someone by treating them as unimportant, leaving them feeling snubbed and resentful
example: She felt slighted when the manager thanked everyone on the team except her.

hindi: उपेक्षित — अपमानित या नज़रअंदाज़ महसूस करना
definition: feeling hurt because someone treated you as less important than you deserved to be treated
example: She felt slighted when the invitation went to everyone on the floor except her.

hindi: दबे पाँव खिसक जाना — शर्म या अपराध-बोध में चुपके से निकलना
definition: to move quietly and furtively, keeping low, out of guilt, shame or the wish not to be noticed
example: He slunk out of the meeting room after admitting the report was late because of him.

hindi: धीमा उबाल — धीरे-धीरे भीतर सुलगता, देर से फूटता गुस्सा
definition: anger or resentment that builds quietly and gradually beneath a controlled surface before it finally shows
example: Watching him take credit again started a slow burn that lasted until the retrospective.

hindi: सुस्त — धीमा, भारी और ऊर्जा से खाली
definition: slow-moving and lacking energy or alertness, as if your body and thoughts were wading through something thick
example: After the heavy lunch the whole office turned sluggish and the afternoon meeting dragged.

hindi: निराशा में ढह जाना — हताश होकर बेजान बैठ जाना
definition: to sink heavily into a chair or against a wall with shoulders dropped, showing exhaustion or dejection
example: He slumped onto the sofa after the interview and did not speak for an hour.

hindi: धूर्त चुहल — छिपे हुए मज़ाक की चालाक झलक
definition: quietly cunning and playfully secretive in manner, hinting at a private joke or hidden meaning with mischievous amusement
example: He gave a sly grin when the recipe asked for a splash of wine and he poured himself a glass too.

hindi: संकीर्ण-हृदय — छोटी सोच और तुच्छ द्वेष वाला
definition: petty and intolerant in outlook, obsessed with trivial grievances and quick to resent anyone who thinks differently
example: It was small-minded of him to report a colleague for taking a slightly longer lunch.

hindi: चिकनी बनावटी शालीनता — झूठी गर्मजोशी
definition: showing warmth and friendliness in an oily insincere way that feels like flattery
example: The smarmy salesman kept calling her a genius for choosing the bigger plan.

hindi: अपमान की चुभन महसूस करना — आहत होकर टीस से भर उठना
definition: to feel the sharp sting of a hurt or insult, pride wounded and still throbbing
example: She was still smarting from the comment about her presentation an hour later.

hindi: व्यंग्य से मुस्कुराना — आत्मतुष्ट, चिढ़ाने वाली मुस्कान
definition: to smile in a smug, knowing or mocking way that shows you feel pleased with yourself at someone else's expense
example: He smirked when his sister's cake collapsed in the oven, having warned her it would.

hindi: प्रेम में मोहित — किसी पर अचानक और पूरी तरह दिल आ जाना
definition: suddenly and completely taken with someone, struck by a fresh affection that makes you a little foolish
example: He was so smitten after the first date that he read her text message eleven times on the train home.

hindi: दबा देना — किसी भावना को बाहर आने से ज़बरदस्ती रोकना
definition: to force a strong feeling down and out of sight, pressing back anger, grief or laughter so hard that it is almost extinguished
example: He smothered his disappointment and congratulated the colleague who got the promotion instead of him.

hindi: सुलगते रहना — क्रोध का बिना भड़के जलते रहना
definition: to burn with a slow, hidden anger or resentment that persists without flaring into the open
example: Resentment smouldered in the department for months after the layoffs.

hindi: सुलगता हुआ — दबा हुआ पर तीव्र आवेश या इच्छा दिखाने वाला
definition: showing intense passion that is held back and burns slowly beneath the surface instead of flaring
example: The smouldering look he gave her across the office kitchen said more than any message could.

hindi: अत्यधिक संगतता या आत्म-संवेदन द्वारा चिह्नित
definition: marked by excessive complacency or self-satisfaction
example: A smug glow of self-congratulation.

hindi: आत्म संतुष्टि की अत्यधिक भावना
definition: an excessive feeling of self-satisfaction

hindi: झल्लाकर बोलना — चिढ़कर अचानक तीखे शब्दों में फट पड़ना
definition: to speak suddenly in a sharp irritated voice, your patience breaking over something small
example: She snapped at the kids for asking about dinner before she had taken her coat off.

hindi: झिड़कने वाला चिड़चिड़ापन — तीखे जवाब देने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: inclined to answer sharply and curtly out of irritation, biting off short replies like a snapping dog
example: The nurse was snappish with everyone by the end of a fourteen-hour shift.

hindi: व्यंग्यपूर्ण-चिढ़ा — कटाक्ष भरी खिन्नता
definition: irritable in a sarcastic, mocking manner, releasing your annoyance through clever cutting remarks rather than open anger
example: The replies in the group chat got snarky once the plans fell through for the third time.

hindi: गुर्राना — गुस्से में कर्कश स्वर में बोलना
definition: to speak in a harsh, angry, aggressive tone, like a dog baring its teeth
example: The driver snarled at the cyclist to get out of the way.

hindi: उपहास करना — तिरस्कार भरी मुस्कान से हँसना
definition: to smile or speak in a scornful, contemptuous way that shows you look down on someone
example: He sneered at the homemade costume, then lost the contest to it.

hindi: दबी हुई उपहास की हँसी — किसी की भूल पर छिपकर हँसना
definition: to laugh in a half-hidden, slightly mocking way at someone else's mistake or awkwardness
example: Someone snickered when the new guy tried to open the pull door by pushing it.

hindi: कुटिल-व्यंग्यपूर्ण — दबे तौर पर अपमान करने वाला
definition: mocking and spiteful in an indirect, sneaky way that lets the speaker deny meaning offence
example: Her snide remark about his second-hand shoes was delivered with a perfectly innocent smile.

hindi: नाक सिकोड़ना — तिरस्कार या उपेक्षा में नाक से आवाज़ के साथ बोलना
definition: to speak with a short intake of breath through the nose that signals disdain, scorn or wounded pride
example: She sniffed that she would never shop somewhere that played music that loud.

hindi: सुबकना — रोते हुए या रोना रोकते हुए नाक से हल्की आवाज़ करना
definition: to sniff repeatedly and quietly while crying or trying to hold back tears
example: She sniffled through the whole wedding speech and blamed it on hay fever.

hindi: नाक सिकोड़ने वाला — हल्के तिरस्कार से अस्वीकृति दिखाना
definition: showing mild disdain, as if wrinkling your nose at something you consider not quite good enough
example: The sommelier was a bit sniffy when they ordered the cheapest bottle on the list.

hindi: दबी हुई उपहास की हँसी — छिपाकर मज़ाक उड़ाना
definition: to laugh in a half-suppressed, sly, mocking and disrespectful way at something that should not be laughed at
example: A couple of boys sniggered when the new teacher tripped over the projector lead.

hindi: कटाक्ष करना — दबे स्वर में चुभती आलोचना करना
definition: to make sly, critical remarks from the sidelines, attacking someone indirectly out of resentment or spite
example: Instead of raising the issue in the meeting, he kept sniping about the schedule in private messages afterwards.

hindi: छिपे वार — तीखी और तुच्छ आलोचना की झड़ी
definition: a steady run of petty, spiteful criticisms aimed at someone from the sidelines rather than in an open argument
example: The constant sniping in the comments section wore the volunteer moderators down.

hindi: रुखा-चिढ़ा — छोटे तीखे जवाबों में झलकती खिन्नता
definition: curt and irritable, answering in short sharp bursts because your patience wore thin
example: Sorry I was snippy earlier, I had been on hold with the bank for forty minutes.

hindi: तुनकमिज़ाजी का दौरा — क्षणिक चिड़चिड़ा रोष
definition: a brief sulky fit of bad temper over something small, an annoyed mood that passes quickly
example: She left the meeting in a snit because her slide had been skipped.

hindi: नाक सुड़कते हुए रोना — दयनीय ढंग से रोना-धोना
definition: to weep and sniff in a weak self-pitying manner that others find hard to sympathise with
example: He snivelled about the referee's decision all the way home from the match.

hindi: दंभी — खुद को नीचे वालों से श्रेष्ठ मानकर तिरस्कार करने वाला
definition: a person who feels superior because of class, taste or wealth and looks down on those they consider inferior
example: The wine snob at dinner sniffed at the supermarket bottle before anyone had tasted it.

hindi: दंभ — निम्न वर्ग या रुचि को तुच्छ समझने का घमंड
definition: the attitude of believing that your social class, taste or education makes you superior and that people of lower standing deserve contempt
example: The snobbery in the office was obvious when the new hire's supermarket coffee was mocked at the morning stand-up.

hindi: दंभी — वर्ग या रुचि के आधार पर तिरस्कार करने वाला
definition: feeling contempt for people considered of lower class, taste or education, and admiring those considered superior
example: His snobbish remark about supermarket wine silenced the dinner table for a moment.

hindi: ताक-झांक करना — छिपकर दूसरों के निजी मामलों की जानकारी लेना
definition: to look secretly into other people's private affairs or belongings out of curiosity
example: He caught his flatmate trying to snoop through his messages while the phone was charging.

hindi: नकचढ़ा — स्वयं को ऊँचा और दूसरों को हीन मानने वाला
definition: showing a smug sense of social superiority that looks down on ordinary people and ordinary things
example: The snooty shop assistant looked at her rain-soaked coat and asked whether she was lost.

hindi: नाक से फुफकारना — तिरस्कार, अविश्वास या दबी हँसी में नाक से आवाज़ निकालना
definition: to force air noisily through the nose to show contempt, disbelief or a laugh you tried to swallow
example: He snorted when the estate agent described the cupboard as a second bedroom.

hindi: घमंडी-रूखा — तिरस्कार भरा अहंकार
definition: haughty and rudely dismissive, treating others with superior contempt, as though they were beneath notice
example: The receptionist got snotty when he asked whether the appointment could be moved.

hindi: जानबूझकर उपेक्षा करना — तिरस्कार से अनदेखा करना
definition: to insult someone deliberately by ignoring them or treating them coldly in a way they are meant to notice
example: She snubbed her former manager at the conference by walking straight past his outstretched hand.

hindi: आरामदेह गरमाहट — छोटी सुरक्षित जगह में गरम और निश्चिंत
definition: comfortably warm and protected in a small enclosed space, feeling sheltered from the cold or weather outside
example: With the rain hammering the window and a blanket over her knees, she felt perfectly snug on the sofa.

hindi: सिमटकर सटना — गर्माहट और स्नेह के लिए किसी से चिपक जाना
definition: to settle closely and cosily against someone in a soft, affectionate way, seeking warmth and comfort
example: The dog snuggled against her feet on the train home and refused to move until her stop.

hindi: सिसकियाँ लेकर रोना — गहरे दुःख में हिचकियों के साथ रोना
definition: to weep with loud, gasping, convulsive breaths because grief or distress has overwhelmed you
example: She sobbed into her jacket on the train home after the phone call about her grandfather.

hindi: गंभीर-संयत — शांत, सतर्क और उत्तेजना से दूर
definition: serious, calm and free of excitement or exaggeration in temper and judgement, weighing things coolly where others get carried away
example: Amid the hype about the launch, her sober assessment of the numbers cooled the room.

hindi: गंभीर कर देने वाला — हँसी उड़ा कर गहरी सोच में डालने वाला
definition: making you suddenly serious and thoughtful by revealing a hard truth, so that lighter moods drain away
example: Seeing the flood photos from his hometown was a sobering start to what had been a cheerful commute.

hindi: मिलनसार — लोगों से मिलने-जुलने में सहज और खुश
definition: warmly enjoying the company of other people and eager to talk and spend time with them
example: The sociable new neighbour had learned every name on the floor within a week of moving in.

hindi: सामाजिक चिंता — लोगों के बीच जाने और उनके आकलन का भय
definition: an intense worry about being watched and judged by other people, making ordinary gatherings feel like tests
example: His social anxiety meant he rehearsed a greeting in the lift before walking into the team drinks.

hindi: मिलनसार — हर जगह मेलजोल में खुशी से उड़ते-फिरते रहने वाला
definition: a sociable, outgoing person who flits happily between friends and gatherings and thrives on company
example: A true social butterfly, she had three brunch invitations before the weekend even started.

hindi: सामाजिक संक्रमण — भावना या व्यवहार का समूह में फैल जाना
definition: the spread of a mood, behaviour or belief from person to person through a group, catching on like an infection
example: Quitting spread through the team by social contagion, one resignation setting off the next.

hindi: कमज़ोरी — किसी के लिए विशेष स्नेह और नरमी
definition: a warm, indulgent fondness for a particular person or thing that makes you forgive its flaws and enjoy it anyway
example: The strict editor had a soft spot for the trainee who kept bringing him terrible puns.

hindi: मृदुभाषी — धीमी, कोमल और शांत आवाज़ में बोलने वाला
definition: speaking in a gentle, quiet voice that suggests a calm and unaggressive nature, never raised even in disagreement
example: The soft-spoken mediator somehow got both shouting neighbours to lower their voices within minutes.

hindi: कोमल होना — भावों में सख्ती की जगह नरमी आना
definition: to become gentler and kinder in feeling as sternness or hostility gradually fades
example: His tone began to soften once he realised the intern had been up all night on the fix.

hindi: आसानी से दया या दु:ख के लिए ले जाया जाता है
definition: easily moved to pity or sorrow
example: A softhearted judge.

hindi: किसी के कल्याण के लिए चिंता की भावना (विशेष रूप से कोई रक्षाहीन)
definition: a feeling of concern for the welfare of someone (especially someone defenseless)

hindi: नरम दिल — भावनाओं में आसानी से पिघल जाने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: an affectionate name for a person who is tender and easily moved to sympathy despite a tougher outward manner
example: The gruff security guard turned out to be a softie who fed the stray cats every evening.

hindi: जब आप निराशा के समय सांत्वना करते हैं तो आपको आराम महसूस होता है
definition: the comfort you feel when consoled in times of disappointment
example: Second place was no consolation to him.

hindi: तरीके या चरित्र में गरिमा और सोम और वादा रखने के लिए प्रतिबद्ध
definition: dignified and somber in manner or character and committed to keeping promises
example: A grave God-fearing man.

hindi: गंभीरता — गहरी और आदरपूर्ण गंभीरता का भाव
definition: a deep serious dignity that a moment or ceremony carries, calling for quiet respectful feeling
example: The solemnity of the minute's silence reached even the noisy corner of the trading floor.

hindi: चिंता और चिंता से भरा
definition: full of anxiety and concern
example: Solicitous parents.

hindi: अत्यधिक चिंता की भावना
definition: a feeling of excessive concern

hindi: अत्यधिक चिंता की भावना
definition: a feeling of excessive concern

hindi: एकांतप्रिय — अकेले रहने वाला या रहना पसंद करने वाला
definition: living or spending time alone, whether by choice or by circumstance, without any particular sadness implied
example: He was a solitary person who genuinely preferred a quiet evening with a book to a crowded pub.

hindi: एकांत — चुना हुआ शांत अकेलापन
definition: the peaceful condition of being alone by choice, often welcomed as rest from other people rather than felt as loneliness
example: She treasured the solitude of the early train, the one hour of the day nobody could ask her for anything.

hindi: गंभीर और उदास — शांत, भारी और शोकपूर्ण मनोभाव
definition: serious, dark and quietly sorrowful in mood or tone, without any lightness
example: The mood in the group chat turned somber when the news about the coach came through.

hindi: गंभीर उदासी — शांत, गहरा और मंद
definition: serious and quietly sorrowful in mood, a dark, subdued feeling with no lightness in it
example: The group chat went sombre when someone shared the news about the accident.

hindi: नैतिक या भावनात्मक ताकत देने के लिए
definition: give moral or emotional strength to

hindi: भावुकता में डूबा — प्रेम में मूर्खतापूर्ण हद तक कोमल और भावप्रवण
definition: foolishly sentimental and tender, showing affection in a way that seems weak or overly sweet
example: She got all soppy watching the puppy video and made everyone on the train look at it too.

hindi: घिनौना और नीच — नैतिक रूप से गंदा और लालची
definition: morally dirty and disgusting, often involving greed, dishonesty or selfishness that makes decent people look away
example: The sordid details of the expenses fraud came out slowly over three days of the inquiry.

hindi: आहत — अपमान या हार से चिढ़ी हुई भावना
definition: feeling resentful and touchy about a recent slight or defeat that still stings
example: He was still sore about losing the pub quiz and refused to look at the winning table.

hindi: हार न पचाने वाला — हार पर कुढ़ने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: someone who reacts to defeat with bitterness and complaint rather than accepting it gracefully
example: He was such a sore loser that he blamed the dice for losing the family board game.

hindi: नुकसान या पीड़ा से जुड़े महान उदासी की भावना
definition: an emotion of great sadness associated with loss or bereavement
example: He tried to express his sorrow at her loss.

hindi: विशेष रूप से दु:ख से सामना करना या चिह्नित करना कि अपूरणीय नुकसान से जुड़ा हुआ है; ; ; - प्रोवरब 14: 13
definition: experiencing or marked by or expressing sorrow especially that associated with irreparable loss; ; ; ; - Proverbs 14:13
example: Sorrowful widows.

hindi: उदास होने की स्थिति
definition: the state of being sad
example: She tired of his perpetual sadness.

hindi: खेदित — दुखी और क्षमाप्रार्थी
definition: feeling regret or sympathy for a wrong or a hurt, the everyday word for owning a mistake
example: He felt sorry the moment the sarcastic reply went out.

hindi: आत्मा को कुचल देने वाला — उम्मीद और उत्साह मिटा देने वाला
definition: so dull, hopeless or crushing that it drains away all spirit, motivation and gladness
example: Re-entering the same data into three systems every morning was soul-destroying for the new admin.

hindi: आत्म-मंथन — अपने उद्देश्यों और चुनावों की गहरी पड़ताल
definition: a period of serious, often painful examination of your own motives, beliefs and choices, usually after a shock or failure
example: After the project collapsed she did some soul-searching about why she had ignored the warning signs.

hindi: गहरी भावना से भरा या व्यक्त करना
definition: full of or expressing deep emotion
example: Soulful eyes.

hindi: गहरी भावना या भावना
definition: deep feeling or emotion

hindi: खट्टा — कड़वाहट से भरा चिड़चिड़ा मिजाज
definition: having a resentful, bad-tempered mood in which nothing pleases and everyone seems at fault
example: He came back from the review in a sour mood and snapped at anyone who asked about lunch.

hindi: मुँह लटकाए रहने वाला — हमेशा खट्टा चेहरा रखने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a habitually gloomy, sulky person whose sour expression dampens everyone's mood
example: The sourpuss at the end of the table refused to join in the birthday toast.

hindi: छोटी तकरार — जल्दी उठकर जल्दी शांत होने वाला झगड़ा
definition: a brief, minor quarrel that flares up quickly and is usually forgotten soon afterwards, without lasting damage
example: They had a quick spat about directions and were laughing again by the next junction.

hindi: अवाक् — भावना के आवेग से शब्दहीन
definition: temporarily unable to speak because surprise, shock or strong emotion has overwhelmed you
example: The surprise party left her speechless in the doorway with her keys still in her hand.

hindi: मंत्रमुग्ध — किसी को जादू-सा बाँधकर मोह लेना
definition: to hold someone entranced with wonder and fascination, as though under a magic spell
example: Her grandmother's stories spellbound the whole table until the candles burned down.

hindi: मंत्रमुग्ध — जैसे जादू से बाँध दिया गया हो
definition: held completely still by fascination, as though a magic spell were stopping you from looking away
example: The whole carriage sat spellbound while the little girl sang to herself by the window.

hindi: निःशेष — ऊर्जा पूरी तरह खर्च हो चुकी
definition: having used up every reserve of energy and emotion, left empty and unable to give anything more
example: When the final exam ended she felt utterly spent and sat in the corridor for twenty minutes.

hindi: रीढ़ सिहराने वाला — भय से शरीर में सिहरन दौड़ाने वाला
definition: frightening in a way that sends a shiver down the spine, often eerie rather than violent
example: The spine-chilling story at the sleepover kept the kids awake until three.

hindi: रोमांचक — रीढ़ में सिहरन पैदा करने वाला
definition: thrilling or frightening in a way that sends a shiver of excitement down your back
example: The choir's final note was spine-tingling even through the laptop speakers.

hindi: रीढ़हीन — दबाव में तुरंत झुकने वाला
definition: lacking the courage or firmness to stand up for anything under pressure, caving in at the first sign of disapproval
example: The spineless committee reversed its decision the moment the sponsor frowned.

hindi: जोशपूर्ण — साहसी और उत्साही
definition: full of energy, courage and lively enthusiasm, especially when standing up for something
example: The debate turned spirited once the interns started arguing about tabs versus spaces.

hindi: निर्जीव — उत्साह और जोश से बिल्कुल खाली
definition: lacking energy, courage or enthusiasm, going through the motions without any inner drive
example: The team gave a spiritless performance in the meeting, nodding at slides nobody had read.

hindi: दूसरों को देखने की जरूरत महसूस करना
definition: feeling a need to see others suffer

hindi: दिखा दुर्भावनापूर्ण बीमार इच्छा और चोट की इच्छा; स्पिट द्वारा प्रेरित
definition: showing malicious ill will and a desire to hurt; motivated by spite
example: A despiteful fiend.

hindi: दूसरों को देखने की जरूरत महसूस करना
definition: feeling a need to see others suffer

hindi: तेज़-मिज़ाज — गुस्से में तीखा और जोशीला व्यक्ति
definition: a person, often a woman, with a fiery, quick temper and a sharp tongue that others find both fierce and admirable
example: The new intern was a spitfire who argued back at the director in her first week.

hindi: कटु रोष — भीतर जमा हुआ क्रोध और चिड़चिड़ापन
definition: bad temper and spiteful anger, especially when vented on someone who is not to blame
example: After the bad review he vented his spleen on the poor intern who had brought him coffee.

hindi: क्रोधी और कटु — बात-बात पर भड़कने वाला
definition: bad-tempered and spiteful, given to sudden outbursts of ill humour and bitter remarks
example: The columnist wrote a splenetic piece attacking everyone who had ever praised the film.

hindi: हकबकाकर बोलना — आक्रोश या हैरानी में अटक-अटक कर बोलना
definition: to speak in a rapid, incoherent, spitting way because indignation or astonishment has left you flustered
example: She spluttered with outrage when the waiter assumed her son was paying.

hindi: खेल बिगाड़ने वाला — मज़े में रुकावट डालने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a person who refuses to take part in a game or shared pleasure and thereby wrecks everyone else's enjoyment
example: Come on, join the sweepstake and stop being a spoilsport.

hindi: डराना — अचानक चौंकाकर भयभीत कर देना
definition: to frighten someone suddenly so that they become jumpy and want to flee
example: The sudden drop in the share price spooked half the investors into selling.

hindi: डरकर चौंका हुआ — अचानक किसी अनहोनी के आभास से घबराया
definition: suddenly frightened and unsettled by something unexpected, often more than the thing deserves
example: The whole office was spooked after the lights cut out during the storm and the printer started up on its own.

hindi: प्रेम-मूढ़ — मोह में मूर्खतापूर्ण रूप से भावुक
definition: foolishly sentimental and sappy about someone you adore, an old-fashioned word for being silly with affection
example: His colleagues found him hopelessly spoony, naming the office plant after his girlfriend.

hindi: खेल-भावना — हार-जीत में शालीनता
definition: the generous fairness that lets you lose without bitterness and win without gloating
example: Her sportsmanship after losing the pitch impressed the client more than the winning team's slides.

hindi: आत्म-केंद्रित भ्रम — यह मान लेना कि सब आपकी हर गलती देख रहे हैं
definition: the tendency to believe that other people notice your appearance and mistakes far more than they actually do
example: The spotlight effect had him convinced the whole train was staring at the coffee stain on his shirt.

hindi: फुर्तीला उल्लास — हल्का, चुस्त और प्रसन्न
definition: lively, brisk and light of movement and mood, often said of someone older than they seem
example: My sprightly grandmother beat everyone to the top of the stairs and laughed about it.

hindi: बसंत की बेचैनी — नई ऋतु में उमड़ती चंचल उत्तेजना
definition: the restless, giddy lift of energy and longing that comes over people together when the first warm days of spring arrive
example: Spring fever hit the office on the first sunny Friday and nobody could focus past lunch.

hindi: जोश और जीवट — जुझारू साहस और उत्साह
definition: lively courage and spirited determination, especially in someone who could easily be pushed around
example: The youngest player had enough spunk to argue with the referee while the captain stayed silent.

hindi: प्रेरित करना — किसी को कार्य के लिए उकसाना
definition: to urge someone into action or greater effort, giving a sharp push of motivation like a rider's heel to a horse
example: A rival's promotion spurred her to finally ask for the raise she deserved.

hindi: ठुकराना — घृणा या तिरस्कार के साथ अस्वीकार करना
definition: to reject an offer or a person with visible disdain, as though accepting would be beneath you
example: He spurned the apology and the flowers that came with it, leaving both on the doorstep overnight.

hindi: तिरस्कृत — अपमान के साथ अस्वीकार किया गया
definition: rejected with contempt, feeling the sting of being turned away as if you were beneath consideration
example: Spurned by the study group he had helped set up, he ate lunch alone and pretended it was by choice.

hindi: तू-तू मैं-मैं करना — छोटी बात पर झगड़ना
definition: to argue noisily and childishly about something trivial, with more irritation than real anger behind the fuss
example: The two designers squabbled for an hour over which shade of grey to use for the footer.

hindi: कर्कश शिकायत करना — ऊँची, कठोर आवाज़ में विरोध जताना
definition: to protest loudly and harshly, with a raucous indignant noise like a startled bird
example: The regulars squawked when the cafe raised the price of a flat white.

hindi: खुशी से चीख पड़ना — उत्तेजना में तीखी आवाज़
definition: to give a high, sharp, sudden cry of delight, excitement or sudden fright
example: The girls squealed when the lights came on and they saw the surprise party.

hindi: घिन खाने वाला — खून या घिनौनी चीज़ें देखकर विचलित हो जाने वाला
definition: easily made queasy or upset by blood, injury or unpleasant sights
example: She was too squeamish to watch the nurse take her father's blood.

hindi: कुचल देना — आशा या उत्साह को तुरंत और पूरी तरह दबा देना
definition: to crush a hope, a feeling or a rising enthusiasm suddenly and completely, usually with a curt word or a cold fact
example: The finance team squelched the excitement over the new project with a single budget email.

hindi: कुलबुलाना — शर्म से बेचैन होना
definition: to wriggle with discomfort and embarrassment, unable to sit still under awkward attention
example: He squirmed as the clip of his fall was replayed at the party.

hindi: कसमसाहट — बेचैनी या असहजता से हिलना-डुलना
definition: restless in a wriggling, uncomfortable way, unable to sit still because of boredom, nerves or awkwardness
example: The kids got squirmy twenty minutes into the long car journey.

hindi: बेचैन-चंचल — घबराई हुई अस्थिरता
definition: restless, jumpy and unable to settle, an American word for a nervous energy that keeps you fidgeting
example: He got squirrelly waiting for the test results and kept refreshing his email.

hindi: अचानक तेज भावना
definition: a sudden sharp feeling
example: Pangs of regret.

hindi: मंच का भय — दर्शकों के सामने आने से पहले की घबराहट
definition: the nervous fear that grips a person just before performing or speaking in front of an audience
example: Stage fright hit him so hard at the karaoke bar that he handed the microphone straight back.

hindi: स्तंभित — भारी आश्चर्य से डगमगाया
definition: deeply shocked and thrown off balance by news that turns out vastly bigger than anyone expected
example: The staggered parents read the acceptance letter three times to be sure.

hindi: ठहराव — बढ़ने और बदलने की गति का रुक जाना
definition: the dull discouraged feeling that your life or work has stopped moving or growing and has no forward energy left
example: Three years without a promotion or a new skill gave her a sense of stagnation she could not shake.

hindi: बासी — दोहराव से ताज़गी और उत्साह खो चुका
definition: having lost freshness and enthusiasm through too much repetition, so that even familiar pleasures feel flat and tired
example: After five years of the same commute and the same desk he felt stale and started browsing job adverts.

hindi: हकलाना — घबराहट या डर में रुक-रुक कर बोलना
definition: to speak with involuntary pauses and repeated sounds because nervousness or fear has scrambled your words
example: He stammered through the first question of the interview before finding his rhythm.

hindi: रूखा — दूरी बनाकर ठंडे व्यवहार वाला
definition: cold and distant in manner, keeping other people at arm's length even when they try to be friendly
example: The new manager seemed standoffish at first, but it turned out she was simply nervous about being liked.

hindi: कलफ़दार-औपचारिक — कड़ी औपचारिकता से भरा ठंडा व्यवहार
definition: stiffly formal and unbending in manner, correct to the point of coldness like a heavily starched collar
example: The starchy receptionist would not use first names even after a year.

hindi: सपनीला — भोली और अव्यावहारिक आशा से भरा
definition: full of naive dreamy hope and admiration, seeing only the wonderful side of something
example: He was still starry-eyed about the startup even after the third missed payday.

hindi: सितारे से अभिभूत — किसी प्रसिद्ध व्यक्ति के सामने मंत्रमुग्ध और घबराया हुआ
definition: so dazzled by meeting someone famous that you feel giddy and tongue-tied, admiration turning into nervous excitement
example: He was completely starstruck when the author he had read since school joined the same video call.

hindi: चौंकाना — अचानक किसी को डराकर झटका देना
definition: to cause a sudden shock of fright, making someone jump before they understand what happened
example: The notification sound startled her so badly she knocked over her coffee.

hindi: हैसियत की चिंता — दूसरों की नज़र में अपनी जगह की फ़िक्र
definition: a persistent worry about where you stand compared with others in wealth, success or respect
example: The reunion invitation triggered status anxiety and a sudden urge to update his job title online.

hindi: टिके रहने की शक्ति — थकान या ऊब के बावजूद लगे रहने का धीरज
definition: the patient stamina to keep going with something long after the excitement has worn off and others have quit
example: Plenty of people start a novel in November, but staying power is what gets you to the last chapter.

hindi: स्थिर — भावनात्मक रूप से अडिग और भरोसेमंद
definition: emotionally firm and dependable, not swinging between moods or shaken by what happens around you
example: When the startup nearly ran out of money, it was the steady office manager everyone leaned on.

hindi: गुस्से में उबलता — दबा हुआ तीखा क्रोध
definition: quietly furious and simmering with anger you have kept inside, an American word for a temper about to boil over
example: She was steamed after the meeting and typed her reply three times before sending it.

hindi: कामुक-गर्म — यौन आवेश से भरा हुआ और उत्तेजक
definition: charged with open sexual passion, so heated that it feels like the air itself is warm
example: The steamy texts they exchanged during the conference made the closing keynote hard to follow.

hindi: फौलादी — कठोर और अडिग दृढ़ता वाला
definition: hard and cold in determination, showing no softness or sign of giving way, with a chill that warns others not to push
example: Her steely stare across the table ended the argument before it started.

hindi: कड़ा-गंभीर — अनुशासन में कठोर और अप्रसन्न मुख
definition: serious and strict in a way that allows no lightness, disapproval carried in a firm unsmiling face
example: The stern librarian tapped the sign and the giggling stopped instantly.

hindi: चिंता और आंदोलन की चरम स्थिति
definition: an extreme state of worry and agitation
example: His stewing over the fight kept him awake most of the night.

hindi: दकियानूसी — नयी बात या मज़े से घबराने वाला पुराने ढर्रे का व्यक्ति
definition: a dull, cautious person who resists anything new or exciting and prefers the same safe routine every time
example: Her flatmates called her a stick-in-the-mud when she voted for the usual pizza place again.

hindi: टिके रहने की लगन — काम छोड़े बिना डटे रहने का गुण
definition: dogged persistence and perseverance, the homely virtue of keeping at a task until it is finished
example: It was plain stick-to-itiveness that got her through the driving test on the fourth attempt.

hindi: गर्दन-कड़ा हठी — अभिमान से झुकने या मानने से इनकार
definition: proudly stubborn and unwilling to yield, refusing to bend even slightly because bending feels like defeat
example: Too stiff-necked to ask for directions, he drove us round the same roundabout four times.

hindi: दबा देना — उठती भावना को बाहर आने से रोकना
definition: to hold back a feeling or its expression, such as a laugh, a sob or a surge of anger, so it never escapes into the open
example: He stifled a grin when the boss mispronounced the client's name for the third time.

hindi: निस्तब्धता — भीतर की गहरी शांति और ठहराव
definition: a deep inner quiet in which restless thoughts stop moving and the mind rests without effort
example: Sitting on the balcony before anyone else woke, he felt a stillness he never found during the workday.

hindi: बनावटी कठोरता — असहजता से जकड़ी हुई बोली
definition: stiff and unnatural in manner, speaking with an awkward formality that reveals discomfort or self-consciousness
example: Their conversation at the reunion was stilted until someone mentioned the old school canteen.

hindi: चुभन — आलोचना से हुई तीखी पीड़ा
definition: the sharp, brief pain of an insult or criticism that lingers longer than it should
example: The sting of her comment stayed with him during the whole train ride.

hindi: भावना जगाना — मन में गहरी अनुभूति उभारना
definition: to arouse a strong emotion in someone, moving them deeply so that feeling rises where there had been calm
example: The farewell speech stirred even the quiet engineers who rarely showed emotion.

hindi: बंद रहने की बेचैनी — लंबे समय तक कैद से पागल-सा
definition: restless and agitated to the point of feeling slightly unhinged from being confined in one place for too long
example: After two weeks working from a tiny flat she was going stir-crazy.

hindi: उत्तेजक — मन में जोश और गौरव की लहर उठाने वाला
definition: rousing a proud, energetic surge of feeling that makes the chest swell, as a great speech or anthem does
example: The captain's stirring message before the product launch had even the quiet engineers cheering.

hindi: बंधक सहानुभूति — बंदी बनाने वाले के प्रति लगाव पैदा होना
definition: the strange affection and loyalty a captive can develop towards their captor as a way of surviving, now used loosely for attachment to anyone who mistreats you
example: Her friends joked about stockholm syndrome when she defended the boss who had cancelled her holiday twice.

hindi: धैर्यशील — दुःख या कष्ट को बिना शिकायत के सहन करने वाला
definition: bearing pain, hardship or harsh news without complaint or visible feeling, keeping the face steady when others would break
example: She took the redundancy news with a stoic nod and went back to finish the report anyway.

hindi: जोश में — किसी बात को लेकर बेहद उत्साहित
definition: thrilled and eagerly excited about something, often something about to happen, with an energy that wants to share the news
example: The whole group chat was stoked about the camping trip next weekend.

hindi: छोटी भावनाओं या संवेदनशीलता को प्रकट करना या प्रकट करना; आसानी से उत्तेजित या उत्तेजित नहीं; - Nordhoff और हॉल; -Virginia Woolf
definition: having or revealing little emotion or sensibility; not easily aroused or excited; ; - Nordhoff & Hall; -Virginia Woolf
example: Her impassive remoteness.

hindi: सहानुभूति भावनात्मक प्रतिक्रियाओं की अनुपस्थिति द्वारा प्रदर्शित
definition: apathy demonstrated by an absence of emotional reactions

hindi: जी मिचलाने वाला — घृणा और दहशत से पेट में हलचल भरने वाला
definition: so disturbing or horrifying that it produces nausea and a sick, sinking feeling in the stomach
example: The stomach-churning details of the recall report made her push the sandwich away.

hindi: पत्थर-चेहरा — चेहरे पर कोई भाव न आने देने वाला कठोर
definition: showing no emotion at all on the face, deliberately blank and unmoved in a way that feels chilly
example: The stone-faced security guard did not blink at the child's knock-knock joke.

hindi: दीवार बन जाना — जवाब न देकर और बात टालकर विरोध जताना
definition: to refuse coldly to answer or cooperate, shutting someone out with silence and evasions as a form of hostility
example: Every time she raised the budget question, the finance team stonewalled her with vague promises.

hindi: भावनात्मक दीवार — बातचीत से पूरी तरह कट जाना
definition: shutting down completely in a conflict, refusing to respond or engage, which leaves a partner talking to a wall
example: His stonewalling during every argument hurt her more than any shouting could have.

hindi: पाषाण-सम — किसी भावना या दया का कोई चिह्न न दिखाने वाला
definition: cold and unfeeling like stone, showing no warmth, pity or response when someone reaches out
example: She met his apology with a stony silence and went back to typing.

hindi: दूसरों के लिए महसूस करना
definition: devoid of feeling for others
example: An unfeeling wretch.

hindi: तूफ़ान की तरह बरसना — क्रोध में ज़ोर से बोलते हुए आना या जाना
definition: to speak or move with loud, sudden, violent anger, often slamming doors or shouting as you leave
example: She stormed out of the review meeting before anyone could explain the numbers.

hindi: दृढ़ हृदय — निडर और साहसी मन वाला
definition: brave and loyal in a sturdy, old-fashioned way that stands firm when danger appears
example: A stouthearted neighbour waded through the flooded street to check on the elderly couple.

hindi: गंभीर मुखमुद्रा — हँसी रोककर शांत चेहरा बनाए रखना
definition: keeping a serious, unsmiling expression through deliberate self-control, usually while hiding amusement or telling a joke
example: She managed to stay straight-faced while telling the new hire that Friday was hat day.

hindi: खिंचाव — दबाव से मन पर पड़ा भारी बोझ
definition: the mental burden felt when demands pull hard on a person's patience, energy or nerves
example: The strain of the custody case showed in every clipped reply he sent.

hindi: कठोर-नैतिक — नियमों और मर्यादा में बहुत सख्त और संकुचित
definition: strict and narrowly proper in morals and behaviour, restrained to the point of seeming prudish and unable to relax
example: The straitlaced accountant left the karaoke bar the moment the first rude song came on.

hindi: अजनबी भय — शिशु का अपरिचित लोगों से डरना
definition: the wary fear that infants show towards unfamiliar people, clinging and crying when a stranger comes too close
example: The baby had been all smiles until the new neighbour leaned into the pram, and then stranger anxiety turned her face to the wall.

hindi: तनाव — दबाव और मांगों के कारण मन पर भार महसूस होना
definition: the strained, pressured feeling of having more demands on you than you can comfortably handle, wearing at both mind and body
example: The stress of juggling two deadlines and a sick toddler left him snapping at everyone by Thursday.

hindi: तनाव-कारक — मानसिक दबाव पैदा करने वाली चीज़
definition: anything, from a deadline to a noisy neighbour, that triggers strain and anxiety in a person
example: For him the biggest stressor was the weekly budget call with the client.

hindi: तनावग्रस्त-चिड़चिड़ा — दबाव में खिन्न बेचैनी
definition: tense and irritable under pressure, a British word for the frazzled anxious mood that snaps at small things
example: She gets stressy in the week before a deadline and reorganises the whole kitchen.

hindi: आघात-ग्रस्त — दुःख या सदमे से आहत
definition: suddenly hit by grief, shock or distress so that the feeling shows plainly on the face
example: He looked stricken when the message came through in the group chat that his old teacher had died.

hindi: वैमनस्य — कड़वी और लंबी चली आ रही खींचतान
definition: bitter and prolonged conflict between people who have stopped trying to reconcile, heavier and more exhausting than ordinary disagreement
example: Years of family strife meant nobody wanted to host the holiday dinner anymore.

hindi: दृढ़ इच्छाशक्ति वाला — जो आसानी से नहीं मानता
definition: having a powerful will that resists being persuaded or pushed around by others
example: The strong-willed toddler refused every spoonful until she could hold the spoon herself.

hindi: अड़ियल गुस्सा — झगड़ालू और असहयोगी
definition: bad-tempered and awkwardly argumentative, refusing to go along with things out of temper
example: The teenager went stroppy when asked to put his phone away at dinner.

hindi: तनाव से तना हुआ — थकान और घबराहट में खिंचा
definition: stretched to a nervous, exhausted tension by prolonged stress or lack of sleep, unable to settle
example: She was strung out after the week of deadlines and jumped when the phone rang.

hindi: अकड़कर चलना — घमंड भरी चाल चलना
definition: to walk with a stiff, proud and self-important gait that displays how pleased you are with yourself
example: He strutted through the office after the promotion as if the carpet had been laid just for him.

hindi: हठी — अपनी बात पर अड़ा रहने वाला
definition: refusing to change your mind or course even when there are good reasons to
example: He was too stubborn to admit the shortcut had made them late.

hindi: घमंड में चूर — दूसरों से मिलने-जुलने में नाक भौं सिकोड़ने वाला
definition: arrogantly convinced of your own importance in a way that makes you unfriendly and distant toward ordinary people
example: Everyone in the kitchen thought the new designer was stuck-up because she never joined the tea round.

hindi: रूढ़िवादी-गंभीर — पुराने ढंग से कठोर और आनंद-विरोधी
definition: old-fashioned, formal and disapproving of fun, a narrow seriousness that makes others feel judged
example: The stuffy committee vetoed the office playlist as unprofessional.

hindi: निरुत्तर — किसी सवाल का जवाब न सूझने की उलझन
definition: unable to find an answer or a path forward despite real effort, and stuck exactly there
example: The quiz question about rivers left the whole table stumped.

hindi: स्तब्ध — आघात से किसी को सुन्न कर देना
definition: to shock someone so completely that they are left numb and momentarily unable to react
example: The sudden resignation of the manager stunned the whole office.

hindi: आहत — किसी की बात या व्यवहार से तीखा दर्द
definition: sharply hurt by an unkind remark or unexpected slight, a quick pain that lingers longer than it should
example: She was stung when her sister forgot to add her to the family holiday chat.

hindi: सन्न — झटके से सुन्न और निष्क्रिय
definition: left numb and unable to react by a sudden shock, as if struck by a physical blow
example: He sat stunned in the meeting room long after the layoffs were announced.

hindi: stupefied astonishment की भावना
definition: a feeling of stupefied astonishment

hindi: सन्न — आश्चर्य से मूढ़ और निष्क्रिय
definition: dazed into numb silence by amazement or shock, with the mind seeming to stop working
example: The stupefied crowd stood motionless as the fireworks display went completely wrong.

hindi: जब आप गलती से कुछ बुरा होता है, तो संकट और असंतुष्टता की भावना
definition: the feeling of distress and disbelief that you have when something bad happens accidentally
example: His mother's death left him in a daze.

hindi: अटका हुआ — आगे बढ़ने का कोई रास्ता न सूझने की खीझ
definition: stuck and frustrated because every route forward seems blocked and you cannot see how to make progress
example: Stymied by a bug nobody could reproduce, the developers stared at the screen in silence.

hindi: शांत-दबा हुआ — भावों की तीव्रता कम हुई अवस्था
definition: quiet and lowered in mood or spirit, with feeling muted rather than absent, often after news or exhaustion
example: The office was subdued the morning after the merger announcement, with everyone speaking softly.

hindi: उदात्तीकरण — दबी इच्छाओं को रचनात्मक काम में मोड़ना
definition: the healthy channelling of a raw urge or painful feeling into something productive, like turning grief into a marathon
example: Her sublimation of the breakup into a hundred sourdough loaves kept the whole office fed for a month.

hindi: भव्यता — विशाल सौंदर्य से उपजा भय मिला विस्मय
definition: the quality of greatness or beauty so vast that it produces wonder mixed with a little fear
example: The sheer sublimity of the glacier silenced the tour group for the entire walk back.

hindi: विनम्र दब्बूपन — बिना विरोध मान लेना
definition: ready to obey and give in to others without protest, yielding rather than asserting yourself
example: His submissive nod when the client changed the brief again worried the rest of the team.

hindi: दासवत विनम्रता — खुद को दूसरे से नीचे रखना
definition: too willing to obey and please others, treating your own wishes as less important than theirs
example: She hated how subservient she became around her father-in-law, laughing at jokes she found unfunny.

hindi: सहारा — संकट में दी गई सहायता और सांत्वना
definition: help and comfort given to someone in distress or hardship, the relief that reaches a person at their lowest point
example: After the flood, the neighbours brought food and succour to the family sleeping in the school hall.

hindi: खुशामद करना — फ़ायदे के लिए किसी बड़े की चापलूसी करना
definition: to behave with eager, exaggerated friendliness toward someone powerful in order to gain their favour
example: The interns competed to suck up to the manager by laughing hardest at his jokes.

hindi: sullen aloofness या वापसी के मूड या प्रदर्शन
definition: a mood or display of sullen aloofness or withdrawal
example: Stayed home in a sulk.

hindi: sullen aloofness या वापसी के मूड या प्रदर्शन
definition: a mood or display of sullen aloofness or withdrawal
example: Stayed home in a sulk.

definition: showing a brooding ill humor; ; ; ; ; ; - Bruce Bliven
example: A dark scowl.

hindi: उदासीन अनुभव
definition: a gloomy ill-tempered feeling

hindi: धूप जैसा स्वभाव — सदा प्रसन्न और गर्मजोश
definition: having a warm, bright and consistently cheerful temperament that seems untouched by gloom
example: Even in the queue at the passport office she kept her sunny disposition.

hindi: उद्धत तिरस्कार भरा — भौंह उठाकर दूसरों को तुच्छ समझने वाला
definition: showing a cool, raised-eyebrow contempt that treats other people as beneath serious notice
example: The waiter gave a supercilious glance at their trainers and led them to the table nearest the toilets.

hindi: श्रेष्ठता की ग्रंथि — दूसरों से बेहतर होने का दिखावटी भाव
definition: an exaggerated belief in being better than others that usually hides a deeper insecurity
example: The superiority complex he wore in meetings made his colleagues quietly root for him to be wrong.

hindi: सहायक — कठिन समय में संबल देने वाला
definition: giving warm encouragement and practical help that makes someone feel less alone in a struggle
example: Her flatmates were so supportive during the layoffs that she stopped dreading the rent.

hindi: दमन — भावना को जानबूझकर दबाकर बाहर न आने देना
definition: in psychology, the conscious effort to hold a feeling or thought down and out of view, unlike repression, which happens without awareness
example: His suppression of grief through the funeral gave way the moment he was alone in the car.

hindi: रूखा और उजड्ड — बदमिज़ाज और अभद्र
definition: bad-tempered and rudely unfriendly in manner, answering people with a scowl rather than an insult
example: The surly waiter dropped the menus on the table without a word and walked away.

hindi: आपको लगता है कि जब कुछ पूरी तरह से अप्रत्याशित आप के लिए होता है
definition: the astonishment you feel when something totally unexpected happens to you

hindi: निराशा की स्वीकृति
definition: acceptance of despair

hindi: बचे रहने की ग्लानि — दूसरों के खोने पर स्वयं जीवित रहने की ग्लानि
definition: the painful guilt felt by someone who lived through a disaster or loss when others did not
example: After the redundancies she carried a quiet survivor's guilt every time she walked past the empty desks.

hindi: संदेह करना — किसी के दोषी होने का अनुमान लगाना
definition: to believe someone is probably guilty of something or that something is wrong, without having proof yet
example: He started to suspect his flatmate when the grocery money kept coming up short every single week.

hindi: क्या हो रहा है
definition: apprehension about what is going to happen

hindi: शक — किसी के इरादों पर बेचैन अविश्वास
definition: an uneasy, distrustful feeling that someone is doing something dishonest or hidden, without proof to settle the doubt
example: Suspicion crept in when the contractor stopped answering calls the day after the deposit cleared.

hindi: अकड़ — चाल-ढाल में दिखता घमंड
definition: a bold, strutting confidence expressed through the way someone walks and carries themselves, showing they think highly of themselves
example: He walked into the interview with such swagger that the receptionist assumed he already worked there.

hindi: काम से लदा — इतने काम में डूबा कि साँस लेने की फुरसत न हो
definition: feeling buried under a flood of work or requests arriving faster than they can be cleared
example: He was so swamped with support tickets that he ate lunch standing at his desk.

hindi: मीठी बातों से फुसलाना — प्रशंसा भरे शब्दों से मनाना
definition: to persuade someone with charming, flattering words, coaxing them into agreement through pleasant praise
example: She tried to sweet-talk the landlord into fixing the boiler before the weekend.

hindi: मृदु स्वभाव — कोमल और धैर्यपूर्ण मिज़ाज
definition: gentle, patient and pleasant in disposition, rarely showing anger even when provoked
example: The sweet-tempered nanny never once raised her voice at the twins.

hindi: घमंड से फूला हुआ — सफलता से सिर चढ़ा
definition: conceited and full of yourself, especially after a recent success has inflated your opinion of your own importance
example: He became swellheaded after the article about the app and stopped answering messages from old colleagues.

hindi: एक पैनिक या चरम विघटन
definition: a panic or extreme discomposure
example: It threw her into a swivet.

hindi: मूर्च्छित-सा होना — आनंद या आसक्ति से बेसुध हो जाना
definition: to be overcome with delight or romantic admiration, as though about to faint from the feeling
example: The whole group chat swooned when he posted the photo of the dinner he had cooked for her.

hindi: चाटुकार — स्वार्थ से भरी खुशामद करने वाला
definition: flattering people in power with servile eagerness in order to gain advantage from them
example: The sycophantic replies under the CEO's post made the actual criticism impossible to find.

hindi: सहानुभूति — दूसरे के दुख को समझकर उसके साथ दुखी होना
definition: a feeling of sorrow and care for someone else who is suffering, and the wish to comfort them
example: The whole team sent sympathy messages when they heard about her father.

hindi: सहानुभूति-वेदना — दूसरे की पीड़ा देख अपने शरीर में महसूस हुआ दर्द
definition: aches or discomfort a person feels in their own body out of close fellow feeling for someone who is actually suffering
example: He swore he got sympathy pains every time his pregnant wife mentioned her back.

hindi: चाशनी जैसी भावुकता — बनावटी रूप से मीठा और भावपूर्ण
definition: excessively sweet and sentimental in a way that feels cloying and artificial rather than sincere
example: The syrupy farewell email made half the department roll their eyes.

hindi: जीवन से विरक्ति — जीने की ऊब और थकान का गहरा भाव
definition: a weary disgust with life itself, in which nothing seems worth the effort of continuing
example: Halfway through another identical Monday, a taedium vitae settled on him that made even lunch feel pointless.

hindi: चौंका हुआ — अचानक बात से असहज आश्चर्य
definition: momentarily surprised and thrown off balance by something unexpected, usually a remark or reaction
example: He was taken aback when his quiet colleague bluntly disagreed with him in front of the client.

hindi: ऊँची पोस्त की मानसिकता — सफल लोगों को नीचा दिखाने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the tendency to criticise and cut down people whose success sets them above the rest of the group
example: Tall poppy syndrome kicked in fast when the youngest engineer was quoted in a national newspaper.

hindi: वश में करना — उग्र भावना या क्रोध को नियंत्रित और शांत करना
definition: to bring a wild or fierce feeling such as rage or fear under control so it becomes manageable and quiet
example: Years of therapy taught him to tame the temper that used to wreck family dinners.

hindi: खराब स्वभाव का प्रदर्शन
definition: a display of bad temper
example: He had a fit.

hindi: कटु और तीखा — चुभने वाले लहज़े में कहा गया
definition: sharply cutting in tone, expressing displeasure through a brief, acid remark rather than open anger
example: Her tart reply to the customer's third complaint earned her a warning from the manager.

hindi: चिढ़ाना — तिरस्कार भरे ताने देकर भड़काना
definition: to mock someone with scornful remarks intended to provoke or humiliate them, often about a weakness they cannot hide
example: The older boys taunted him about his stammer until a teacher walked into the corridor.

hindi: सामूहिक भावना — साथियों के प्रति एकजुटता और उत्साह
definition: a warm feeling of loyalty and shared enthusiasm among members of a group working together
example: The team spirit in the kitchen carried the staff through the busiest wedding of the summer.

hindi: आंसू से भरा या चिह्नित
definition: filled with or marked by tears
example: Tearful eyes.

hindi: रोना द्वारा व्यक्त उदासी
definition: sadness expressed by weeping

hindi: रुलाने वाली कहानी — जो जानबूझकर आँसू और भावुकता जगाए
definition: a story, film or song deliberately made to stir sadness and bring tears
example: The training video turned out to be a real tearjerker about a nurse and her patients.

hindi: विजयोन्माद — जीत पर घमंड भरा सामूहिक जश्न
