example: The triumphalism in the winning team's channel made the rest of the company want to mute it.

hindi: विशेष रूप से विजय या सफलता के कारण हर्षित और गर्व
definition: joyful and proud especially because of triumph or success
example: Rejoicing crowds filled the streets on VJ Day.

hindi: व्याकुल करना — मन में चिंता और बेचैनी पैदा करना
definition: to cause someone worry or unease that lingers, disturbing their peace of mind
example: Something in her sister's voice on the phone troubled him all evening.

hindi: विश्वास — किसी की ईमानदारी और भरोसेमंदी पर टिका सुकून
definition: a settled confidence that someone is reliable and honest, which lets one relax and depend on them
example: It took months of small favours before real trust grew between the two flatmates.

hindi: सहज विश्वासी — जल्दी ही दूसरों पर भरोसा कर लेने वाला स्वभाव
definition: having a temperament that readily believes people are honest and means well, often before they have earned that confidence
example: He was so trusting that he lent his car keys to a coworker he had met at lunch that same day.

hindi: (Yiddish) परेशानी और पीड़ा
definition: (Yiddish) trouble and suffering

hindi: उथल-पुथल — तीव्र भावनात्मक अव्यवस्था और उलझन
definition: a state of great confusion, agitation and disorder, whether in a crowd or in one troubled mind
example: The sudden merger threw the whole office into turmoil for a fortnight.

hindi: च-च करना — जीभ से आवाज़ निकालकर नापसंदगी या झुंझलाहट जताना
definition: to make a clicking sound with the tongue to express mild disapproval, impatience or annoyance
example: The woman behind me tutted loudly when my card was declined at the till.

hindi: अति कोमल बनावट — बचकानी और कृत्रिम मिठास
definition: affectedly sweet, dainty and quaint in a way that feels precious and overdone
example: The handwritten notes with little hearts on every desk struck her as twee.

hindi: अचानक तेज भावना
definition: a sudden sharp feeling
example: Pangs of regret.

hindi: ताना मारना — किसी गलती पर चिढ़ाना
definition: to taunt or tease someone about a blunder or weakness, poking at it to embarrass them
example: His sister twitted him about the burnt lasagne for the rest of the evening.

hindi: फड़कती बेचैनी — घबराहट से झटके खाता मन
definition: nervously restless and jumpy, with tension that shows in small sudden movements and quick reactions
example: He was twitchy all morning waiting for the exam results to be posted.

hindi: प्रेम में बौराया — नई मोहब्बत की चंचल घबराहट
definition: giddy and flustered with the first rush of romantic infatuation, a playful American word for lovestruck silliness
example: He has been twitterpated since the barista remembered his order, and keeps finding excuses to go back.

hindi: अनावश्यक गंभीरता या मनमाना व्यवहार द्वारा चिह्नित
definition: marked by unjust severity or arbitrary behavior
example: The oppressive government.

hindi: अनावश्यक गंभीरता या मनमाना व्यवहार द्वारा चिह्नित
definition: marked by unjust severity or arbitrary behavior
example: The oppressive government.

hindi: नाराज होने के कारण क्रोध की भावना
definition: a feeling of anger caused by being offended
example: He took offence at my question.

hindi: निःसंकोच — बिना झेंप के
definition: not embarrassed in the slightest by something that might have made others blush
example: He was unabashed about singing along loudly on the crowded bus.

hindi: खतरों या खतरों के बारे में अप्रिय या शांतिपूर्वक उन्हें सामना करने में मदद करते हैं
definition: oblivious of dangers or perils or calmly resolute in facing them

hindi: अलार्म नहीं; अलार्म जारी करना
definition: not alarming; assuaging alarm

hindi: क्षमा न माँगने वाला — बेधड़क अडिग
definition: openly refusing to apologise for a choice, sometimes with pride, whether or not it was wrong
example: She was unapologetic about leaving the meeting early to collect her kid.

hindi: अनदेखा — प्रयासों की कद्र न होने का दुख
definition: hurt and resentful because your efforts pass unnoticed or unthanked by others
example: He felt unappreciated when the launch email never mentioned his team.

hindi: अगम्य — इतना ठंडा कि लोग पास आने से डरें
definition: seeming so cold or intimidating in manner that other people feel unable to come and talk to you
example: The senior partner was so unapproachable that juniors would rather guess than ask him a question.

hindi: आत्म-विश्वास की कमी या आत्म-विश्वास की कमी
definition: inclined to timidity or lack of self-confidence
example: A shy unassertive person.

hindi: आत्म पदोन्नति के बारे में
definition: diffidence about self promotion

hindi: असहनीय — जिसे झेलना मन की सामर्थ्य से बाहर हो
definition: so painful, sorrowful or tense that it feels impossible to endure for another moment
example: The suspense before the results email was unbearable, so she went for a walk around the block.

hindi: सहज होना — कठोरता और औपचारिकता छोड़ ढीला पड़ना
definition: to relax and become less stiff, formal or reserved, letting your manner soften and ease
example: The stern professor unbent over coffee and started telling stories about his own failed exams.

hindi: अनम्य — अपने सिद्धांत या रुख से बिल्कुल न झुकने वाला
definition: refusing to soften a position or standard under pressure, firm to the point of seeming rigid and stern
example: The unbending editor rejected the piece a third time, calmly repeating that the facts still did not hold.

hindi: आंशिकता की कमी की विशेषता
definition: characterized by a lack of partiality
example: A properly indifferent jury.

hindi: आंशिकता की कमी की विशेषता
definition: characterized by a lack of partiality
example: A properly indifferent jury.

hindi: बेपरवाह — दूसरों की बातों से मन पर कोई असर नहीं
definition: calmly untouched by criticism or trouble that others expect to sting, showing no sign of worry or irritation
example: She read the snarky comment in the group chat, shrugged, and went back to her lunch completely unbothered.

hindi: न झुकने वाला — हार में भी सिर ऊँचा रखने वाला
definition: undefeated in spirit even after losing, with pride and resolve still intact
example: She left the tribunal unbowed, already planning the appeal.

hindi: बेलगाम भावना — बिना रोक-टोक की उमड़ती उत्तेजना
definition: describes excitement or emotion that is released without any restraint or holding back
example: There was unbridled cheering in the group chat when the funding came through.

hindi: भारमुक्त — चिंता का बोझ उतर जाने का हल्कापन
definition: feeling calm and light after a heavy worry or secret has been set down and no longer weighs on the mind
example: After telling her parents the truth she walked home unburdened, lighter than she had felt in months.

hindi: औपचारिकता से मुक्त — खुला, सहज और बेतकल्लुफ
definition: relaxed and informal with the usual stiffness and formality dropped, easy, open and unreserved
example: After the client left, the meeting turned unbuttoned, with everyone kicking off their shoes and sharing snacks.

hindi: अजीब — परिचित होते हुए भी डरावना और रहस्यमय
definition: strange in a way that unsettles you because it is both familiar and slightly wrong
example: It was uncanny how the stranger on the train had exactly her late grandfather's laugh.

hindi: अनिश्चितता — आगे क्या होगा, यह न जानने की बेचैनी
definition: the uncomfortable feeling of not knowing what will happen or what the truth is
example: Months of uncertainty about the contract renewal wore down everyone in the department.

hindi: अनुदार — दूसरों को बुरा मानने वाली कठोरता
definition: harsh or unfair in judging others, quick to assume the worst about their motives
example: She caught herself thinking uncharitable thoughts about the colleague who was late again.

hindi: उदासी और अपर्याप्तता के कारण
definition: causing sad feelings of gloom and inadequacy
example: The economic outlook is depressing.

hindi: डरावना या निराशावादी उदासी की भावना
definition: a feeling of dreary or pessimistic sadness

hindi: तनाव छोड़ना — जकड़न खोलकर शांत होना
definition: to release tension you had been holding in your body and mind, letting worry and tightness ease
example: Only when the test results came back clear did her shoulders finally unclench.

hindi: असामाजिक-अलग — मेल-जोल से दूर रहने वाला अमिलनसार
definition: unsociable and not easy company, disinclined to join in with a group and cool toward those who try
example: Our unclubbable colleague eats lunch alone in his car and seems happier for it.

hindi: मानसिक असुविधा के लिए अनुकूल
definition: conducive to or feeling mental discomfort
example: This kind of life can prove disruptive and uncomfortable.

hindi: मौन-कठोर — बात करने या बताने से हठपूर्वक इनकार
definition: unwilling to talk or share information, keeping silent in a way that shuts other people out
example: After the argument he was uncommunicative for days, answering only with nods.

hindi: बिना शिकायत सहने वाला — कष्ट और अतिरिक्त बोझ को चुपचाप झेलना
definition: bearing hardship, boredom or extra work patiently without grumbling about it to anyone
example: The uncomplaining night-shift nurse covered a double shift when her colleague called in sick.

hindi: निश्चिंतता — जहाँ दूसरे घबराएँ वहाँ चिंता का सहज अभाव
definition: a calm lack of worry about something that others might fret over, without being cold or dismissive
example: He watched the stock dip with an unconcern that surprised his anxious brother.

hindi: बेपरवाह — चिंता या परवाह से पूरी तरह खाली
definition: feeling no worry or care about something that others think should matter to you
example: He seemed entirely unconcerned that the train was forty minutes late and kept reading his book.

hindi: निःशर्त सकारात्मक स्वीकार — बिना किसी शर्त के व्यक्ति को अपनाना
definition: psychology's term for warm acceptance of a person exactly as they are, with no conditions attached to that acceptance
example: The mentor's unconditional positive regard made the struggling student stop hiding her failed attempts.

hindi: आराम से परे उदास; सांत्वना की अक्षमता
definition: sad beyond comforting; incapable of being consoled
example: Inconsolable when her son died.

hindi: भावनाएँ न दिखाने वाला — प्रेम या दुःख चुपचाप सहना
definition: reserved about showing affection or emotion openly, keeping warmth hidden even when the feelings underneath are strong
example: Her undemonstrative father never hugged her but always waited up until she got home.

hindi: समझदार सहानुभूति — दूसरे की स्थिति को बिना दोष दिए समझने वाला
definition: sympathetically aware of another person's feelings and circumstances, ready to forgive rather than blame
example: Her boss was understanding about the school run and let her shift her hours without a fuss.

hindi: संयत अभिव्यक्ति — भावना को धीमे और हल्के ढंग से जताने वाला
definition: expressing feeling in a deliberately restrained, quiet way that leaves the strength of the emotion for others to sense
example: His understated thanks, a nod and a squeeze of the shoulder, meant more than any speech.

hindi: सबसे मजबूत या प्रचलित भावना के विपरीत एक झुकाव
definition: an inclination contrary to the strongest or prevailing feeling
example: His account had a poignant undertow of regret.

hindi: कम आँका हुआ — अपनी क़दर न मिलने की खटास
definition: feeling that your worth is rated far below what you actually contribute, a sore and resentful sense of being short-changed
example: Watching a newer colleague get the promotion left him feeling undervalued and quietly looking at other jobs.

hindi: अप्रभावित निराशा — अपेक्षा से कम पाकर ठंडी उदासी
definition: mildly disappointed because something turned out far less impressive than the fuss around it had promised
example: After all the hype she was distinctly underwhelmed by the sequel.

hindi: निर्भीक — बाधाओं से हतोत्साहित न होने वाला
definition: continuing calmly toward a goal without being discouraged by a setback, warning or refusal that would stop others
example: Undeterred by the rain, they set up the market stall anyway.

hindi: बेचैनी — बिना स्पष्ट कारण के मन का असहज और अशांत रहना
definition: a quiet, nagging feeling that something is wrong or about to go wrong, without being able to name exactly what
example: A faint unease settled over the meeting when the manager closed the door before speaking.

hindi: चिंता की भावना जो आपको तनाव और चिड़चिड़ा बनाती है
definition: feelings of anxiety that make you tense and irritable

hindi: सुरक्षा की भावना की कमी या कोई आसानी या पुन: आश्वासन नहीं देना
definition: lacking a sense of security or affording no ease or reassurance
example: Farmers were uneasy until rain finally came.

hindi: भावनारहित — न भावना दिखाना, न उससे प्रेरित होना
definition: not showing or seeming to feel strong emotion, approaching things with a cool and reasoned steadiness
example: The surgeon was unemotional as she explained the odds, which the family found both reassuring and unnerving.

hindi: सहानुभूति भावनात्मक प्रतिक्रियाओं की अनुपस्थिति द्वारा प्रदर्शित
definition: apathy demonstrated by an absence of emotional reactions

hindi: अनुत्साही — बिना जोश या रुचि के
definition: showing little eagerness or interest, going along with something without any warmth or energy
example: The group chat gave an unenthusiastic thumbs up to the idea of another team-building day.

hindi: अनुत्तेजित स्वभाव — जिसे आसानी से जोश या घबराहट न आए
definition: having a temperament that is hard to stir into excitement, alarm or enthusiasm, calm by nature rather than by effort
example: Grandad was so unexcitable that he watched the penalty shootout with the same face he used for the weather.

hindi: जानबूझकर असंभव तरीके से
definition: deliberately impassive in manner
example: Deadpan humor.

hindi: अप्रभावित — चौंकाने वाली बात से भी विचलित नहीं
definition: not thrown off or shaken by something surprising or difficult, carrying on calmly as though nothing happened
example: The barista seemed unfazed when the espresso machine hissed and sprayed steam across the counter.

hindi: डर या डरावना
definition: invulnerable to fear or intimidation
example: Audacious explorers.

hindi: दूसरों के लिए महसूस करना
definition: devoid of feeling for others
example: An unfeeling wretch.

hindi: अथक — जिसका जोश या मेहनत कभी कम न पड़े
definition: keeping the same energy and enthusiasm all the way through without tiring or fading
example: His unflagging cheerfulness on the night shift kept the rest of the ward going.

hindi: आसानी से परेशान या उत्साहित या परेशान नहीं; चरम शांत और composure द्वारा चिह्नित
definition: not easily perturbed or excited or upset; marked by extreme calm and composure
example: Hitherto imperturbable, he now showed signs of alarm.

hindi: अघबराया हुआ — जल्दबाज़ी या हड़बड़ी में न आने वाला
definition: calm and unhurried in a situation that would normally make someone confused or nervous, with no sign of being rattled
example: The barista stayed unflustered while twelve orders stacked up and the card machine died.

hindi: क्षमाहीन — माफ न करने वाला कठोर रुख
definition: unwilling to pardon a wrong and holding onto resentment long after most people would have released it
example: She was unforgiving about the borrowed jacket, still bringing it up at every family dinner.

hindi: मितभाषी-संकोची — अपनी बात या भावनाएँ खुलकर न बताने वाला
definition: reluctant to share information or feelings, answering with a guarded reserve that gives away as little as possible
example: Asked how the interview went, he was unforthcoming and just said the coffee was fine.

hindi: जैसा कि मित्रता की अनुपस्थिति के रूप में अनुभव नहीं है
definition: dislike experienced as an absence of friendliness

hindi: अतृप्त — इच्छा या क्षमता के अधूरे रह जाने की उदासी
definition: quietly dissatisfied because a hope, talent or longing has never been given the chance to be realised
example: He felt unfulfilled in a job that used only a fraction of what he could do.

hindi: निश्चिंत-उदासीन — किसी बात की परवाह न होना
definition: untroubled and unanxious about something, a British word for calm indifference toward the outcome
example: He was unfussed about which film we picked and just brought the popcorn.

hindi: अशालीन-रूखा — प्रशंसा या जीत के क्षण में भी शिष्टता और गर्मजोशी से रहित
definition: lacking warmth or good manners at a moment that called for them, receiving praise or victory with sourness
example: It was ungracious of him to accept the award without thanking anyone who had helped.

hindi: नहीं लग रहा है या ग्रेविटी दिखा; - शेक्सपियर
definition: not feeling or showing gratitude; ; - Shakespeare
example: Ungrateful heirs.

hindi: आभार की कमी
definition: a lack of gratitude

hindi: निःसंकोच उदार — बिना मन मारे, खुशी से दिया गया
definition: given freely and gladly, with no trace of resentment or feeling that you are owed something back
example: Her ungrudging praise for the rival team's design surprised everyone at the review.

hindi: जब अच्छी तरह से किया जा रहा है की स्थिति में नहीं
definition: emotions experienced when not in a state of well-being

hindi: उदासी या उदासी या असंतोष का सामना करना या चिह्नित करना
definition: experiencing or marked by or causing sadness or sorrow or discontent
example: Unhappy over her departure.

hindi: परेशान करना या असहज बनाना या चिंतित होना या चिंतित होना
definition: disturb in mind or make uneasy or cause to be worried or alarmed
example: She was rather perturbed by the news that her father was seriously ill.

hindi: इत्मीनान — जल्दबाज़ी के दबाव से मुक्त शांत भाव
definition: calmly free of any rush or pressure to be quick, moving at a pace that reflects an easy mind
example: The old barber worked in an unhurried way that made every customer forget they had somewhere to be.

hindi: अप्रभावित — दिखावे या दावे से कोई प्रशंसा न जगना
definition: feeling no admiration or wonder toward something presented as remarkable, meeting it with a flat shrug
example: The kids were unimpressed by the new office coffee machine and asked where the vending machine went.

hindi: प्रेरणाहीन — बिना रचनात्मक जोश या नयेपन के
definition: lacking any creative spark or excitement, feeling flat and empty when you try to begin something
example: He stared at the blank slide deck feeling completely uninspired and closed the laptop.

hindi: रुचिहीन — किसी बात में ध्यान या आकर्षण न होना
definition: feeling no curiosity or attraction toward something, so that your attention simply drifts away from it
example: He was so uninterested in the office gossip that he wandered off mid-sentence to refill his coffee.

hindi: निष्ठुर — कठोर शब्दों या मदद न करने से आहत करने वाला
definition: lacking kindness in a way that hurts another person, whether through harsh words or a refusal to help
example: It was unkind to laugh at his accent in front of the whole class.

hindi: आराम महसूस करने का कारण
definition: cause to feel relaxed
example: A hot bath always relaxes me.

hindi: अप्रिय — प्रेम पाने के अयोग्य होने की पीड़ादायक धारणा
definition: believing, deep down, that you are not the kind of person anyone could truly love, whatever they say
example: After the third breakup in a year he confided that he had started to feel fundamentally unlovable.

hindi: प्रेम-वंचित — किसी के स्नेह के बिना उदास महसूस करना
definition: feeling that nobody cares for or values you, with a sorrowful ache where affection should be
example: The new hire felt unloved when her first week passed without a single welcome message.

hindi: साहस छीनना — किसी को भीतर से कमज़ोर कर देना
definition: to strip someone of their courage or self-control so they feel weak, shaken and helpless
example: The sight of his childhood home being demolished unmanned him completely.

hindi: कोई दया नहीं
definition: having or showing no mercy
example: The merciless enemy.

hindi: बेसहारा — जिसका सहारा और ठिकाना छूट गया हो
definition: feeling unsteady and unanchored after losing the person, place or routine that kept you steady
example: With her grandmother gone she felt unmoored, no longer sure whose voice to hear when she doubted herself.

hindi: अविचलित — भावुक करने वाली बात से भी अछूता
definition: feeling no stir of emotion when something is meant to touch, persuade, or affect you
example: She watched the tearful farewell video at the leaving party and remained completely unmoved.

hindi: विचलित करना — किसी का साहस और आत्मविश्वास छीन लेना
definition: to make someone lose their confidence and composure, leaving them shaken and uncertain
example: The silence on the call after her proposal completely unnerved her.

hindi: विचलित — साहस और स्थिरता खोया हुआ
definition: shaken and stripped of your usual composure and confidence by something disturbing or unexpected
example: The unnerved driver pulled over after the deer leapt across the motorway inches from the bonnet.

hindi: दया या दया के बिना
definition: without mercy or pity
example: An act of ruthless ferocity.

hindi: संवेदनाओं से असहमत, मन, या भावनाओं से असहमत
definition: disagreeable to the senses, to the mind, or feelings
example: An unpleasant personality.

hindi: असहमत उत्तेजना के कारण होने वाली भावना; महसूस करने वाले राज्यों की निरंतरता का एक ध्रुव
definition: the feeling caused by disagreeable stimuli; one pole of a continuum of states of feeling

hindi: अशांत — बेचैन, चिंतित और चैन न पाने वाला
definition: restless and uneasy in mind, unable to settle down or find any peace
example: An unquiet night of checking her phone left her exhausted before the interview.

hindi: एकतरफा — जिस प्रेम का उत्तर न मिले
definition: offered with real affection but not given back, leaving the one who loves waiting for a warmth that never arrives
example: Her unreciprocated affection for the barista survived a whole winter of polite small talk.

hindi: अपश्चात्तापी — गलती पर दुखी नहीं
definition: showing no regret or remorse for a wrong even after being confronted with it, calmly standing by what you did and refusing any apology
example: The unrepentant roommate ate the labelled leftovers again.

hindi: एकतरफ़ा प्रेम — जिसका बदला या प्रतिदान न मिले
definition: describing love or affection that is felt strongly but not returned by the other person
example: Years of unrequited feelings for his best friend finally spilled out over drinks.

hindi: एकतरफ़ा प्रेम — जिसका उत्तर न मिले
definition: a longing love for someone who does not return it, mixing tenderness with a steady quiet ache
example: Years of unrequited love for his best friend meant he clapped a little too hard at her engagement party.

hindi: प्रतिक्रियाहीन — भावनात्मक संकेतों पर कोई जवाब न देने वाला
definition: not reacting to emotional signals or appeals from others, giving nothing back where a feeling was expected
example: She told him she was leaving and he stayed unresponsive, scrolling through the match scores.

hindi: अशांति — जनता में फैला असंतोष और बेचैनी
definition: a simmering shared discontent among a population that shows in protests, strikes and a general refusal to settle
example: Months of unrest over the parking changes made every council meeting a shouting match.

hindi: अविचलित — किसी बात से परेशान या क्षुब्ध नहीं
definition: staying calm and smooth on the surface when something happens that would upset or annoy most people
example: The train conductor stayed unruffled as passengers complained about the third delay of the morning.

hindi: अरुचिकर और संदिग्ध — नैतिक रूप से गंदा लगने वाला
definition: disagreeable in a morally distasteful way, used of people, dealings or places that seem dishonest or seedy
example: The landlord had some unsavory friends who collected rent in cash and never gave receipts.

hindi: निस्वार्थ — अपने से पहले दूसरों की परवाह
definition: caring about the needs of other people more than your own comfort or advantage
example: In an unselfish move she passed the credit for the launch to the junior developer.

hindi: भावुकता से मुक्त — व्यावहारिक और कठोर यथार्थवादी
definition: not swayed by tender feelings or nostalgia, dealing with things practically even when they carry emotional weight
example: She was unsentimental about the old house and had it on the market a week after the funeral.

hindi: अशांत कर देना — मन की शांति भंग कर बेचैनी भर देना
definition: to disturb someone's calm and leave them feeling uneasy and off balance without a clear threat
example: The empty desk next to hers, cleared overnight with no announcement, unsettled everyone on the floor.

hindi: अस्थिर मन — बेचैनी से अव्यवस्थित और असहज
definition: feeling restless and uneasy because things around you are uncertain and nothing feels quite in place
example: He felt unsettled all week after the team reorganisation was announced.

hindi: अटल — किसी झटके से न डगमगाने वाला
definition: so firmly held that no doubt, argument or shock can disturb it, staying steady while everything around it wobbles
example: His unshakable faith in the team calmed everyone during the outage.

hindi: अविचलित — किसी भी बात से न चौंकने, न हिलने वाला
definition: so steady and experienced that nothing surprising, crude or terrible can shake your calm or make you flinch
example: The unshockable emergency dispatcher took the bizarre call in the same even voice as always.

hindi: अहास्य — कठोर गंभीरता में मुस्कान से वंचित चेहरा
definition: keeping a serious closed expression that offers no warmth, a face that refuses to soften into a smile
example: The unsmiling doorman checked every name on the list twice.

hindi: असामाजिक — लोगों से मिलना-जुलना नापसंद करने वाला
definition: disliking the company of other people and avoiding chances to talk or spend time with them
example: He was so unsociable that he took his lunch to the stairwell rather than sit with the team.

hindi: अजेय — ऐसी ऊर्जा और संकल्प जिसे रोका न जा सके
definition: feeling or seeming so full of momentum, energy and determination that nothing could halt your progress
example: After the first two sales came in, the new founder felt unstoppable and worked straight through the weekend.

hindi: आराम महसूस करने का कारण
definition: cause to feel relaxed
example: A hot bath always relaxes me.

hindi: आत्म-विश्वास की कमी
definition: lacking self-confidence
example: Stood in the doorway diffident and abashed.

hindi: अनजान — किसी छल की आशंका न रखने वाला
definition: having no idea that something harmful or dishonest is about to happen to you, feeling safe when you are not
example: The unsuspecting intern kept smiling through the meeting where the team quietly decided to cut her project.

hindi: अटल — किसी भी दबाव में अपने निश्चय से न हटने वाला
definition: holding steadily to a purpose, loyalty or belief without once bending or drifting, however strong the pressure to give way
example: Her unswerving support for the whistleblower cost her friends but never her sleep.

hindi: असंवेदनशील — दूसरे के दुख से अछूता
definition: showing no concern or understanding for someone's trouble, hearing their story without being moved
example: The unsympathetic reply from customer service simply repeated the returns policy.

hindi: नहीं लग रहा है या ग्रेविटी दिखा; - शेक्सपियर
definition: not feeling or showing gratitude; ; - Shakespeare
example: Ungrateful heirs.

hindi: निश्चिंत — चिंता या व्याकुलता से पूरी तरह मुक्त
definition: free from worry or inner disturbance, with a mind that carries no nagging concern about anything
example: She slept untroubled the night before the exam because she had studied everything she could.

hindi: किसी को नुकसान पहुंचाने का कारण
definition: cause to lose one's composure

hindi: अवांछित — ऐसा लगना कि किसी को आपकी ज़रूरत नहीं
definition: feeling that nobody wishes to have you around, a bruised sense of being surplus to other people's lives
example: He felt unwanted when the meeting carried on cheerfully without anyone noticing he had joined the call.

hindi: असावधान — खतरे से अनजान और सतर्कता से रहित
definition: not alert to danger or trickery, comfortably off guard when caution was needed most
example: The unwary new hire clicked the phishing link within minutes of getting his laptop.

hindi: अडिग — जो कभी डगमगाए नहीं
definition: holding steady in belief or loyalty without the slightest wobble under pressure
example: Her unwavering support for the new schedule surprised the colleagues who expected her to complain.

hindi: अस्वागतपूर्ण — नए आने वाले को अवांछित महसूस कराने वाला
definition: making a newcomer feel unwanted through cold looks, silence or a lack of any friendly gesture
example: The unwelcoming silence when she joined the video call made her wonder whether she had the wrong link.

hindi: तनाव छोड़ना — काम के बाद धीरे-धीरे शांत होना
definition: to let built-up tension loosen gradually after effort or stress until the mind feels easy again
example: She likes to unwind after a long shift by cooking something slow with the radio on.

hindi: निश्चिंत — बिना किसी चिंता के मन का हल्कापन
definition: free from worry or anxiety, calm and untroubled about what might happen next
example: He was unworried about the results, having done everything he could, and slept soundly the night before.

hindi: अयोग्यता का बोध — प्रेम या सम्मान के लायक न लगना
definition: the feeling that you do not deserve the love, praise or good fortune that comes your way
example: A quiet unworthiness made him deflect every compliment his manager offered in the review.

hindi: अटल — दबाव में भी न झुकने वाला
definition: refusing to bend or give way under pressure, sometimes to the point of stiffness
example: The negotiator stayed unyielding on price even after the buyer walked out twice.

hindi: आशावादी उत्साह — हँसमुख और सकारात्मक
definition: cheerful and positive in outlook, especially when talking about something that could go either way
example: The manager stayed upbeat in the standup even though the deadline had just moved forward.

hindi: उत्थित — मन हल्का और हौसला ऊँचा
definition: feeling raised out of a downcast mood into hope, gladness and renewed energy, usually by something beautiful or kind
example: She left the concert uplifted and hummed all the way to the bus stop.

hindi: उत्साहवर्धक — मन को ऊपर उठाने वाला
definition: making you feel happier, more hopeful and morally raised above your ordinary worries
example: The team lead's short uplifting message in the group chat turned the mood of the whole afternoon.

hindi: अपनी हैसियत से बढ़कर घमंड दिखाने वाला — इतराया हुआ
definition: behaving as though you are more important than your position warrants, in a way others find presumptuous and irritating
example: The intern got a bit uppity after one good week and started correcting the senior developers in code reviews.

hindi: हंगामा — आक्रोश या उत्तेजना से भरा शोरगुल
definition: a sudden burst of loud, angry or excited commotion from a group, all shouting at once
example: The announcement that bonuses were cancelled caused an uproar in the meeting room.

hindi: ठहाकों भरा — ज़ोरदार हँसी और शोर वाला
definition: provoking or marked by loud, unrestrained laughter and noisy delight from a group
example: The team lunch grew uproarious when someone found the old company photos.

hindi: उखड़ा हुआ — अपनी जमीन से जबरन अलग होने का दुख
definition: sorrowful and unsettled after being pulled away from the home and people you were deeply attached to
example: The transfer to the Singapore office left him uprooted, missing the corner café where everyone knew his order.

hindi: विक्षुब्ध — दुखी, परेशान और भीतर से हिला हुआ
definition: unhappy, worried and emotionally shaken by something that has happened, often close to tears or anger
example: She was too upset by the layoff news to finish her lunch in the canteen.

hindi: एक सामयिक स्थिति में होना
definition: being in a tense state

hindi: प्रबल आवेग — कुछ करने की अचानक और ज़ोरदार इच्छा
definition: a strong sudden wish to do something, felt as a push from inside before any reason arrives
example: She resisted the urge to reply to the message straight away and put her phone in the drawer.

hindi: तात्कालिकता — तुरंत कुछ करने का दबावभरा भाव
definition: a pressing feeling that something must be done immediately, with no time to spare
example: There was a sudden urgency in her voice when she asked everyone to check the shared drive.

hindi: झूठी गौरव की विशेषता; आत्म-आयात की अतिरंजित भावना होना
definition: characteristic of false pride; having an exaggerated sense of self-importance
example: A conceited fool.

hindi: आत्मश्लाघी — खोखली शान का घमंड
definition: boastfully proud of your own achievements or appearance in an empty, showy way that craves admiration from others
example: The vainglorious captain kept retelling the story of his one winning goal to anyone who sat near him on the train.

hindi: वीर — कठिन स्थिति में बहादुरी दिखाने वाला
definition: showing noble courage in a hard fight, often one that cannot be won, where the effort itself earns respect
example: The team made a valiant effort to ship on time despite losing two developers mid-sprint.

hindi: मान्यता — भावनाओं के स्वीकारे जाने की तसल्ली
definition: the reassuring comfort of having your feelings acknowledged as real and reasonable by someone else
example: Just hearing 'that sounds really hard' from her manager was the validation she needed.

hindi: क़दर पाया हुआ — अपने महत्व को पहचाने जाने का सुखद भाव
definition: feeling that your work and presence matter to the people around you, a steady warmth of being counted rather than a rush of praise
example: One line in the review, saying the team would struggle without her, left her feeling valued for weeks.

hindi: अत्यधिक गौरव की भावना
definition: feelings of excessive pride

hindi: शेखी बघारना — अपनी बड़ाई का बखान करना
definition: to boast about or praise something of your own excessively, in a proud and often formal way
example: The company vaunted its new office so loudly that visitors were surprised to find an ordinary open-plan floor.

hindi: प्रचंड — तीव्र और जोशीली भावना से भरा
definition: showing strong, forceful and passionate feeling, especially in anger or objection
example: She was vehement that the presentation should not go ahead without the corrected figures.

hindi: एक मात्र इच्छा, प्राप्त करने के प्रयास से असंतुष्ट
definition: a mere wish, unaccompanied by effort to obtain

hindi: सम्मान और सम्मान की भावनाओं के बारे में; मधुमक्खियों या बहिष्कारों पर विचार करें या उनमें से प्रत्येक में हों
definition: regard with feelings of respect and reverence; consider hallowed or exalted or be in awe of
example: Fear God as your father.

hindi: सम्मान और सम्मान की भावनाओं के बारे में; मधुमक्खियों या बहिष्कारों पर विचार करें या उनमें से प्रत्येक में हों
definition: regard with feelings of respect and reverence; consider hallowed or exalted or be in awe of
example: Fear God as your father.

hindi: किसी व्यक्ति या किसी चीज़ के लिए गहन सम्मान की भावना
definition: a feeling of profound respect for someone or something
example: The fear of God.

hindi: प्रतिशोध — भारी और कठोर बदले की भावना
definition: punishment inflicted in return for an injury, with a heavier and more righteous feeling than ordinary revenge
example: She pursued the parking ticket appeal with a vengeance that startled the council clerk.

hindi: बदला लेने या बदला लेने के लिए इरादा करने के लिए disposed; - शेक्सपियर; - M.R. कोहेन
definition: disposed to seek revenge or intended for revenge; - Shakespeare; - M.R.Cohen
example: More vindictive than jealous love.

hindi: बदला लेने की इच्छा
definition: a malevolent desire for revenge

hindi: विष — बोली में झलकता तीखा द्वेष
definition: intense bitter hostility that comes out in cutting, malicious words meant to wound
example: The venom in her reply to the group chat made everyone else go quiet for the rest of the evening.

hindi: विषैला — कड़वाहट और द्वेष से भरा
definition: full of bitter spite and meant to wound, as when resentment finally comes out in words
example: Her venomous remark about his promotion silenced the whole table at lunch.

hindi: भड़ास निकालना — दबे गुस्से या दुख को बोलकर बाहर करना
definition: to release pent-up anger or frustration by talking it out, wanting relief rather than advice
example: She called her brother from the train just to vent about the meeting and hung up feeling lighter.

hindi: भावविह्वल — भावनाओं से गला रुंधा हुआ और आंसुओं के कगार पर
definition: so choked with sudden emotion that you can hardly speak, overcome and wavering on the edge of tears
example: When the whole team signed the farewell card, she got too verklempt to finish her thank-you speech.

hindi: विशेष रूप से मामूली जलन से परेशान होना
definition: cause annoyance in; disturb, especially by minor irritations
example: Mosquitoes buzzing in my ear really bothers me.

hindi: कुछ परेशानियों से उत्पन्न क्रोध
definition: anger produced by some annoying irritation

hindi: माहौल की तरंग — किसी जगह या व्यक्ति से मिलता भावनात्मक अहसास
definition: the informal, instinctive sense of the mood a place, group or person gives off, felt before it can be explained
example: The vibe in the new coworking space was friendly enough that people shared chargers without asking.

hindi: जीवंत — ऊर्जा और उत्साह से चमकता हुआ
definition: glowing with vivid energy and enthusiasm, so alive and bright in spirit that others notice it at once
example: She was so vibrant at the reunion that nobody guessed she had worked a night shift before it.

hindi: परोक्ष अनुभूत — दूसरे के अनुभव से स्वयं महसूस की गई भावना
definition: felt through imagining or watching someone else's experience rather than living it yourself, such as borrowed pride or thrill
example: She got a vicarious thrill from watching her cousin's marathon finish on the live stream at work.

hindi: परोक्ष लज्जा — दूसरे की शर्म खुद महसूस करना
definition: the embarrassment you feel on someone else's behalf when they do something awkward and seem not to notice
example: Watching the presenter's joke die was pure vicarious embarrassment.

hindi: परोक्ष आघात — दूसरों की पीड़ा देख-सुनकर स्वयं पर पड़ा मानसिक घाव
definition: lasting emotional distress and shaken faith in the world that comes from repeatedly hearing or seeing others' suffering
example: After a year of moderating graphic reports, the content reviewer was diagnosed with vicarious trauma.

hindi: दुष्ट — चोट पहुँचाने के इरादे से क्रूर
definition: deliberately cruel and violent, intending to wound or harm as badly as possible
example: The vicious rumour about the new starter was traced back to someone in her own team.

hindi: पीड़ित-भाव — खुद को हमेशा शिकार समझने की मनोदशा
definition: the state of seeing yourself as wronged by others, sometimes clung to as an identity and excuse
example: He wore his victimhood so openly that colleagues stopped mentioning any problem near him.

hindi: ओज — शरीर और मन की सशक्त, फुर्तीली ऊर्जा
definition: robust physical and mental energy that makes effort feel easy, a healthy forceful strength you bring to whatever you tackle
example: After a week off she came back to the office with a vigour that cleared the backlog by Wednesday.

hindi: नीच और घिनौना — नैतिक रूप से गंदा और घृणित
definition: extremely unpleasant or morally disgusting, with a strong sense that the thing is low, dirty and beneath decency
example: The comments under the video were so vile that the moderator closed the thread within an hour.

hindi: जोश — काम में झलकती चुस्त, उछलती ऊर्जा
definition: lively bouncing energy and enthusiasm that shows in how briskly you move and speak, usually paired with vigour
example: The new intern attacked the filing cabinet with a vim nobody in accounts had seen for years.

hindi: सही सिद्ध होना — निर्दोष या सही ठहराए जाने की तसल्ली
definition: the satisfied relief of being proved right after others doubted, blamed or dismissed you
example: When the audit backed her numbers she felt a quiet vindication across the meeting table.

hindi: बदला लेने या बदला लेने के लिए इरादा करने के लिए disposed; - शेक्सपियर; - M.R. कोहेन
definition: disposed to seek revenge or intended for revenge; - Shakespeare; - M.R.Cohen
example: More vindictive than jealous love.

hindi: बदला लेने की इच्छा
definition: a malevolent desire for revenge

hindi: खट्टा-चिड़चिड़ा — सिरके जैसी कड़वाहट से भरा स्वभाव
definition: sour and sharp-tempered in manner, a peevish acid disposition that turns every remark slightly bitter
example: The vinegary landlord answered the door already complaining about the noise.

hindi: अंतःप्रेरित — सोच से पहले शरीर में महसूस होने वाली गहरी भावना
definition: felt deep in the body as an instinctive gut reaction of fear, disgust or excitement, before any thought has formed
example: He had a visceral reaction to the sound of the drill, even in the safety of the waiting room.

hindi: जीवन-शक्ति — जीवंत, स्वस्थ और सक्रिय होने की ऊर्जा
definition: the feeling of being fully alive and healthy, a steady inner energy and eagerness for living rather than a single burst
example: Even at seventy, her grandmother had a vitality that left the rest of the family tired on holiday walks.

hindi: तेज़ाबी कटुता — जलाने वाली कटु आलोचना
definition: cruel and bitter criticism or anger expressed in words meant to burn like acid
example: The comments section filled with vitriol within minutes of the article going live.

hindi: तेज़ाबी कटुता — बेहद कड़वी और घातक आलोचना
definition: savagely bitter and cruel in criticism, as corrosive as acid on whoever receives it
example: The vitriolic review of the restaurant read more like a personal grudge than a meal.

hindi: जीवंत — आकर्षक रूप से ऊर्जावान और प्रसन्न
definition: attractively lively and spirited, full of animated energy and sparkling good humour
example: She was the vivacious one at the dinner table, telling stories with her hands.

hindi: अस्थिर मिज़ाज — पल में भड़क उठने वाला
definition: liable to sudden unpredictable changes of temper, calm one moment and furious the next
example: His volatile moods made the whole kitchen staff walk carefully around him.

hindi: दृश्यरति — दूसरों के निजी जीवन को छिपकर देखने में आनंद
definition: a fascination with secretly watching other people's private lives or intimate moments for pleasure
example: Scrolling through a stranger's holiday photos for an hour felt uncomfortably close to voyeurism.

hindi: भावनात्मक रूप से असुरक्षित — चोट खाने के लिए खुला
definition: emotionally open and unprotected, so that criticism, rejection or unkindness could easily wound you
example: He felt vulnerable reading his first short story aloud to the writing group.

hindi: सनकी-मज़ेदार — अजीबोगरीब ढंग से हास्यास्पद

hindi: दृढ़ता से या लगातार इच्छा
definition: desire strongly or persistently

hindi: लंबे समय तक unfulfilled इच्छा या आवश्यकता
definition: prolonged unfulfilled desire or need

hindi: चिल्लाना — क्रोध, डर या उत्साह में ज़ोर से चीखना
definition: to shout loudly and sharply from anger, fright or excitement, without the control of ordinary speech
example: The kids yelled with delight when the sprinkler came on.

hindi: चीख पड़ना — अचानक दर्द, डर या हैरानी में छोटी तीखी चीख निकालना
definition: to give a short, sharp, high cry of sudden pain, alarm or surprise
example: He yelped when the cold water hit him in the shower.

hindi: कुछ के लिए या कुछ करना
definition: a yearning for something or to do something

hindi: चीख कर रोना — पीड़ा या विरोध में लंबी कर्कश चीख निकालना
definition: to let out a long, loud, wailing cry of pain, misery or angry protest that carries across the whole house
example: The baby yowled the moment the car stopped moving.

hindi: गंदा और अरुचिकर — बच्चों की बोली की हल्की घृणा
definition: unpleasant to taste, touch or look at in a small childish way, the word a toddler uses for disliked food
example: The toddler pushed the plate of spinach away and announced that it was yucky.

hindi: अटपटा-मज़ेदार — बेतुका और पागलपन भरा हास्य
definition: amusingly crazy and unconventional, funny because of wild, absurd unpredictability
example: The zany energy of the improv night left everyone hoarse from laughing.

hindi: मजबूत उत्सुकता की भावना (आमतौर पर किसी व्यक्ति या कारण के पक्ष में)
definition: a feeling of strong eagerness (usually in favor of a person or cause)
example: They were imbued with a revolutionary ardor.

hindi: सक्रिय रुचि और उत्साह से चिह्नित
definition: marked by active interest and enthusiasm
example: An avid sports fan.

hindi: जोरदार और उत्साही आनंद
definition: vigorous and enthusiastic enjoyment

hindi: भावनापूर्ण आनंद द्वारा चिह्नित
definition: marked by spirited enjoyment

hindi: जोरदार और उत्साही आनंद
definition: vigorous and enthusiastic enjoyment

hindi: निढाल — इतना थका कि लगभग बेसुध
definition: informally so exhausted that you feel dazed and barely able to function, almost asleep on your feet
example: After the overnight flight she was zonked and put the milk in the cupboard and the cereal in the fridge.
